item.title: ベネズエラで約2年ぶりに全国抗議デモ、自由な選挙要求
item.description: ［カラカス／マラカイ（ベネズエラ） ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［カラカス／マラカイ（ベネズエラ）　２２日　ロイター］ - ベネズエラ各地で２２日、野党側による全国規模の抗議デモが約２年ぶりに行われ、数千人が自由な選挙の実施や政治の変革を求めて街頭に繰り出した。

米国は、１月に米軍がマドゥロ大統領を拘束して以降、ロドリゲス暫定大統領が率いる政権と緊密に協力している。トランプ米大統領とロドリゲス氏はいずれも選挙を実施すると述べているが、議会選、大統領選ともに日程は決まっていない。

ノーベル平和賞を受賞したベネズエラの野党指導者マリア・コリナ・マチャド氏は、結果を巡り争いとなった２０２４年の選挙後に潜伏生活を送った後、国外に出て間もなく１年になる。同氏は２７年７月までに選挙を実施する必要があると訴えている。

デモはマチャド氏率いる政治運動「ベンテ・ベネズエラ」が主催し、首都カラカスのほか、バレンシア、マラカイ、サンクリストバル、マラカイボなどで行われた。

野党の一派と暫定政権の間では、将来の選挙の公正さを確保するため、最高裁と選挙管理委員会の体制刷新を目指す協議が米国の支援の下で続いている。直近の協議は今月行われたが、改革には相当な時間がかかる可能性がある。

item.title: Singer Raye wins Mercury Prize for 'This Music May Contain Hope'
item.description: Singer Raye won the Mercury Prize for her second studio album "This Music May Contain Hope" on Thursday, beating the likes of veteran Paul McCartney, rock band Suede and rapper Dave for the British music award.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Singer Raye won the Mercury Prize for her second studio album "This Music May Contain Hope" on Thursday, beating the likes of veteran Paul McCartney, rock band Suede and rapper Dave for the British music award. Judges praised the "scale, structure, ambition and sheer charm" of the 28-year-old chart-topper's 73-minute record, which blends jazz, orchestral pop, funk and other genres. "Hope is a very cheesy word ... but hope is just something that we all need," Raye said while accepting the award at the ceremony held in the northern English city of Newcastle. "Music is medicine, so I just hope as well that message comes across to anyone who needs it." First handed out to rockers Primal Scream in 1992, the annual £25,000 ($33,495) Mercury Prize shortlists 12 albums released by British and Irish acts in the United Kingdom in the past year. It is considered less mainstream than the BRIT Awards, Britain's pop music honours, and is open to all music genres. This year's contenders included McCartney, who was nominated for his album "The Boys of Dungeon Lane", and past winners Suede and Dave, who were shortlisted for their respective records "Antidepressants" and "The Boy Who Played The Harp". The nominees also included singer Olivia Dean for "The Art of Loving", former Little Mix star Jade for "That’s Showbiz Baby!", and producer Nia Archives, who was recognised for "Emotional Junglist". Band Knats, musicians Kojey Radical and Dove Ellis were also in the running for their respective records "A Great Day In Newcastle", "Don't Look Down" and "Blizzard". Florence + the Machine's "Everybody Scream" and "Help (2)", a compilation album by various artists for War Child, completed the list. Rocker Sam Fender won the prize last year for his third album "People Watching". ($1 = £0.7464)

item.title: 'Slow down': Hamilton jokes to champion-in-waiting Antonelli
item.description: Lewis Hamilton had one piece of advice for Kimi Antonelli as the 20-year-old Mercedes driver stands on the verge of becoming Formula One's youngest ever champion: "Slow down!"
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Lewis Hamilton had one piece of advice for Kimi Antonelli as the 20-year-old Mercedes driver stands on the verge of becoming Formula One's youngest ever champion: "Slow down!" The Italian would have to win the US Grand Prix and have everything else fall his way for the title to be secured in Austin on Sunday but, with a lead of 102 points and a maximum 150 still to be won, he can be sure it is just a matter of time. Hamilton, winner of seven championships and the most successful driver in the history of the sport, left no doubt he was joking. "He doesn't need any advice. I think he's shown this year, and also last year, but particularly this year, his talent and his ability, his calmness and his approach," said the Ferrari driver of the man who replaced him at Mercedes last season. "He's done an amazing job this year, and I'm so proud of him. I'm so proud of the way he's carried himself, how he interacts with the drivers and even with you guys," he told reporters on Thursday. "It's great to see him and the team excel. If it's not my team, I'd always want to see my old team do well." Antonelli would be the first Italian to take the title since Alberto Ascari in 1953 and, while professing to be taking one race at a time, he knows what awaits. "It definitely is crazy if you think about it, but that's why I won't think about it," he said of the possibility that he could be champion already on Sunday with five races to spare as the calendar stands. "I've heard that something catastrophic needs to happen to the others for me to become champion (in Austin). For me, it needs to be a perfect weekend. The others need to have a poor result, which is unlikely to happen," he added. Antonelli said following in Hamilton's footsteps as a champion as well as a Mercedes driver would be a dream come true, but also made clear he was prepared to wait. "Obviously, I'm in an incredible position... But, of course, I still have to keep going, and the mindset is always the same: whenever I go on track, I want to be at the top and try to win as much as possible, whether I win the championship this weekend, next weekend or in Brazil. Let's see," he said.

item.title: Deckers results show aggressive discounts from rivals are hitting premium brands
item.description: Deckers Outdoor , the maker of UGG boots and Hoka sneakers, said aggressive discounting by rivals hurt its sales in the second quarter, highlighting challenges facing premium footwear brands as shoppers grow more selective.
item.dc:creator: Sanskriti Shekhar
item.content:encoded: Deckers Outdoor (DECK.N) , the maker of UGG boots and Hoka sneakers, said aggressive discounting by rivals hurt its sales in the second quarter, highlighting challenges facing premium footwear brands as shoppers grow more selective. Shares of the company fell 8% in extended trading after the results. Here are more details: The footwear maker reported sales of $1.48 billion, [USN:L1N46819K TEXT:"missing"] analysts' estimate of $1.51 billion, but reported a 27% rise in profit for the quarter ended September 30 "In the US, we saw promotional activity increase throughout the quarter, particularly in athletic footwear, which weighed on our US e-commerce performance as we maintained full-price discipline," CEO Stefano Caroti said on the company's earnings call Comparable direct-to-consumer sales fell 6.4% in the second quarter "There is a heightened focus on revenues over margins," said Simeon A. Siegel, analyst at CFA "Share declines were evident across every household income bracket, including higher-income consumers, highlighting the challenges facing even premium brands as shoppers become more selective," said Michael Gunther, analyst at Consumer Edge Deckers continues to grapple with intense competition in the athletic footwear market, including from larger rivals such as Nike (NKE.N) "Where we potentially lose share to others are the more compressed price points below $120, where the competition is greater," CEO Caroti said "We will continue to prioritize margin preservation and long-term value over chasing potential incremental near-term revenue that could dilute our brands," he added

item.title: ＧＭ、米レアアース磁石工場との供給契約解除 仲裁手続きに
item.description:
Eric Onstad
[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] - 米ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）が、電気自動車（ＥＶ）向けレ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＧＭ、米レアアース磁石工場との供給契約解除　仲裁手続きに 7:31 配信

ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）本社に掲げられたＧＭのロゴ。1月12日、デトロイトで撮影。REUTERS/Rebecca Cook

Eric Onstad

[ロンドン ２２日 ロイター] - 米ゼネラル・モーターズ（ＧＭ）が、電気自動車（ＥＶ）向けレアアース（希土類）磁石を製造する米工場との長期供給契約を解除し、双方が仲裁手続きに入っていることが、規制当局への提出書類と事情に詳しい関係者の話で分かった。ＧＭは同工場の最大の顧客だった。

今回の動きは、世界の永久磁石の約９０％を生産する中国への依存を減らし、国内でのレアアース生産を拡大しようとする欧米企業が直面する課題を浮き彫りにしている。

また、トランプ米大統領が２０２５年にホワイトハウスに復帰し、ＥＶに対する連邦政府の支援を削減して以降、米自動車業界を取り巻く環境がいかに変化したかも示している。

ドイツのバキュームシュメルツ（ＶＡＣ）は２３年、米サウスカロライナ州の新工場からＧＭのＥＶ向けに永久磁石を供給する長期契約を結んだ。

６月にＶＡＣを１９億ドルで買収することで合意したエナジー・フュエルズは米証券取引委員会（ＳＥＣ）に先週提出した書類で、同工場の顧客が７月１日に供給契約を解除し、その数日後にＶＡＣがこの顧客に対する仲裁手続きを開始したと明らかにした。

エナジー・フュエルズは顧客名を公表していないが、ＧＭは今週のＳＥＣへの提出書類で、ＥＶ駆動用モーター部品の供給業者が「当社による戦略的調達契約の解除を受け、損害賠償を求める仲裁を申し立てた」と記した。契約を解除した理由は説明していない。

事情に詳しい関係者は、ＶＡＣの米子会社ｅ─ＶＡＣマグネティクスとの契約を解除した顧客がＧＭだと確認した。

ＧＭとエナジー・フュエルズは、仲裁手続きは非公開だとしてコメントを控えた。

ＶＡＣは昨年終盤、５億ドルを投じた米国の磁石工場を稼働させた。ＶＡＣのエリック・エッシェン最高経営責任者（ＣＥＯ）が昨年９月にロイターに語ったところによると、年間生産能力は２０００トン弱で、その９０％をＧＭに販売し、残りを米政府に供給する予定だった。

ＶＡＣの米子会社は、不当な契約解除を理由に仲裁で損害賠償を求めていると述べた。

ロイター 関連ニュース 焦点：トランプ氏の中国産鉱物脱却、国内供給不足で27年期限は困難か アングル：レアアースに警戒強める日本企業、有報などへの記載5月から急増 焦点：中国、米への経済的圧力の手段拡充　貿易休戦の裏で アングル：世界で進むレアアース供給計画、米は中国依存ある程度解消か アングル：ＥＵの対中通商姿勢、ドイツの方針転換で強化へ 最終更新: 10/23(金) 7:31 ロイター

item.title: Florida attorney general proposes bill that limits social media, AI features for teens in the state
item.description: Days after Florida lost its bid for a court order forcing Meta Platforms to overhaul Instagram and Facebook for teens in the state, its attorney general said he was proposing legislation that would force the company to make the same changes.
item.dc:creator: Diana Jones
item.content:encoded: Days after Florida lost its bid for a court order forcing Meta Platforms (META.O) to overhaul Instagram and Facebook for teens in the state, its attorney general said he was proposing legislation that would force the company to make the same changes. Florida Attorney General James Uthmeier, a Republican, proposed the legislation, called the Safe Screens Act, on Thursday The act, which would need to be introduced by a legislator, dictates changes for app stores, social media companies and AI chatbots It would require app stores to verify user ages and direct social media platforms to implement two-hour time limits for teens and remove features like infinite scroll or autoplay unless parents enable them It would also bar AI chatbots from simulating companionship with minors and sharing content about self-harm and suicide, among other changes Florida is suing [USN:L6N44N0VA TEXT:"Meta"] and [USN:L6N429106 TEXT:"OpenAI"] over claims the companies have designed their platforms to be addictive to children The state asked the judges overseeing [USN:L6N45K0T3 TEXT:"each"] [USN:L6N45T10H TEXT:"case"] for orders directing the companies to make changes to their platforms On Sunday, the judge overseeing the Meta case rejected Florida’s request, saying it wasn’t appropriate to order the company to make major changes at the start of the case The judge overseeing the OpenAI case has not yet ruled Florida has a state law that bars users under the age of 14 from social media, which a US appeals court [USN:L6N4601B4 TEXT:"just upheld"] A spokesperson for Meta did not immediately respond to a request for comment on Thursday

item.title: ATP roundup: Jiri Lehecka cruises into quarterfinals at Brussels
item.description: Second-seeded Jiri Lehecka of Czechia served nine aces without a double fault while soaring to a 6-4, 6-2 victory over Belgium's Raphael Collignon in the BNP Paribas Fortis European Open at Brussels.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Second-seeded Jiri Lehecka of Czechia served nine aces without a double fault while soaring to a 6-4, 6-2 victory over Belgium's Raphael Collignon in the BNP Paribas Fortis European Open at Brussels. Lehecka won 26 of 30 (86.7%) first-serve points and had 24 winners against 14 unforced errors in the victory. He will next face Tallon Griekspoor of the Netherlands in the quarterfinals. Fifth-seeded Alex Michelsen notched a 6-3, 6-4 victory over 35-year-old Belgian David Goffin, who played in the final singles match of his 18-year career. Goffin, the former world No. 7, had 23 winners and 32 unforced errors and was honored on the court after the match. Michelsen will next face top-seeded Frenchman Arthur Fils, who won a walkover against Spain's Jaume Munar (back discomfort). In the other match, sixth-seeded Belgian Zizou Bergs beat Bosnian Damir Dzumhur 6-2, 6-4. Grand Prix Auvergne-Rhone-Alpes Second-seeded Taylor Fritz won 29 of 35 (82.9%) first-serve points while recording a 6-2, 7-5 victory over Frenchman Pierre-Hugues Herbert to advance to the quarterfinals at Lyon, France. Fritz committed just 10 unforced errors, 19 fewer than Herbert. Fritz will next face Germany's Daniel Altmaier, who beat Croatia's Borna Gojo 6-3, 6-4. Top-seeded Flavio Cobolli of Italy had a 22-10 edge in winners while dispatching Switzerland's Stan Wawrinka 6-2, 6-4. France's Luca Van Assche knocked off No. 3 Valentin Vacherot of Monaco 2-6, 6-4, 6-4, and No. 5 Brandon Nakashima sailed to a 6-4, 6-3 victory over Kyrian Jacquet of France. Almaty Open Top-seeded Daniil Medvedev of Russia had seven aces and saved all three break points he faced while recording a 6-2, 6-1 victory over Japan's Sho Shimabukuro to reach the quarterfinals in Kazakhstan. Medvedev held a 20-9 edge in winners and won 25 of 31 (80.6%) first-serve points. Shimabukuro committed 21 unforced errors to Medvedev's 10. Medvedev will next face Frenchman Terence Atmane, who knocked off Italy's Mattia Bellucci 6-7 (4), 7-6 (2), 7-6 (5). Also, No. 3 Alexander Bublik of Kazakhstan beat Hungary's Fabian Marozsan (illness) in a walkover and No. 5 Karen Khachanov of Russia outlasted Czechia's Thomas Machac 6-2, 4-6, 7-6 (7). --Field Level Media

item.title: New York City bans horse-drawn carriages from June 2028
item.description: The New York City Council voted on Thursday to ban horse-drawn carriages from city streets and Central Park beginning in June 2028, ending a historic tourist attraction and long-standing industry.
item.dc:creator: Maria Tsvetkova
item.content:encoded: The New York City Council voted on Thursday to ban horse-drawn carriages from city streets and Central Park beginning in June 2028, [USN:L6N465056 TEXT:"ending a historic tourist attraction"] and long-standing industry. Out of the city's 51 lawmakers, 40 supported the bill, which was backed by Mayor Zohran Mamdani, who earlier this month said the horse-drawn carriage industry would come to an end. Seven council members voted against it and two abstained. Support for the ban grew after the death this summer of Romanch Mahajan, an 18-year-old tourist from India. Mahajan was thrown from a carriage and died on June 17, when the horse bolted after the driver stepped away to take a picture of Mahajan's family. President Donald Trump , who has both attacked Mamdani and held cordial meetings with him, expressed skepticism about the ban. "When there is a car accident in the area, of which there are many, they don't stop cars from entering the Park. So why would they stop the Carriages? It was a Great Tradition. Another piece of History that’s gone. It will be missed!" Trump, whose business empire is headquartered in Trump Tower, minutes from Central Park, wrote on Truth Social. The bill requires the city to develop a transition plan for the workforce by April and to consider a program to compensate carriage operators for their businesses and help with the disposition of their horses. Under the proposal, the horses could not be slaughtered. The day before the vote, the Transport Workers Union, which represents carriage business owners and drivers, said that if the bill is enacted, it will seek a temporary restraining order from a court "the minute the ink dries," according to a letter sent to New York City Corporation Counsel Steve Banks. "This may be the first time in City history that a previously licensed profession was banned," the letter signed by principal attorney Arthur Schwartz said. "The proposed bill deprives the owner of all economically beneficial or productive use of their property."

item.title: 和平協議、ロシア・ウクライナ双方への安保確約軸に プーチン氏主張
item.description: ［モスクワ ２２日 ロイター］ -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
［モスクワ　２２日　ロイター］ - ロシアのプーチン大統領は２２日、ウクライナ戦争の終結に向けた今後の協議では、ロシアとウクライナ双方に対する安全保障の確約と、欧州全体の安全保障の枠組みを議論の中心に据えるべきだと述べた。

米国のウィットコフ和平交渉担当特使との会談翌日にロシアのテレビインタビューに応じ、米国仲介によるウクライナとの協議を１１月に再開する用意があると確認した。

プーチン氏は、ロシアは戦争を始めることを望んでいなかったが、自国が懸念する主要な問題についてウクライナから敵対的な反応を受けたとする従来の立場を改めて示した。

さまざまな問題について協議すれば前向きな結果につながる可能性があるとする一方、ロシアが求めているのは短期間の停戦ではなく、紛争を終結させる解決策だと強調。

「協議の目標は、短期間の一時的な停戦によってではなく、最終的な和平合意に達した後のウクライナとロシアの安全を確保することだ。この目標を達成するため、協議を再開する用意がある」と語った。

プーチン氏は、ウィットコフ氏も「欧州全体の安全保障の枠組み」にまで議論を広げる必要があると強調したと説明。「私もその点に同意する。今後数日間の展開を見てみよう」と述べた。

プーチン氏は２１日、ウィットコフ氏と会談後、ウクライナ和平に向けた米国仲介の協議を来月にも再開することで合意。ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領も同日、ロシア、米国、ウクライナの実務レベル協議を早期に開催するとの米国の提案を支持すると表明した。

ウクライナ戦争を巡る争点の多くは領土に関するもので、ロシアはウクライナ東部ドンバス地域の全域を割譲するよう要求している。ウクライナ側は、現在支配している領土の放棄を一切拒否している。

プーチン氏は、ウクライナ東部の領土に関するいかなる議論でも、同地域が「歴史的にロシアの土地」であるという自身の主張を考慮する必要があると述べた。

その上で、ロシアが侵攻を開始してから７カ月後に実施された住民投票で、同地域の住民はロシアへの編入を支持したと指摘。「まず、この問題に関する私の立場は、ここは彼らの領土ではないということだ。歴史的にロシアの領土だ」と語った。

item.title: Vantagem de Flávio sobre Lula diminui para 47% a 46%, mostra Datafolha
item.description: A vantagem numérica do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) diminuir mais uma vez no segundo turno da disputa pelo Planalto, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira, ainda que as variações registradas estejam dentro da margem de erro.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A vantagem numérica do senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) sobre o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) diminuir mais uma vez no segundo turno da disputa pelo Planalto, mostrou pesquisa Datafolha divulgada nesta quinta-feira, ainda que as variações registradas estejam dentro da margem de erro. Flávio segue com 47% das intenções de voto, enquanto Lula passou a 46%, um ponto percentual a mais que no levantamento anterior. Como a margem de erro da pesquisa é de 2 pontos percentuais, os dois candidatos continuam em situação de empate técnico. Os indecisos se mantiveram em 2%, enquanto aqueles que dizem que votarão em branco, anularão o voto ou não votarão em nenhum candidato agora chegam a 5% (eram 6%). Em votos válidos, quando não são considerados os votos brancos e nulos e os indecisos, os dois candidatos estão empatados numericamente em 50%. Na semana passada, o placar era 51% a 49%. Flávio venceu o primeiro turno da disputa pelo Planalto no início do mês com 47,03% dos votos válidos, contra 45,16% de Lula. O segundo turno será realizado no domingo.

item.title: Tunisian police clash with protesters in capital on day of heightened tensions
item.description: Tunisian police fired tear gas to disperse protesters in Ettadhamen, a suburb of the capital, after the death of a man detained on suspicion of drug dealing, amid clashes with police in two towns in southern Tunisia.
item.dc:creator: Tarek Amara
item.content:encoded: Tunisian police fired tear gas to disperse protesters in Ettadhamen, a suburb of the capital, after the death of a man detained on suspicion of drug dealing, amid clashes with police in two towns in southern Tunisia. The conflicts on Thursday coincide with a deepening economic, social and political crisis in the country, heightening fears of a wider wave of violent protests as anger grows over deteriorating living conditions and poor public services. The man's family said he died as a result of violence by police officers after his arrest, calling for the circumstances of his death to be clarified and those responsible to be held accountable. Local media, however, reported that he died after swallowing drugs. The interior ministry was not immediately available for comment. Protesters blocked roads, burned tyres and threw stones at police. Security forces responded by firing tear gas, while seeking to secure a National Guard station in the area. Earlier on Thursday, police clashed with protesters in the southern town of Jebeniana following the death of a man who his relatives say died during a security chase. The city of Agareb, also in Sfax governorate, witnessed similar clashes. In the city of Sfax, students protested on Thursday over the death of a female student who suffered a cardiac problem. Her colleagues said ambulance personnel took too long to arrive, citing a lack of medical facilities, and called for a strike at Sfax's faculties on Friday. Thousands of Tunisians joined the [USN:L1N463047 TEXT:"largest protest"] against President Kais Saied in years in the capital on Saturday, accusing him of undermining democracy and mishandling the economy in a growing challenge to his rule.

item.title: ウクライナのスターリンク利用制限問題、米上院民主議員が調査開始
item.description: [ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米上院常設調査小委員会の民主党トップ、リチャード・ブルーメンソル議員は２２日、ウクライナ軍が米宇宙開発企業スペースＸの衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」の軍事版「スターシールド」への重要なアクセスができなくなり、防衛能力が低下した問題について調査を開始したと明らかにした。

ブルーメンソル氏はヘグセス国防長官宛ての書簡で「１０月１３日夜、ウクライナ軍はスターシールドへの接続維持に必要な通信速度の上限が設定されたため、重要なアクセスを失った。こうした能力を変更する技術的・法的権限を誰が持つのか、またスペースＸのサービスが利用できなくなった場合に、国防総省が十分な代替手段を有しているのかという緊急の疑問が生じている」と述べた。

このサービス変更がホワイトハウス、国防総省、スペースＸのいずれの指示によるものだったのか、ブルーメンソル氏は情報提供を求めている。

現在の上院は共和党が多数派を占めているため、民主党には召喚状発付権限がなく、ブルーメンソル氏は政府内外の関係者に対して情報や説明を「要請」することしかできない。

ブルーメンソル氏は、今回の措置によってウクライナ軍と民間人が危険にさらされたほか「米政府が数十億ドルを投じて調達してきた重要な能力を誰が管理しているのか」という懸念も生じていると指摘した。

スターシールドは米国防総省が最大の顧客。国防総省報道官は「議会からの書簡には、他の案件と同様に直接回答する」とコメントした。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領は１４日、イーロン・マスク氏率いるスペースＸがスターリンクのサービスを制限し、ウクライナの防空能力が弱体化したと発言していた。

ブルーメンソル氏はヘグセス氏に対し、政府とスペースＸとの関係や同社技術への依存状況に関しても調査すると説明した。また書簡に盛り込んだ質問への回答期限を１１月５日、スターシールドの利用制限に関する知識を持つスペースＸ関係者による説明会の期限を１１月１２日に設定した。

１１月３日の中間選挙で民主党が上院の多数派を奪還した場合、ブルーメンソル氏が同小委員会の委員長に就任する見通しだ。

item.title: Flavio Bolsonaro and Lula about even ahead of Brazil runoff, Datafolha poll shows
item.description: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva are about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian Senator Flavio Bolsonaro and President Luiz Inacio Lula da Silva are about even heading to Sunday's election runoff, a Datafolha poll showed on Thursday. The senator, the eldest son of former President Jair Bolsonaro, would receive 47% of the vote compared with 46% for the president, according to the poll. Last week, a Datafolha poll [USN:L1N461163 TEXT:"showed the younger Bolsonaro"] at 47% and Lula at 45%. The poll has a margin of error of plus or minus 2 percentage points. 5% of the respondents said they would cast a blank vote, and undecided voters made up 2%, the poll showed. Datafolha surveyed 2,154 people between October 20-22. The senator [USN:L6N45Q04L TEXT:"surprisingly led"] Lula in the first-round vote earlier this month.

item.title: トランプ氏、石油生産は国防に不可欠と認定 国防生産法発動
item.description: [ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、石油の生産や精製、関連事業が国防に不可欠だと認定した。

トランプ氏はまた、冷戦時代に制定された国防生産法を発動した。これにより、こうした石油関連事業やパイプライン、エネルギー貯蔵の整備などに対し、財政的な優遇措置を講じることが可能になる。

item.title: Appeals court lifts block on Mississippi's DEI ban, ejects judge over AI errors
item.description: A federal appeals court on Thursday vacated a ruling that blocked Mississippi's ban on diversity, equity and inclusion programs in public schools, reassigning the case away from a district court judge who had acknowledged that a key ruling contained AI-generated errors.
item.dc:creator: Mike Scarcella, Nate Raymond
item.content:encoded: A federal appeals court on Thursday vacated a ruling that blocked Mississippi's ban on diversity, equity and inclusion programs in public schools, reassigning the case away from a district court judge who had acknowledged that a key ruling contained AI-generated errors. The New Orleans-based 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals threw out the preliminary injunction against the state law and reassigned the civil rights lawsuit to a different district judge for further review. The decision is a victory for Republican Mississippi Attorney General Lynn Fitch's office, which had argued that US District Judge Henry Wingate's apparent misuse of generative AI tools had compromised the integrity of the judicial process. US Circuit Judge Jerry Smith, writing for the three-judge panel, took Wingate to task for a "botch job" that led to a ruling that contained "sloppy edicts" and "several factual assertions nowhere to be found in the record" and got the law wrong. "The district court — or perhaps, being charitable, its AI agent — ignored and manipulated governing law, apparently to satisfy a policy agenda," Smith wrote. The appeals court laid out detailed instructions for how the new judge should assess the law, which it said only applies to educators and not students. It also stressed that states also have broad power to regulate their own curricula and publicly funded speech. Representatives for Fitch and the plaintiffs did not immediately respond to requests for comment, nor did Wingate’s office. Wingate and the judges on the appeals court panel are all Republican appointees. State and federal courts have grappled with a wave of AI-generated [USN:L6N42B15L TEXT:"inaccuracies in filings"]. The cases have led to mounting concerns about the technology's role in the legal process, including whether and how judges are using AI programs to help craft opinions. US courts do not have uniform rules about lawyers' use of AI, and the policies can [USN:L6N41A09S TEXT:"differ from one judge to another"] about their own use of the technology. The case before the 5th Circuit concerned a challenge by teachers, professors, students and advocacy groups to a law Republican-led Mississippi enacted last year that bars government-run educational institutions from mandating activities like diversity training or promoting DEI. The plaintiffs argued the law violated the US Constitution's First and Fourteenth Amendments, and convinced Wingate to issue a temporary restraining order blocking its implementation. But that order was later found to contain fabricated names and nonexistent legal authorities, prompting scrutiny from Republican Senator Chuck Grassley, the current chairman of the Senate Judiciary Committee. Wingate [USN:L1N3W40R4 TEXT:"in a subsequent letter"] told Grassley that the errors stemmed from a law clerk's unvetted use of the AI platform Perplexity. Even after the errors in that initial order, Wingate continued to block the law by issuing a preliminary injunction. Lawyers for Mississippi [USN:L6N44S0X9 TEXT:"argued on appeal"] that even after Wingate replaced the faulty ruling, the AI-related errors cast doubt on the court's core legal reasoning, and they urged the appeals court to reassign the case. Attorneys representing the teachers and civil rights advocates challenging the law had asked the appeals court to keep the case with Wingate, arguing that the AI use was a regrettable "shortcut" that did not affect the ultimate constitutionality of the state's DEI restrictions. But Smith said the case "easily calls for reassignment." He said given the number of errors in Wingate's ruling, the judge might be tempted in future proceedings to want to unjustly find a way "to prove that, even with the correct law and fact, that his initial view should prevail." The case is Jackson Federation of Teachers, et al, v Fitch, 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals, No. 25-60496. For the plaintiffs: Robert McDuff of Mississippi Center for Justice For the defendant: Anthony Shults of the Mississippi Attorney General's Office Read more: [USN:L6N44S0X9 TEXT:"Mississippi asks appeals court to reassign judge over 'error-plagued' AI-assisted ruling"] [USN:L6N43I17W TEXT:"US judge warns Justice Department about AI use in immigration case"] [USN:L6N43C0Z7 TEXT:"US appeals court rebukes lawyer over ‘fake and hallucinated’ case citations"] [USN:L6N42H0ZJ TEXT:"Judge rules both sides in lawsuit misused AI, disqualifies lawyers"] [USN:L6N4250GD TEXT:"Fallout grows for former law partner sanctioned over AI 'hallucination'"]

item.title: ＮＹ市場サマリー（22日）円が大幅高、Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落 利回り急低下
item.description: ＜為替＞ 円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ市場サマリー（22日）円が大幅高、Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落　利回り急低下 7:12 配信

写真はニューヨーク証券取引所の外にあるウォール街の道路標識。2021年7月、米ニューヨークで撮影。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

＜為替＞ 円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の将来の収益性に対する疑念を背景に、投資家が安全資産を求めた。

円は対ドルで０．７５％上昇し、１ドル＝１５６．９６円となった。

円相場の動きの一部は、重要な節目である１ドル＝１６０円に近づいていたことも背景にある可能性がある。この水準に近づくほど、日本当局が円を下支えするため再び介入する可能性が高まると見られている。

円やユーロなど主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．０８％低下し、１０１．６０。

ＮＹ外為市場：[USD/J]

＜債券＞ 国債利回りが短期債から長期債まで大幅に低下した。ＡＩ（人工知能）成長の持続性を巡る懸念が再燃し、株式相場が下落したことを受け、安全資産と見なされる国債に買いが入った。

終盤の取引で、１０年債利回りは１９．３ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）低下の４．９５３％。１日の低下幅としては２０２３年３月１０日以来の大きさとなる。１０年債利回りは１０月７日に５．３６４５％と、０２年４月以来の高水準を付けていた。

３０年債利回りは１５ｂｐ低下の５．２８７％。２４年８月以来の大幅な低下となる。

２年債利回りは１８．５ｂｐ低下の４．６３８％。２５年８月以来の大幅な低下となる。

米金融・債券市場：[US/BJ]

＜株式＞ Ｓ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が反落。ナスダックは１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。注目企業の決算発表が相次ぐ中、人工知能（ＡＩ）への投資競争を巡る懸念が再燃した。一方、ダウ工業株３０種は取引終了の数分前に小幅高に転じた。

フェイスブックの親会社メタ・プラットフォームズは、決算がアナリスト予想を上回ったものの、株価は７．０％下落した。ＡＩ関連支出により１０年以上ぶりにキャッシュフローがマイナスとなったほか、ＡＩ技術への投資資金を調達するため、１対２の株式分割で議決権のない株式を発行する計画を発表した。

電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーのテスラは３．１％安。四半期のフリーキャッシュフローが予想外のプラスとなり、２０２６年の設備投資計画を引き下げたものの、売られた。

半導体株が幅広く売られる中、インテル、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）、サンディスク、マーベル・テクノロジーはいずれも８％超下落した。

米国株式市場：[.NJP]

＜金先物＞ 原油価格の上昇によるインフレ懸念が強まり、金相場は２カ月超ぶりの安値となった。中心限月１２月物の清算値は前日比２．２％安の１オンス＝４０６０．４０ドル。スポット金は午後２時５分（米東部時間）時点で２．４％安の１オンス＝４０４１．３９ドルとなり、８月３日以来の安値を付けた。

ＮＹ貴金属：[GOL/XJ]

＜米原油先物＞ 北海ブレント先物が約４％上昇し、５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアでの攻撃を受け、主要なエネルギー輸出地域からの供給に一段の混乱が生じるとの懸念が強まった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が４．３５ドル（４．０％）高の１バレル＝１１３．１７ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．３２ドル（２．４％）高の９９．４７ドルだった。

ブレントは５月４日以来の高値で取引を終えた。テクニカル指標では、この１週間で３度目の買われ過ぎの状態となった。

ＮＹＭＥＸエネルギー：[CR/USJ]

item.title: Grupo Mexico to press ahead with major US copper projects after output dip
item.description: Grupo Mexico said on Thursday it will push ahead with major investments at its US mining unit Asarco, expanding the Ray and Silver Bell mines in Arizona and aiming to restart the Hayden smelter and refinery, after copper output fell in the third quarter.
item.dc:creator: Raul Cortes
item.content:encoded: Grupo Mexico (GMEXICOB.MX) said on Thursday it will push ahead with major investments at its US mining unit Asarco, expanding the Ray and Silver Bell mines in Arizona and aiming to restart the Hayden smelter and refinery, after copper output fell in the third quarter. The mining and transportation conglomerate expects to spend $4 billion to $6 billion over the next three years on Asarco's main projects, mining head Leonardo Contreras told analysts on a call. The investment would mark a significant step up from the unit's recent spending levels, which came in at just $101 million in 2024, though in line with what the firm had [USN:S0N3SX04G TEXT:"previously floated"] for potential US expansion plans. US EXPANSION PUSH Grupo Mexico has [USN:L1N3HQ26W TEXT:"long weighed kickstarting"] output from its US assets, particularly as Washington has prioritized domestic copper production and securing critical mineral supply chains. The plans come after Grupo Mexico reported that third-quarter [USN:L1N46616V TEXT:"copper output fell"] about 2%, hurt by lower production in the US and Peru. In September, Itau analysts said management intended to move ahead with Asarco investments despite uncertainty over possible US tariffs, while also evaluating opportunities to integrate Mexican concentrates and US copper scrap. Grupo Mexico shares closed down more than 4% on Thursday, making them among the weakest performers on the Mexican market, with copper prices also falling on the day. Contreras said Grupo Mexico is continuing work on the [USN:S0N3SX04V TEXT:"Ray expansion"] while carrying out feasibility studies. He added that the company is becoming "increasingly optimistic" about restarting Hayden with capacity to process 1.4 million metric tons of copper concentrate a year, restoring additional copper-processing capacity in the United States. "That would represent almost 350,000 metric tons of contained copper," Contreras said. "If that feeds into our refinery, we could be looking at 500,000 metric tons of copper." He said the Silver Bell project is also in the feasibility stage, with more clarity expected in coming quarters. PERU LONG-TERM FOCUS Even so, Grupo Mexico's long-term growth plans remain centered on Peru through subsidiary Southern Copper (SCCO.N) , despite a delay to its [USN:L6N43H166 TEXT:"flagship Tia Maria"] project. The company said this week that startup had been [USN:L1N4140GX TEXT:"pushed back"] from the fourth quarter of 2027 to the first half of 2028. Southern Copper is also developing the Los Chancas and Michiquillay projects in Peru, expected to produce 130,000 and 225,000 tons of copper a year, respectively. Both are currently scheduled to begin operating around 2032.

item.title: Whitehaven Coal's first-quarter output rises nearly 22%
item.description: Australia's Whitehaven Coal reported about a 22% rise in first-quarter output on Friday, driven by resilient production in its Queensland operations and volume recovery at its New South Wales mines.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Australia's Whitehaven Coal (WHC.AX) reported about a 22% rise in first-quarter output on Friday, driven by resilient production in its Queensland operations and volume recovery at its New South Wales mines. The country's top independent coal miner reported managed run-of-mine coal production of 11 million metric tons for the three months ended September 30, up from 9 million tons a year ago. That beat the Visible Alpha consensus estimate of 9.5 million tons. The company earned A$226 per metric ton of coal sold in the quarter, compared with an average of A$188 a ton last year. The temporary impact of sales slippages and elevated inventories is expected to unwind in the second quarter, Whitehaven said.

item.title: Deadly fire at Canada military base was caused by live grenade exercise, army says
item.description: A fast-moving grass fire that killed at least four soldiers at a western Canadian military base on Saturday was sparked by an exercise using live grenades, a senior defense official said on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: A fast-moving grass fire that killed at least four soldiers at a western Canadian military base on Saturday was sparked by an exercise using live grenades, a senior defense official said on Thursday. High winds then propelled the blaze across the army base in Wainwright, overwhelming dozens of soldiers. The incident was one of the worst peacetime tragedies for Canada's military. "The fire initiated on the automatic grenade launcher range ... (it) initiated as a result of routine military training that was happening on that range at the time," Brigadier-General Vanessa Hanrahan told reporters. Officials said 27 people remain hospitalized, several in critical condition. The soldiers and reserve members were preparing to deploy to Latvia, where Canadian forces have their largest international military operation.

item.title: QatarEnergy in talks with Venture Global to buy LNG in long term supply deal, sources say
item.description: QatarEnergy is in advanced talks with Venture Global for a long-term supply deal to buy at least 3 million metric tons of LNG per year, three people with knowledge of the negotiations told Reuters.
item.dc:creator: Curtis Williams, Marwa Rashad
item.content:encoded: QatarEnergy is in advanced talks with Venture Global (VG.N) for a long-term supply deal to buy at least 3 million metric tons of LNG per year, three people with knowledge of the negotiations told Reuters. QatarEnergy has been buying liquefied natural gas on the spot market from Venture Global to supply some of its customers due to the ongoing blockage of the Strait of Hormuz as the US-Israeli war on Iran and Tehran’s strikes this year have sharply curtailed shipping. Reuters could not immediately learn the timeline of any agreement between Venture Global and QatarEnergy, or how long a contract could run. Neither company immediately responded to requests for comment. Venture Global is the US supplier with the most uncommitted LNG capacity and could become the second largest exporter in the country when it starts producing from its CP2 plant currently under construction in Louisiana. An agreement could become the second major long-term deal that QatarEnergy signs with a US exporter this year. On Thursday, Cheniere (LNG.N) , the largest US exporter of liquefied natural gas, announced a long-term deal to supply QatarEnergy with 4 million metric tons per annum (mtpa) from 2031 to 2054. Two million metric tons per year will be sourced from Cheniere’s Sabine Pass facility in Louisiana, and another 2 mtpa will come from its Corpus Christi terminal in Texas.

item.title: Australia's Rio Tinto to invest $1.9 billion in Queensland bauxite project
item.description: Rio Tinto said on Friday it will invest $1.9 billion to develop the Kangwinan bauxite project in Queensland, Australia, replacing output from its ageing Andoom mine and lifting annual production capacity at its Weipa bauxite operations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Rio Tinto (RIO.AX) said on Friday it will invest $1.9 billion to develop the Kangwinan bauxite project in Queensland, Australia, replacing output from its ageing Andoom mine and lifting annual production capacity at its Weipa bauxite operations. The miner said the investment would add 20 million tonnes of annual bauxite production in Weipa, with first output targeted in 2029 and full production expected by 2032. Located in Queensland, Weipa is one of the world's largest bauxite mining complexes. It supplies the ore to make alumina and aluminium for applications ranging from construction and transportation to packaging and renewable energy infrastructure. Kangwinan will replace production from the Andoom mine near Weipa as it reaches the end of its life this decade, while increasing Weipa's annual production capacity to about 44 million tonnes from around 38 million tonnes currently. The development will also help offset the planned 2029 closure of Rio's Gove bauxite mine in the Northern Territory. The announcement follows Rio's [USN:L4N4500BL TEXT:"agreement last month"] to acquire the adjacent Aurukun Bauxite Project from Glencore (GLEN.L) and Mitsubishi, subject to regulatory approvals, as it seeks to extend long-term growth in the region. Rio said the combined Amrun, Kangwinan and Aurukun operations are expected to support its Weipa bauxite business well beyond the middle of the century.

item.title: UK financial regulators propose easing vetting rules for finance employees
item.description: Britain's financial regulators on Thursday proposed further easing of rules on vetting employees at finance firms, aiming to reduce regulatory burden and boost economic growth.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Britain's financial regulators on Thursday proposed further easing of rules on vetting employees at finance firms, aiming to reduce regulatory burden and boost economic growth. The Senior Managers and Certification Regime was introduced a decade ago, after the 2008 financial crisis, to hold senior decision-makers accountable in regulated finance firms The Financial Conduct Authority and the Bank of England's Prudential Regulation Authority are now proposing to scrap annual certification checks on about 139,000 employees below senior management level and replace regulatory approval with notification for senior roles Chief executives, finance chiefs and chairs would still need regulatory approval before taking up their posts, the regulators said, launching consultations on the proposals, with final policy expected in 2027 The Bank of England said the changes are expected to save firms around £2 billion ($2.68 billion) over a 10-year period The regulators had in April already [USN:S8N3YU021 TEXT:"eased"] some rules to streamline senior manager accountability, as part of a broader government-led push to cut red tape As part of the latest proposal, the regulators are also raising the threshold on reporting conduct rule breaches for most staff below senior manager level, saying it would let the firms better target more serious misconduct ($1 = 0.7467 pounds)

item.title: Getty Images says investor litigation helped push it to bankruptcy
item.description: Costly investor disputes helped accelerate Getty Images' fall into bankruptcy, its attorney said Thursday, with about $200 million in legal judgments weighing on the photo and image company's recent performance.
item.dc:creator: Dietrich Knauth
item.content:encoded: Costly investor disputes helped accelerate Getty Images' fall into bankruptcy, its attorney said Thursday, with about $200 million in legal judgments weighing on the photo and image company's recent performance. Bankruptcy attorney Brian Schartz said at a court hearing in Wilmington, Delaware, that the company could also face up to $275 million in future liabilities related to the investor disputes. Getty Images has spent another $35 million on legal fees to dispute the investor claims over the past four years, he added. Getty Images filed for [USN:L6N4670CJ TEXT:"bankruptcy"] on Wednesday with $1.46 billion in debt, citing the investor litigation, a failed merger with Shutterstock, and its high debt as reasons for the move. Despite having total revenue of $978 million over the past 12 months, Getty Images was down to just $20 million in cash at the time of its Chapter 11 filing, and had been hit with a large legal judgment over the summer it could not pay. "Thus far, defending those claims outside of bankruptcy court has not swung in the company's favor, and the company does not have the liquidity or time to engage in that type of challenge at this point," Schartz told US Bankruptcy Judge Kate Stickles, who is overseeing the company’s Chapter 11 case. Getty Images has been sued by several investors, who alleged that the company violated agreements that should have allowed them to acquire shares at $11.50 per share. Getty blocked investors from exercising warrants at a time when the share price briefly rose to $32, and it has lost two lawsuits over the warrants so far. Getty had argued that the warrants could not be exercised at that time because they were still awaiting approval from US securities regulators. Getty paid $110 million to two large investors in April, after losing a federal court case and an appeal. Getty recently lost another lawsuit that resulted in a $92 million judgment that it has not yet paid. The company sought to appeal that judgment, but it could not afford to post a bond that would have enabled it to put that judgment on hold while it appealed. Shareholders, who are set to have their equity stakes wiped out in bankruptcy, plan to seek a court-appointed equity committee to represent their interests in bankruptcy, Schartz said. In addition to the investor disputes, Getty also cited its [USN:L4N4321Q5 TEXT:"failed merger"] with Shutterstock, which the two companies abandoned earlier this year due to the UK competition regulator's requirement to sell Shutterstock's editorial business as a condition for approval. Getty Images entered bankruptcy with a restructuring agreement that would cancel existing equity and convert it into a private company that is 100% owned by affiliates of the Getty family and Koch Equity Development. The Getty family affiliates and Koch Equity Development have agreed to make a $533 million investment in the company, and the deal is supported by creditors who hold 90% of Getty Images’ debt, according to the company. The case is Getty Images Holdings Inc, US Bankruptcy Court for the District of Delaware, No. 26-11643 For Getty Images: Brian Schartz of Simpson Thacher & Bartlett LLP For an ad hoc group of equity holders: Robert Stark of Brown Rudnick LLP Read more: [USN:L4N4321Q5 TEXT:"Getty Images scraps $3.7 billion merger with Shutterstock over UK scrutiny"] [USN:L6N4670CJ TEXT:"Getty Images files for US bankruptcy, advances restructuring plan"]

item.title: US corporate profit boom faces its ‘Minsky moment’
item.description: Earnings for the S&P 500 Index rose 26% in the past year. Tech giants and chipmakers at the heart of the AI boom make up more than half the surge. Depreciation delays and investments in unlisted firms inflate bottom lines. As the economist Hyman Minsky wrote, it cannot last.
item.dc:creator: Edward Chancellor
item.content:encoded: The artificial intelligence generated by large language models is breathtaking. Equally wonderous is the financial alchemy that accompanies multi-trillion-dollar investments in AI infrastructure. Capital spending is instantaneously transformed into profits, even as the economic viability of the AI buildout remains questionable. The United States is in the throes of a great profit boom. Corporate profits had reached a record $4.7 trillion for the last twelve months by mid-year. That’s a 17% increase on the previous year’s figures. Tax breaks contained in President Donald Trump’s One Big Beautiful Bill Act have led to a sharp drop in corporate tax receipts. Washington’s enormous fiscal deficit – running at around 6% of GDP – provides an economy wide fillip to corporate bottom lines. When it comes to individual companies, however, the surge is all about AI. Earnings per share for members of the S&P 500 Index (.SPX) were up 26% in the twelve months to July: the long-run average annual growth rate is 7%. Expected earnings for the third quarter are 35% above estimates from a year ago. Gerard Minack of Minack Advisors lists 19 members of the S&P 500 that are heavily involved in the AI buildout: Big Tech “hyperscalers”, chipmakers and supply-chain companies such as fibre-optic provider Corning (GLW.N) . Since January 2025, these “AI-19 stocks” have seen forecast earnings rise by around $700 billion, 50% more than all the other companies in the US stock market benchmark. Analysts at Morgan Stanley predict that 42 leading companies exposed to AI will grow their earnings by 67% in 2026. The aggregate earnings growth of the other S&P 500 companies is projected at 23%. Put another way, these 42 stocks account for more than half of the earnings growth for the S&P 500 in the current year. Next year Morgan Stanley expects the basket of AI plays to contribute 78% of the S&P 500 earnings growth as AI investment in the United States rises to a forecast $1.6 trillion. “This is the probably the most earnings accretive capex boom in history,” says Jefferies strategist Christopher Wood. AI capital spending inflates profits because, as Minack points out, one company’s capex is another’s revenue. Profits emerge because the investing company does not expense all its costs at once, whereas the seller of capital equipment immediately books the full amount as revenue. Buyers of Nvidia’s (NVDA.O) graphics processing units depreciate their purchases on average over around 6 years, while the chip giant books a juicy upfront profit. What’s more, when the buyer is acquiring chips for a data centre that is under construction, the depreciation clock does not start ticking until the facility is up and running. Morgan Stanley estimates that as much as 40% of this year’s AI capex will become operational sometime between 2027 and 2029. The earnings mirage will not last indefinitely, though. By the end of the decade, the hyperscalers’ annual depreciation charges will range between $500 billion and $1 trillion, according to a recent report from Capital Gearing Asset Management. Investments in unlisted AI companies like OpenAI and Anthropic are also super-charging profits. Tech giants reflect changes in the private market value of these investments in their earnings statements as “other non-operating income.” In the four quarters leading up to mid-2026, the four major hyperscalers – Alphabet (GOOGL.O) , Amazon.com (AMZN.O) , Microsoft (MSFT.O) , and Meta Platforms (META.O) – saw annualized earnings increase by $222 billion while "other non-operating income" rose by $224 billion. In other words, the rising value of unlisted AI investments accounted for all the increase in their reported earnings. The fact that the AI buildout is increasingly financed with debt adds a further element of instability. The hyperscalers will plough almost all their operating cash flow into capex in the current financial year. These companies have issued around $225 billion of unsecured bonds so far this year, equivalent to around 30% of their full-year capital spending. They also have lease commitments for $1.1 trillion of AI equipment and services, which, since they haven’t yet commenced, are not reported on their balance sheets. Next year, Morgan Stanley analysts forecast the hyperscalers will have negative free cash flow of around $550 billion. “Access to credit markets and the ability to absorb higher interest rates are fundamental for hyperscalers and neoclouds to be able to deliver against our capex estimates,” says the Wall Street bank. That shouldn’t be too much of a problem for giants like Alphabet, Microsoft, Amazon and Meta which enjoy solid credit ratings because of their dominant positions in search, software, online retailing and social media. The economist Hyman Minsky applied the term “Ponzi finance” to businesses that do not generate sufficient cash flows to meet their outgoings. Loss-making data centre operators and AI frontier labs fit this description. Ponzi finance units, said Minsky, need rising valuations to raise additional capital. When valuations decline and the capital markets seize up, these shaky institutions collapse, causing losses to metastasise through the financial system. That is what happened in early 2000 after the credit markets lost confidence in the debt-fuelled buildout of the information superhighway. That investors are starting to question the viability of the AI investment splurge should come as no surprise. Productivity improvements from implementing the new technology remain elusive. Rogue AI agents are causing havoc. Models continue to hallucinate. Chinese AI companies are rapidly taking market share from the leading US AI labs. OpenAI has pushed back its planned IPO while upstart data centre operators such as [USN:L6N45V00W TEXT:"Firmus Technologies"] have shelved their stock offerings. Prospective investors in Anthropic are [USN:L6N46118I TEXT:"weighing a lower valuation"] for the AI company, Reuters reported citing four people familiar with the matter. CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , the largest neocloud, has seen its [USN:L6N46113K TEXT:"shares and bonds tumble"]. The shares of hyperscalers and chipmakers do not look expensive relative to earnings. That’s because the bubble is in profits, not valuations. US homebuilders were in the same position at the peak of the housing bubble in 2006, as were global miners when the commodity supercycle came to a sudden stop in the middle of the last decade. When the AI capex boom ends, earnings growth could revert to trend, says Minack. That moment may come sooner rather than later. Follow @Breakingviews on X

item.title: Five ways to keep safe online in the wake of AI-supercharged hacking
item.description: Much of the world woke Wednesday to news that PHP, a coding language most people have never heard of but that underlies roughly 70% of all websites, had a hackable vulnerability, sending businesses and governments scrambling to fix it.
item.dc:creator: A.J. Vicens
item.content:encoded: Much of the world woke Wednesday to news that PHP, a coding language most people have never heard of but that underlies roughly 70% of all websites, had a hackable vulnerability, sending businesses and governments [USN:FWN4661WD TEXT:"scrambling"] to fix it. While the PHP glitches sit in the underlying code itself, the NSA warned that attackers could use them to take control of web servers to steal data, disrupt services or move through networks on services the average person relies on every day. Experts say responsibility mostly lies with software providers and organizations that serve customers. But there are basic steps everyone should take to protect themselves. USE MULTI-FACTOR AUTHENTIFICATION MFA, or multi-factor authentication, requires two forms of verification to access a protected site, such as a password plus a text-based code or security key. Emily Austin, principal security researcher at cybersecurity firm Censys, recommended unique passwords for individual websites, and for people to monitor any transactions. “But realistically, for situations like the PHP vulnerabilities, there really isn’t much an end user can do beyond hope the services they rely on either don’t use PHP or have people actively working on patching,” Austin said. The PHP flaws are the latest in a series of severe software bugs made worse by increasingly capable and accessible large language models. Long-hidden flaws in widely used software, once too obscure or complex for humans to exploit, are now much easier to surface and weaponize . MAKE HARDWARE UPDATES AUTOMATIC Dan Guido, CEO and co-founder of cybersecurity firm Trail of Bits, recommended people “turn on automatic updates for your phone, computer, and home router.” Companies typically issue security updates when patches are available for known vulnerabilities, so installing them promptly limits the window for bad actors. Even so, consumers remain at the mercy of the services they rely on, Guido said. “Someone visiting a website can do everything right, like use two-factor authentication, and still have their information exposed,” Guido said. “You can't patch your hospital's website.” Most of the work falls on companies running services, Guido said. “They need to deploy fixes faster and limit the damage that compromised systems can cause.” Runa Sandvik, the founder of Granitt and a digital security expert, said people need to update apps and services on their devices whenever they're available, and to not forget about internet-connected devices around the house. "I can see a scenario in which some people have some sort of IoT device at home that maybe doesn't get frequent updates, maybe doesn't get any updates at all," Sandvik said. "It's worth double checking with the vendor to see if there is anything available." PATCH, PATCH, PATCH Dr. Daniel Gardham, a lecturer at the Surrey Centre for Cyber Security and the University of Surrey, said organizations must know what software they run, patch promptly and check whether they've already been compromised. In the AI age, attackers have the advantage, Gardham added. “Finding vulnerabilities is becoming faster and easier, but fixing them across the range of systems that rely on this software is much harder,” Gardham said. “How well organizations manage that gap will determine whether AI makes the internet safer or more vulnerable.” BEWARE OF SCAMMERS Any time a major cybersecurity threat makes the news, scammers and cybercriminals will try to take advantage, said Nic Adams, co-founder and CEO of 0rcus, a cyberkinetics company. Be wary of unsolicited links. "When these headlines hit, check the affected company's instructions by opening its app or typing its website address yourself," Adams said. "An urgent message telling you to 'secure your account' deserves extra scrutiny." YOUR MONEY IS SAFE Banks have been preparing for this moment since frontier models came out, and have "worked extremely hard to ensure there is no more low-hanging fruit for the bad guys to go after," said Paul Benda, executive vice president of risk, fraud and cybersecurity at the American Bankers Association. However, Benda added, "we are in a new normal" in terms of cyber threats, and consumers need to be aware, especially in the wake of the PHP vulnerabilities, when shopping with random retailers or websites "where their security is not going to be as good as your bank." Benda said consumers should not reuse passwords across shopping sites, and should consider using passkeys where possible, which are digital keys specific to certain websites, that avoid the need to enter a password into a website and a phishing resistant. (This story has been refiled to add the dropped words 'unsolicitated links', in paragraph 20.)

item.title: SK Hynix drops US IPO plan for Solidigm, newspaper reports
item.description: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix has decided not to pursue a US initial public offering of its subsidiary Solidigm, South Korean newspaper Korea Economic Daily reported on Friday, citing unnamed industry sources.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: South Korean chipmaker SK Hynix (000660.KS) has decided not to pursue a US initial public offering of its subsidiary Solidigm, South Korean newspaper Korea Economic Daily reported on Friday, citing unnamed industry sources. SK Hynix did not have an immediate response to a request for comment. The news comes weeks after SK Hynix said it was reviewing various options to strengthen Solidigm's competitiveness, but that no decisions had been made. Solidigm, based in Rancho Cordova, California, is the US-based NAND flash memory and solid-state drive subsidiary of South Korea's SK Hynix Inc.

item.title: Trump administration oversaw 980,000 deportations during first 18 months
item.description: The US Department of Homeland Security oversaw 980,000 deportations during the first 18 months of President Donald Trump's second term, according to a report published on Thursday in the Migration Policy Institute think tank.
item.dc:creator: Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: The US Department of Homeland Security oversaw 980,000 deportations during the first 18 months of President Donald Trump's second term, according to a report published on Thursday in the Migration Policy Institute think tank. Only 20% of all deportations in this period involved individuals with a criminal conviction, the report said. Of deportations of immigrants with two or more years of US residence, 71% were of people who did not have a criminal conviction, it added. The report was authored by Marc Rosenblum, a former head of the DHS Office of Homeland Security Statistics. On an annual basis, total deportations are up from the administration of former President Joe Biden and Trump's first term, but remained well below levels routinely observed in the early 2000s, the report said. Out of the 980,000 Immigration and Customs Enforcement and Customs and Border Protection deportations during Trump's second term, about 59%, or 580,000, were removals, 30%, or 300,000, were enforcement returns, and 11%, or 110,000, were administrative returns, the report said. Trump says his immigration crackdown and [USN:L4N3SN13Z TEXT:"deportation drive"] aim to improve domestic security. Rights advocates say the crackdown has violated due process and free speech rights and has created an unsafe environment, particularly for ethnic minorities, who have raised concerns about [USN:L4N3ZU0AN TEXT:"racial profiling"]. The State Department said on Tuesday the Trump administration has [USN:L1N46613L TEXT:"revoked over 300,000 US visas"] during his second term. Among visa revocations particularly condemned by rights advocates are those of pro-Palestinian protesters demonstrating against US ally [USN:L6N42U0SO TEXT:"Israel's assault on Gaza"] and of foreigners over [USN:L2N3VV14E TEXT:"social media comments"] about conservative commentator Charlie Kirk's assassination. The Trump administration's deportation attempts have faced multiple legal challenges with mixed results.

item.title: Venezuelanos se manifestam em todo o país para exigir eleições, no maior protesto contra o governo dos últimos anos
item.description: Milhares de venezuelanos saíram às ruas nesta quinta-feira, no primeiro protesto da oposição em nível nacional em quase dois anos, exigindo eleições livres e outras mudanças políticas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Milhares de venezuelanos saíram às ruas nesta quinta-feira, no primeiro protesto da oposição em nível nacional em quase dois anos, exigindo eleições livres e outras mudanças políticas. Os Estados Unidos têm trabalhado em estreita colaboração com o governo interino liderado pela presidente interina, Delcy Rodríguez, desde que suas forças capturaram Nicolás Maduro em janeiro. Tanto o presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, quanto Delcy Rodríguez afirmaram que haverá eleições, mas ainda não definiram uma data nem para as eleições legislativas nem para o processo presidencial. A líder da oposição e ganhadora do Prêmio Nobel da Paz, María Corina Machado, destacou que as eleições devem ocorrer antes de julho de 2027. Seu movimento, Vente Venezuela, organizou o protesto, que ocorreu em Caracas e se repetiu em cidades como Valência, Maracay, San Cristóbal e Maracaibo. “Vejo isso e fico feliz porque sei que é possível alcançar a mudança”, disse Leosmary Hernández, uma estudante de cosmetologia de 18 anos em Maracay, no Estado central de Aragua. Nos últimos anos, “passei por tantas coisas ruins, tantos problemas com o dólar, dificuldades para estudar. Tenho grandes expectativas para o meu país, pela nossa próxima governadora, a presidente María Corina”, acrescentou. O movimento socialista venezuelano — no poder desde 1999, primeiro sob o mandato de Hugo Chávez e, posteriormente, de Maduro — já recorreu, no passado, ao envio de forças de segurança contra manifestantes que denunciavam a repressão política, a inflação galopante e a deterioração dos serviços públicos, entre outros problemas. O governista Partido Socialista convocou seus simpatizantes a marchar da central Plaza Venezuela, em Caracas, até um ponto próximo ao palácio presidencial, com o objetivo de comemorar o mês da conscientização sobre o câncer de mama. O ministro do Interior, Diosdado Cabello, conhecido por seus laços estreitos com os serviços de segurança, apareceu na TV estatal participando da marcha. Os simpatizantes da oposição transferiram seu protesto para um local próximo. As negociações apoiadas pelos Estados Unidos entre uma facção da oposição e o governo interino, que buscam reestruturar a Suprema Corte de Justiça e o Conselho Nacional Eleitoral com o objetivo de garantir a equidade em futuras eleições, realizaram sua última sessão neste mês. No entanto, as mudanças podem levar bastante tempo. As negociações não incluem o movimento político de Machado, que afirmou que não impedirá seu andamento. Os manifestantes também exigiram a libertação de pessoas que, segundo afirmam, permanecem detidas por motivos políticos. A organização de direitos legais Foro Penal, que representa figuras da oposição e outros detidos — muitas vezes sob acusações como a de traição à pátria —, afirma que na Venezuela ainda há mais de 320 presos políticos, apesar das libertações ocorridas este ano no âmbito de uma lei de anistia apoiada pelo Poder Legislativo. O governo negou repetidamente que mantenha presos políticos e sustenta que a anistia é generosa.

item.title: Brazil's Bradesco meets profit estimates despite slower credit revenue
item.description: Brazilian lender Banco Bradesco on Thursday reported a 14.6% increase in its third-quarter recurring net profit from a year earlier, meeting analysts' expectations despite softer growth in credit-related revenue.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Brazilian lender Banco Bradesco (BBDC3.SA) on Thursday reported a 14.6% increase in its third-quarter recurring net profit from a year earlier, meeting analysts' expectations despite softer growth in credit-related revenue. Bradesco, which kicked off earnings season for large Brazilian lenders, posted a 7.11 billion reais ($1.41 billion) recurring net profit for the July-September quarter, compared with the 7.14 billion reais expected in a LSEG poll of analysts. CEO Marcelo Noronha said in a statement that Bradesco kept a cautious stance and a moderate appetite for risk amid a challenging macroeconomic environment in Brazil "We saw slower growth in our credit-related revenues, but this was offset by non-credit revenues and solid cost control," he wrote Return on average equity (ROAE) rose to 15.6% from 14.7% a year earlier; Bradesco said that, excluding its recent 10 billion-real capital increase, the ROAE would land at 16.1% The loan book grew 11.1% to 1.15 trillion reais, while the over-90-day delinquency ratio edged up to 4.6% from 4.1% Provisions for loan losses reached 10.6 billion reais, rising 24.3% year-over-year The lender kept its 2026 projections unchanged Bradesco also renewed its share buyback program, with the new program set to start in November spanning up to 106.6 million shares ($1 = 5.0428 reais)

item.title: The whimsical world of 'Wildwood' comes to life in Laika's most ambitious stop-motion film
item.description: What began as a visit to a forest on the outskirts of Portland blossomed into the magical world of the stop-motion film "Wildwood," Laika Studios' most ambitious project to date.
item.dc:creator: Danielle Broadway
item.content:encoded: What began as a visit to a forest on the outskirts of Portland blossomed into the magical world of the stop-motion film "Wildwood," Laika Studios' most ambitious project to date. "The beginning was this germ of an idea," said Colin Meloy, author of the 2011 novel of the same name on which the film is based. Meloy imagined Forest Park, a 5,200-acre wooded grassland in Portland, Oregon, as a "magical kingdom" surrounded by an impervious barrier. The idea led Meloy and his wife, Carson Ellis, who illustrated the novel, to map out the park's boundaries and populate it with mystical creatures and characters, creating the foundation of their fictional world. "Wildwood," which brings the story from page to picture and arrives in theaters on Friday, follows teenager Prue McKeel, voiced by Peyton Elizabeth Lee, as she ventures into the forest outside Portland after magical crows kidnap her younger brother. The voice cast also includes Jacob Tremblay as Prue's friend Curtis, Jake Johnson as Mr. McKeel, Prue's father, and Carey Mulligan as the film's antagonist, Alexandra. "It's really once in a generation they release a movie," Johnson said, referring to Laika. "When they come out, it means something. It's really special and truly unique," he added. Laika is known for its handcrafted stop-motion films, combining traditional animation techniques with 3D printing and digital effects. Its 2009 release "Coraline" remains the studio's highest-grossing film and a Halloween cult favorite. For director Travis Knight, "Wildwood" recalled the fantasy novels he loved growing up, including the works of JRR Tolkien and CS Lewis. He said the story also had a "weird idiosyncratic voice" that felt uniquely suited to Laika, a Portland-based studio, and to him as a Portland native. Bringing the story to life in stop-motion proved a major undertaking. The production used 231 puppets, 54 central hero characters, and 136 locations. Yet animating the puppets to feel lifelike posed an even greater challenge than staging the film's large-scale battle scenes. "There's a lot of stuff that we did with the puppet department to create breathers in the puppets and muscles," said animation supervisor Brad Schiff. "So, not only can the animator control them from the outside, but they're also controlling them from the inside, which makes them feel even more alive," he added.

item.title: GM cancels deal with new US rare-earth magnet plant, documents say
item.description: General Motors , the biggest customer of a US factory making rare earth magnets for electric vehicles, cancelled its long-term supply deal with the manufacturer, and the two sides are in arbitration, according to regulatory documents and a person with knowledge of the situation.
item.dc:creator: Eric Onstad
item.content:encoded: General Motors (GM.N) , the biggest customer of a US factory making rare earth magnets for electric vehicles, cancelled its long-term supply deal with the manufacturer, and the two sides are in arbitration, according to regulatory documents and a person with knowledge of the situation. The move spotlights the challenges Western firms face in building domestic rare-earths output and cutting their reliance on China, which produces about 90% of global permanent magnets. It also shows how the US auto industry's landscape has changed since Donald Trump returned to the White House in 2025 and cut federal support for electric vehicles. Germany's Vacuumschmelze, or VAC, signed a [USN:L8N34F3IX TEXT:"long-term deal"] in 2023 with GM to supply permanent magnets for its electric vehicles from a new plant in South Carolina. Energy Fuels (UUUU.A) , which agreed in June to pay $1.9 billion to [USN:L4N42V0QM TEXT:"acquire VAC"], said in US Securities and Exchange Commission documents filed last week that a customer of the plant terminated its supply agreement on July 1, and VAC launched arbitration proceedings against that customer several days later. It did not name the customer, but GM this week reported in an SEC filing that a supplier of a component for EV traction motors "initiated an arbitration against us seeking damages after we terminated a strategic sourcing agreement," without saying why it cancelled the deal. The person familiar with the matter confirmed GM was the customer that cancelled the contract with VAC's US unit, e-VAC Magnetics. GM and Energy Fuels declined to comment on the arbitration because it is confidential. The dispute has not been previously reported and none of the companies involved have issued press releases about the issue. VAC launched its $500-million US magnet plant late last year with a capacity of just under 2,000 metric tons a year, and 90% was set to be sold to GM, with the remainder supplying the US government, VAC CEO Erik Eschen [USN:L5N3UY0MF TEXT:"told Reuters"] in September last year. VAC's US unit said it was seeking damages in arbitration due to wrongful termination. "We have no concerns about VAC’s commercial success and its ability to produce rare earth permanent magnets to customer specifications," Energy Fuels said. However, Energy Fuels told Reuters there may be "potential adjustments to our purchase price of VAC depending on the outcome of the arbitration." GM ROLLS BACK EV SALES GM has been pulling back on sales of EVs, which historically have lost money, following the Trump administration’s withdrawal of incentives and tax breaks meant to benefit the industry. In January, GM took a [USN:L6N3Y915L TEXT:"$6 billion charge"] to unwind some EV investments. When GM and VAC announced the supply deal three years ago, VAC said the plant would support GM for a minimum of 10 years and supply a wide range of models. The dispute first arose in April 2026, according to the SEC documents. Energy Fuels said it was aware of the dispute when it was negotiating the VAC acquisition. Energy Fuels, a producer of uranium for the nuclear power industry, said the takeover would allow it to become one of the world's largest non-Chinese producers of magnets used in the aerospace, defence and renewable energy sectors. VAC supplies magnets to more than 1,000 customers, from facilities in Germany, Malaysia and other countries.

item.title: Venezolanos marchan en todo el país para exigir elecciones, en mayor protesta antigubernametal en años
item.description: Miles de venezolanos salieron a las calles el jueves en la primera protesta de la oposición a nivel nacional en casi dos años, mientras los manifestantes exigían elecciones libres y otros cambios políticos con una presencia notablemente escasa de las fuerzas de seguridad.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Miles de venezolanos salieron a las calles el jueves en la primera protesta de la oposición a nivel nacional en casi dos años, mientras los manifestantes exigían elecciones libres y otros cambios políticos con una presencia notablemente escasa de las fuerzas de seguridad. Estados Unidos ha trabajado estrechamente con el gobierno interino encabezado por la presidenta encargada Delcy Rodríguez, desde que sus fuerzas capturaron en enero a Nicolás Maduro. Tanto el presidente de Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, como Rodríguez han afirmado que habrá elecciones, pero aún no han fijado una fecha ni para los comicios legislativos ni para el proceso presidencial. La líder opositora y ganadora del Premio Nobel de la Paz, María Corina Machado, ha señalado que los comicios deben celebrarse antes de julio de 2027. Su movimiento Vente Venezuela organizó la protesta, que tuvo lugar en Caracas y se replicó en ciudades como Valencia, Maracay, San Cristóbal y Maracaibo. "Veo esto y me siento feliz porque yo sé que se puede lograr el cambio", dijo Leosmary Hernández, una estudiante de cosmetología de 18 años en Maracay, en el estado central de Aragua. En los últimos años "he pasado tantas cosas malas, tantos problemas con el dólar, dificultades para estudiar. Tengo unas grandes expectativas para mi país, por nuestra próxima gobernadora, presidenta María Corina", agregó. El movimiento socialista venezolano —en el poder desde 1999, primero bajo el mandato de Hugo Chávez y posteriormente de Maduro— ha recurrido en el pasado al despliegue de fuerzas de seguridad contra manifestantes que denunciaban la represión política, una inflación galopante, el deterioro de los servicios públicos, entre otros problemas. El gobernante Partido Socialista convocó a sus simpatizantes a marchar desde la céntrica Plaza Venezuela de Caracas hacia un punto cercano al palacio presidencial, con el fin de conmemorar el mes de la concienciación sobre el cáncer de mama. El ministro del Interior, Diosdado Cabello, conocido por sus estrechos vínculos con los servicios de seguridad, apareció en la TV estatal participando en la marcha. Los simpatizantes de la oposición trasladaron su protesta a un lugar cercano. Rodríguez envió un mensaje a los participantes de la manifestación a través de una llamada divulgada por la televisora estatal. Las conversaciones respaldadas por Estados Unidos entre una facción de la oposición y el gobierno interino, que buscan reestructurar el Tribunal Supremo de Justicia y el Consejo Nacional Electoral con el fin de garantizar la equidad en futuras elecciones, celebraron su última sesión este mes. Sin embargo, los cambios podrían llevar bastante tiempo. Rodríguez tenía previsto reunirse en el palacio de gobierno con Dinorah Figuera, la jefa de la delegación opositora en las conversaciones apoyadas por Washington, según imágenes de la televisora estatal mostrando la llegada de Figuera a la sede oficial. Las negociaciones no incluyen al movimiento político de Machado, quien ha manifestado que no obstaculizará su avance. "Queremos elecciones presidenciales ya, que se haga un cronograma ya. No vamos a esperar hasta 2028", dijo María Débora Marín, de 57 años, quien regenta una tienda de ropa en el centro de la ciudad de Valencia, a unos 150 kilómetros al sur de Caracas, al referirse a versiones de que las elecciones podrían celebrarse recién dentro de dos años. "Lo que queremos es avanzar, salir ya de esta pesadilla", agregó. En estos momentos "estamos en un limbo", comentó Rayeska Puesme, de 18 años y recién graduada, mientras participaba en la protesta en Caracas, añadiendo que ha considerado marcharse de Venezuela debido a la falta de oportunidades. "Estados Unidos saco un gran problema, que fue Maduro, pero falta el resto", añadió. "Siento en mi corazón que las cosas van a cambiar, pero no veo cuándo", dijo. Los manifestantes también exigieron la liberación de personas que, según afirman, permanecen detenidas por motivos políticos. La organización de derechos legales Foro Penal, que representa a figuras de la oposición y a otros detenidos —a menudo bajo cargos como el de traición a la patria-, afirma que en Venezuela todavía hay más de 320 presos políticos, a pesar de las liberaciones que tuvieron lugar este año en el marco de una ley de amnistía respaldada por el poder legislativo. El gobierno ha negado reiteradamente que mantenga a presos políticos y sostiene que la amnistía es generosa.

item.title: Tesouro dos EUA retira Venezuela da lista de países sujeitos a restrições aos investimentos dos EUA no exterior
item.description: O Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA anunciou nesta quinta-feira uma proposta de regulamentação para a análise de investimentos no exterior na China, na Rússia e em outros países — uma lista que não inclui mais a Venezuela, agora que o ex-presidente do país Nicolás Maduro não está mais no poder.
item.dc:creator: Andrea Shalal
item.content:encoded: O Departamento do Tesouro dos EUA anunciou nesta quinta-feira uma proposta de regulamentação para a análise de investimentos no exterior na China, na Rússia e em outros países — uma lista que não inclui mais a Venezuela, agora que o ex-presidente do país Nicolás Maduro não está mais no poder. O Tesouro aceitará comentários até 7 de dezembro sobre as regras propostas, que foram determinadas pela Lei Abrangente de Segurança Nacional para Investimentos no Exterior de 2025 (COINS Act), aprovada pelo Congresso em dezembro, mas que surgiu de um esforço bipartidário iniciado pelo ex-presidente Joe Biden em 2023. A Lei COINS marcou uma expansão significativa dos controles sobre os investimentos externos dos EUA, exigindo que empresas e indivíduos norte-americanos notifiquem o Tesouro sobre certos planos de investimento, ao mesmo tempo em que os proíbe totalmente em outros casos para evitar danos à segurança nacional dos EUA. Ela ampliou a lista de países abrangidos e incluiu a biotecnologia como um dos setores restritos, conferindo ao Tesouro a autoridade para adicionar outros setores conforme necessário. O programa de investimentos no exterior tinha inicialmente como alvo apenas a China, mas a legislação COINS ampliou a lista de países “motivos de preocupação” para incluir Cuba, Irã, Coreia do Norte, Rússia e Venezuela “sob o regime de Nicolás Maduro”. Mas o Tesouro afirmou que retirou a Venezuela da lista, uma vez que o governo Maduro “não existe mais” após a captura do ex-presidente por forças norte-americanas em janeiro, acrescentando que o atual governo, liderado pela vice de Maduro, Delcy Rodríguez, não se enquadrava na definição. A regra proposta ainda poderia se aplicar a certos investimentos em entidades venezuelanas, afirmou o Tesouro, sem dar mais detalhes. O presidente Donald Trump recebeu o presidente chinês Xi Jinping para uma luxuosa visita de Estado a Washington no mês passado e tem adotado uma abordagem menos restritiva em relação às tecnologias chinesas em seu segundo mandato, mas a divulgação, nesta quinta-feira, das regras propostas pode sinalizar um desejo de manter alguma pressão sobre as ambições tecnológicas de Pequim. “A ideia por trás do programa de investimentos no exterior é garantir que tenhamos a capacidade de monitorar e, potencialmente, proibir os tipos de investimentos” que representam riscos à segurança nacional dos EUA, disse à Reuters o secretário-adjunto do Tesouro, Chris Pilkerton, responsável por questões de segurança de investimentos. “Não se trata apenas do investimento em si; não se trata apenas do dinheiro. Trata-se da rede, da cadeia de suprimentos e de aspectos como esses que decorrem desse investimento”, disse ele, acrescentando que uma teia tão complexa de relações seria difícil de regulamentar de outra forma, por meio de controles de exportação ou outras medidas. O Tesouro afirmou que as regras propostas não proibiriam todos os investimentos em países que suscitam preocupação. Em vez disso, elas visariam investimentos específicos em entidades envolvidas em tecnologias de dupla utilização que beneficiem programas militares, Estados de vigilância e países com violações dos direitos humanos. As regras propostas exigem notificação sobre investimentos potenciais em seis setores e cinco países designados, ao mesmo tempo em que os proíbem totalmente no caso da inteligência artificial.

item.title: Banco brasileño Bradesco registra un beneficio recurrente en línea con previsiones en tercer trimestre
