item.title: Paciente com Ebola na Nigéria teria contraído a doença em Uganda, diz Suíça
item.description: A paciente com Ebola na Nigéria, esposa de um diplomata suíço lotado em Abuja e nascida em Uganda, provavelmente contraiu a doença durante uma viagem a Uganda, afirmou comunicado do governo suíço à Reuters divulgado nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Clement Bonnerot, Anait Miridzhanian, Robbie Corey-Boulet
item.content:encoded: A paciente com Ebola na Nigéria, esposa de um diplomata suíço lotado em Abuja e nascida em Uganda, provavelmente contraiu a doença durante uma viagem a Uganda, afirmou comunicado do governo suíço à Reuters divulgado nesta quinta-feira. A Nigéria notificou o caso -- o primeiro de Ebola no país em mais de uma década -- na terça-feira, tornando-se o quarto país africano e o mais populoso a ser afetado por um surto anunciado na República Democrática do Congo em meados de maio e que, desde então, se tornou o de propagação mais rápida já registrado. Autoridades ugandenses afirmaram que a mulher, que adoeceu na Nigéria, havia viajado para o leste do Congo antes de passar por Uganda. Mas a Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS) e a principal agência de saúde da África disseram nesta quinta-feira que não haviam recebido informações confirmadas de que a mulher tivesse viajado para o Congo. Comunicado enviado por email pelo Departamento Federal Suíço de Relações Exteriores informou que a mulher “está internada em uma clínica particular em Abuja há cerca de uma semana com sintomas". "Acredita-se que ela tenha contraído o vírus durante uma viagem a Uganda há cerca de duas semanas”, acrescentou. “Seu marido está em isolamento; ele não apresentou nenhum sintoma. Ele estava viajando com a esposa quando se acredita que ela tenha contraído o Ebola.” Uganda registrou 20 casos em maio e junho, a maioria importada do Congo, mas a Organização Mundial da Saúde (OMS) declarou o país livre do Ebola em agosto. Um porta-voz do governo de Uganda não respondeu imediatamente a um pedido de comentário nesta quinta-feira. Wessam Mankoula, funcionário do Centro Africano de Controle e Prevenção de Doenças (Africa CDC), afirmou nesta quinta-feira que Nigéria e Uganda estavam compartilhando informações para apurar os deslocamentos da paciente e a possível fonte de exposição. “Até o momento, não há informações comprovadas de que essa paciente tenha viajado para a RDC (República Democrática do Congo)”, disse Mankoula em uma coletiva de imprensa online. A OMS afirmou que as informações que recebeu sobre o caso não incluíam viagens para fora de Uganda.

item.title: El Niño rains batter Latin America from Mexico to Chile
item.description: An intensifying El Niño-linked storm season this week brought flooding to Paraguay, killed two farm workers in Argentina's cattle belt and damaged coastal communities in Peru and Mexico.
item.dc:creator: Cesar Olmedo
item.content:encoded: An intensifying El Niño-linked storm season this week brought flooding to Paraguay, killed two farm workers in Argentina's cattle belt and damaged coastal communities in Peru and Mexico. Part of a luxury condominium complex on Mexico’s Pacific coast in the tourist town of San Pancho in Nayarit State collapsed on Wednesday after pounding surf ate away the sand beneath it, exposing its foundation and leaving the structure tilted dramatically toward the sea. In Paraguay, two dozen families took refuge late on Wednesday at a church near Paraguay's border with Brazil after their homes flooded and more residents anxiously watched the swelling [USN:L4N2QW4DD TEXT:"Parana"], South America's second-largest river, as rains battered the region. UN officials [USN:L6N4670T1 TEXT:"warned"] this week that the El Niño weather pattern could drive a record increase in Pacific Ocean temperatures as it moves around the globe like a "wrecking ball," triggering floods in some regions and droughts in others. In Paraguay, the rising Parana River, a key commercial waterway, has affected about 4,200 families, according to the country's national emergency agency. A 58-year-old woman died after her home collapsed in the rains. At the church now doubling as a shelter, in Paraguay's Ciudad del Este, dozens of residents pitched tents on a soccer field while others organized communal kitchens with support from the church and local businesses. In San Rafael, a riverside town, Antonina Sánchez, 65, recounted how she had to flee. "I was surprised because the water came very quickly. My house, my entire kitchen collapsed; it's caving in," she said. The World Meteorological Organization has predicted temperatures in the central Pacific will rise about 3.8 degrees Celsius above average between November and January, peaking around December, causing one of the most turbulent storm seasons on record. RAIN, HAIL, MUD AND EROSION Elsewhere in Latin America this week, two farm workers died near Bella Vista in Argentina's Corrientes province while moving cattle away from flooded areas near the Parana, local media reported. Hundreds of residents have been evacuated across the province, though above-average rainfall in parts of the Pampas agricultural belt could [USN:L6N42J17M TEXT:"benefit crops"]. In Chile's capital Santiago, a flooded stream triggered a mudslide on October 8 onto city streets, and days later, a storm blanketed roads with hail and flooded streets. In Peru, authorities on Thursday announced [USN:L1N4680UE TEXT:"financial aid"] and tax relief for businesses affected by extreme weather battering the country's Pacific coast. The government plans to allocate 18 billion soles ($5.22 billion) in 2027 towards mitigating the economic impact.

item.title: Trump pede a Musk que suspenda as restrições à Starlink na Ucrânia, diz WSJ
item.description: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ligou para Elon Musk e pediu que ele suspenda as restrições ao uso da Starlink pela Ucrânia, informou o Wall Street Journal nesta quinta-feira, citando autoridades norte-americanas.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O presidente dos Estados Unidos, Donald Trump, ligou para Elon Musk e pediu que ele suspenda as restrições ao uso da Starlink pela Ucrânia, informou o Wall Street Journal nesta quinta-feira, citando autoridades norte-americanas. O sistema Starlink estava funcionando de maneira mais normal nesta quinta-feira, logo após a conversa entre Trump e Musk, segundo autoridades norte-americanas e ucranianas citadas pelo Journal. Algumas autoridades ucranianas disseram ao jornal que o sistema não havia recuperado sua funcionalidade total, mas estava operando em velocidades mais altas do que aquelas limitadas anteriormente. O presidente Volodymyr Zelenskiy havia dito na manhã desta quinta-feira que a velocidade do Starlink ainda não havia sido restaurada para a Ucrânia, acrescentando que esperava manter conversas com o secretário de Estado dos EUA, Marco Rubio, nos próximos dias. Trump disse a Musk que estava frustrado porque as velocidades do sistema continuavam limitadas a cerca de 160 km/h, informou o Journal, citando autoridades. Rubio disse na quarta-feira que as decisões relativas ao acesso da Ucrânia à Starlink cabiam à empresa controladora SpaceX e ao seu presidente-executivo, Musk, e não à Casa Branca. A Ucrânia utiliza a Starlink para comunicações no campo de batalha e operações com drones. A restrição ao serviço de satélite prejudicou as missões de ataque e de defesa aérea com drones do país contra a Rússia.

item.title: SpaceX says potential Tesla merger would need Elon Musk's approval
item.description: SpaceX said on Thursday its potential merger with Tesla will require controlling investor Elon Musk's approval, even though the entrepreneur has recused himself from talks between his two companies because of conflicts of interest.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: SpaceX (SPCX.O) said on Thursday its potential merger with Tesla (TSLA.O) will require controlling investor Elon Musk's approval, even though the entrepreneur has recused himself from talks between his two companies because of conflicts of interest. Musk, the world's richest person, said on Tuesday [USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"a merger of SpaceX and Tesla would be "a good idea""] and that they had formed special committees to discuss a union. In a regulatory filing on Thursday, SpaceX said, "No determination by our special committee has been made regarding any potential combination, and any potential combination would be subject to further approval by our special committee, our board of directors and our controlling shareholder." Several Wall Street analysts have said they see a Tesla-SpaceX merger as a matter of when, not if, but disagree on how much Tesla shareholders should receive in a deal. Musk's public endorsement this week of the potential $3.5 trillion merger has also rattled some insiders involved in the discussions, who worry his comments could invite shareholder scrutiny and delay the process by several weeks, [USN:L6N46716H TEXT:"Reuters reported"] earlier on Thursday. Musk owns nearly a fifth of Tesla and holds voting control at SpaceX. Analysts have said a merger would give him control of the combined entity and could consolidate his influence. The disclosure created a "mess" for the process, as it could lead to questions about how well Tesla shareholders' interests would be represented, a person with direct knowledge of the talks told Reuters. Bringing the companies together [USN:L1N46701K TEXT:"could also simplify decision-making"], as multiple companies require approvals from separate boards and shareholders. The potential merger could give management the flexibility to allocate capital, engineering talent and infrastructure toward more promising projects as firms aggressively push into AI. Tesla on Wednesday cut its annual [USN:L4N4671SD TEXT:"capital expenditure forecast to roughly $20 billion"], down from its previous forecast of more than $25 billion. SpaceX [USN:L4N4661M0 TEXT:"expects $35 billion to $40 billion"] in capital expenditure in the fourth quarter. SpaceX is a major contractor for the US military, intelligence agencies and NASA. Tesla, meanwhile, remains deeply tied to China through its Shanghai factory, which plays a major role in vehicle production and sales. Shares of SpaceX rose about 1%, while those of Tesla fell marginally in extended trading.

item.title: ルビオ米長官、カタールの仲介努力に謝意 首相と電話会談＝国務省
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日　ロイター] - ルビオ米国務長官は、カタールのムハンマド首相兼外相と電話会談し、中東紛争の調停に向けたカタールの継続的な取り組みに謝意を示した。米国務省が２２日、明らかにした。

同省は声明で、ルビオ氏がカタールの安全保障とホルムズ海峡の航行の自由に対する米国のコミットメントを改めて示したと説明した。

item.title: Peso mexicano cae tras datos locales de inflación, bolsa se repliega
item.description: El peso mexicano retrocedió el jueves arrastrado por un débil entorno para los activos de riesgo ante persistentes tensiones en Medio Oriente y después de conocerse que la inflación local se aceleró en la primera quincena de octubre más de lo esperado.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El peso mexicano retrocedió el jueves arrastrado por un débil entorno para los activos de riesgo ante persistentes tensiones en [USN:L6N4680XU TEXT:"Medio Oriente"] y después de conocerse que la [USN:L1N4680NW TEXT:"inflación local"] se aceleró en la primera quincena de octubre más de lo esperado. Los datos redujeron las apuestas a que Banco de México podría recortar su tasa clave, coincidieron analistas. El mercado, sin embargo, mantiene las expectativas de una pausa monetaria prolongada, incluso si la Reserva Federal vuelve a elevar los tipos de interés. * La moneda local cotizaba en 18.7110 unidades por dólar en la recta final de los negocios, con una depreciación de un 0.22%, también golpeada por renovadas preocupaciones sobre el suministro global de [USN:L1N46812A TEXT:"petróleo"] ante un recrudecimiento de la violencia en Arabia Saudita. * Antes de conocerse la inflación local, el peso llegó a debilitarse hasta 18.8550 por dólar, un nivel no visto desde septiembre de 2025, pero luego moderó las pérdidas, ya que el repunte de los precios al consumidor complicó las perspectivas de un recorte a la tasa de interés referencial. * La posibilidad de una rebaja de tasas había cobrado fuerza después de que la minuta de la última reunión del banco central reveló que tres de los cinco miembros de la [USN:L1N45U0OW TEXT:"Junta de Gobierno"] se mostraron abiertos a una mayor flexibilización monetaria si ceden las presiones inflacionarias. * El mercado, no obstante, mantiene vigentes las previsiones de que [USN:L6N45G177 TEXT:"Banco de México"] dejaría los tipos de interés sin cambios hasta finales de 2027, aun cuando la [USN:L1N4580T6 TEXT:"Reserva Federal"] podría volver a elevarlos a finales de este año, después de su alza de septiembre. * "Las perspectivas actuales de inflación y las presiones externas deberían llevar al Banxico a mantener su postura sin cambios en el futuro previsible", dijo Barclays. * La plaza accionaria también registró una jornada negativa presionada por un ajuste de posiciones después de cinco sesiones continuas de ganancias, que la llevaron a alcanzar el miércoles su mayor nivel de cierre [USN:L1N467010 TEXT:"desde abril"]. * El referencial índice S&P/BMV IPC (.MXX) cedió un 0.51% a 69,889.73 puntos, mientras los inversionistas vigilan de cerca los reportes corporativos locales del tercer trimestre. * Los títulos de Gentera (GENTERA.MX) , especializada en microcréditos, encabezaron las bajas, con un 6.32% menos a 37.81 pesos, su mayor descalabro diario desde junio de 2024. * Analistas dijeron que si bien la compañía divulgó cifras trimestrales mejores a lo estimado, un [USN:L1N4680SF TEXT:"incremento de la morosidad"] alimentó preocupaciones sobre la calidad de sus activos. * Las acciones mineras también cayeron, siguiendo un descenso de los [USN:L1N4680Z3 TEXT:"precios de los metales"]. Grupo México (GMEXICOB.MX) perdió un 4.34% a 231.36 pesos, mientras que Industrias Peñoles (PEOLES.MX) retrocedió un 3.50% a 856.33 pesos. * Durante su [USN:L1N468173 TEXT:"llamada con analistas"], ejecutivos de Grupo México dijeron que se prevén inversiones de capital por hasta 6,000 millones de dólares en los principales proyectos de su unidad estadounidense Asarco durante los próximos tres años. * En el mercado secundario de deuda, el rendimiento del bono gubernamental a 10 años descendió dos puntos base a un 9.26%, mientras que la tasa a 20 años subió uno, a un 9.75%.

item.title: When should a judge's social life be grounds for a do-over?
item.description: A group of lawyers and retired judges are warning that the social lives of US magistrate and bankruptcy judges could be unfairly picked apart by losing litigants seeking a do-over, as a federal appeals court grapples with how much judges must reveal about their friendships with the lawyers who appear before them.
item.dc:creator: Jenna Greene
item.content:encoded: A group of lawyers and retired judges are warning that the social lives of US magistrate and bankruptcy judges could be unfairly picked apart by losing litigants seeking a do-over, as a federal appeals court grapples with how much judges must reveal about their friendships with the lawyers who appear before them. Arising from a contract dispute over a ship canal in Lake Charles, Louisiana, [USN:L1N4500V6 TEXT:"the case"] hinges on undisclosed social ties between a now-retired magistrate judge and a lawyer whose client she awarded $125 million. The 5th US Circuit Court of Appeals on Thursday withdrew an opinion it issued last month that wiped out the award. The New Orleans-based court granted a rare rehearing and said a new opinion would be issued, but gave no hint if the outcome would change. No additional briefing or oral argument was requested. The sharply divided panel ruled 2-1 in September that US Magistrate Judge Kathleen Kay should have revealed more up front about her longstanding ties with the lawyer, including that he was a groomsman in her wedding 30 years ago. Because she did not fully disclose the relationship, the panel held that the Port of Lake Charles could withdraw its consent for her to decide the case – even though it sought to do so only after losing a 20-day bench trial. Kay did not respond to a request for comment, nor did the Port or its outside counsel, Michael Rubin of Adams & Reese. Lawyers for the Port’s opponent, terminal operator IFG Port Holdings, which saw its $125 million win stripped away, argue that the decision invites copycat moves, creating a “roadmap for invalidating countless final judgments.” Disappointed litigants now need only “proffer ignorance of a potential conflict — no matter how unjustified — to obtain a second bite at the apple,” IFG’s lawyers from Latham & Watkins argued in urging the court to reconsider the case. “It’s an issue of exceptional importance,” Latham partner Gregory Garre said. The plaintiffs are backed by six retired judges, who in an amicus brief filed Tuesday warned that the new standard would prove unworkable in practice, especially in smaller legal communities like Lake Charles, where professional and social ties among members of the bar are plentiful. Inevitably, a judge “may fail to disclose a tangential connection that losing parties then seize on,” judges W. Royal Furgeson, Jr, Mildred Methvin, Brian Owsley, Viktor Pohorelsky, Stephen Wm. Smith and Judith Fitzgerald wrote. EXTRAORDINARY CIRCUMSTANCES? There are about 600 magistrate judges and 300 bankruptcy judges nationwide — more than the number of federal district and circuit judges combined, and they play an essential role in managing the federal docket. Unlike Senate-confirmed Article III judges who are appointed for life by the US president, magistrate and bankruptcy judges are chosen via a merit-based hiring process and serve a set term. Magistrates handle much of a court’s pretrial work, while bankruptcy judges oversee cases ranging from individual debtors to complex restructurings. Their authority has limits. In some cases, the judges can only decide disputes with the parties' knowing and voluntary consent. However, once that permission is given, Congress by statute has said it may only be withdrawn “under extraordinary circumstances.” What exactly this means is key to the Fifth Circuit case. The litigation, which concerned dredging a ship canal at the industrial port, began in 2016. When the parties agreed to a bench trial before Kay, she disclosed at the outset that IFG’s lead counsel William Monk’s daughter, Margaret, was her law clerk and would be screened from the matter. Monk did not respond to a request for comment. After Kay ruled against the port in 2020 in a sharply worded, 64-page opinion, two wives of lawyers on the losing side did some social media sleuthing. Or, as Judge Andrew Oldham put it in his dissent, “Facebook-stalking.” They found photos of Kay’s wedding in 1989 that showed Monk as a groomsman, and posts of Kay officiating the wedding of Monk’s other daughter, Lucie, in 2015. “If the Port had knowledge of the full extent of the relationship between the Magistrate Judge and Plaintiff's counsel, it would not have consented to the referral,” lawyers for the Port wrote in a bare-bones motion in 2020 asking that the case be taken away from Kay and her decision vacated. After an initial review by the Fifth Circuit in 2023, the matter was remanded to Judge Michael Truncale in Beaumont, Texas (the entire Western District of Louisiana was recused) to [USN:L1N3AX2H4 TEXT:"conduct an inquiry"] into the friendship. Truncale cataloged casual social interactions between Kay and Monk spanning decades, from playing Trivial Pursuit together in the 1980s to attending the same annual Christmas party to sitting together at a fundraising dinner. Kay and Monk's wife were childhood acquaintances, and the couples' sons were also friends. While Kay testified that she did not consider Monk to be a friend of hers, just a friend of her husband’s, Truncale found the “existence of a close, family friendship spanning nearly forty years.” IFG’s lawyers question whether the port was truly unaware of the bond. For example, the Port’s general counsel “liked” Kay’s Facebook post that included the photo of Monk as a groomsman. Moreover, Port lawyer Rick Norman of Taylor Porter and his wife attended the wedding of Kay’s daughter in 2017 — and allegedly walked into the ceremony with fellow invitees the Monks. The Fifth Circuit majority held that evidence suggesting the Port was aware Kay and Monk were socially acquainted was not enough. Rather, a party must "actually know the nature and extent" of any potential conflict in order to consent to proceed before a magistrate judge. A litigant's “constructive knowledge” — information it should have inferred from the circumstances or could have discovered through reasonable diligence — is not sufficient, the panel held. The appeals court could strengthen its findings or rethink them as it rehears the case. Its decision could clarify where judges should draw the line between ordinary social relationships and connections that must be disclosed to litigants, lest the losing side seize on the ties to unravel a case.

item.title: James Hoye named umpiring crew chief for Rays-Brewers World Series
item.description: Veteran umpire James Hoye was named crew chief for the 2026 World Series between the Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers, Major League Baseball announced on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Veteran umpire James Hoye was named crew chief for the 2026 World Series between the Tampa Bay Rays and Milwaukee Brewers, Major League Baseball announced on Thursday. Hoye, 55, will be an umpire in the World Series for the third time and this will be his first Fall Classic as a crew chief. He was also part of World Series crews in 2019 and 2022. Hoye has been a full-time MLB ump since 2010. The other umpires appointed to the World Series crew are Dan Bellino, Vic Carapazza, Tripp Gibson, Nic Lentz, Gabe Morales and Jim Wolf. Bellino, Carapazza and Hoye are crew chiefs during the regular season. MLB said having seven umpires allows for "distinct home plate assignments in a potential seven-game series." One umpire will be off the field for each game. Bellino will serve as crew chief when Hoye is off the field in Game 3. Wolf (2015, 2019) is working his third World Series, while Bellino (2021), Carapazza (2023) and Gibson (2022) are working their second. Lentz and Morales are working their first World Series. Umpires Alfonso Marquez, a regular-season crew chief, and D.J. Reyburn have been assigned to assist with replays. Game 1 is Friday night in Milwaukee. --Field Level Media

item.title: Newmont beats quarterly profit estimates on higher gold prices, Cadia recovery
item.description: Newmont beat analysts' third-quarter profit estimates on Thursday, as elevated gold prices and a recovery in copper production at its Cadia mine in Australia boosted earnings.
item.dc:creator: Varun Sahay, Divya Rajagopal
item.content:encoded: Newmont (NEM.N) beat analysts' third-quarter profit estimates on Thursday, as elevated gold prices and a recovery in copper production at its Cadia mine in Australia boosted earnings. Gold prices averaged $4,204.59 per ounce during the quarter, up about 17.6% from a year earlier, as investors sought safe-haven assets despite a stronger dollar and inflation concerns tied to higher oil prices during the US war on Iran. Quarterly revenue rose 15% to $6.36 billion, while copper production jumped 35% from the previous quarter to 23,000 tonnes as Cadia recovered from a prior-quarter disruption. Shares of the company were up 1.5% in extended trading. Newmont said it was advancing its Red Chris Block Cave joint venture in the British Columbia province of Canada toward a final investment decision in early 2027. The project is expected to produce about 3 million ounces of gold and more than 850,000 tonnes of copper over an initial 13-year cave life. Commercial production is targeted for 2033. The miner, which owns 70% of Red Chris, estimated development capital at $4.2 billion to $4.8 billion, net of an anticipated C$500 million ($356.99 million) contribution from the Canadian government. The company also amended its Nevada Gold Mines joint-venture agreement with Canada's Barrick Mining (ABX.TO) to include Barrick's Fourmile and Newmont's Fiberline and Mike properties, and plans to pay Barrick $1.95 billion in the fourth quarter. CEO Natascha Viljoen said Newmont was not interested in bidding for Australian gold miner Northern Star Resources (NST.AX) , saying its assets did not align with the company's strategy. "It is really hard to find anything better than what we have internally in our own operations," Viljoen said. The company posted adjusted profit of $2.20 per share for the quarter ended September 30, above analysts' average estimate of $2.05 per share, according to data compiled by LSEG. ($1 = 1.4006 Canadian dollars)

item.title: Giants OC: J.J. McCarthy's skill set opens up more of playbook
item.description: Having J.J. McCarthy as the starting quarterback allows the New York Giants to run nearly the entire offense they installed during the preseason, when Jaxson Dart was the starter, offensive coordinator Matt Nagy said Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Having J.J. McCarthy as the starting quarterback allows the New York Giants to run nearly the entire offense they installed during the preseason, when Jaxson Dart was the starter, offensive coordinator Matt Nagy said Thursday. Like Dart, McCarthy is a mobile quarterback. With McCarthy now in the starting role, Nagy can restore most of the elements that were removed when the Giants replaced Dart with veteran pocket passer Jameis Winston following Dart's season-ending knee injury last month. "I think for us, and I know for us going into this thing, knowing what we wanted to do with Jaxson's ability and his traits, him and Jameis are very different, and that's OK. Now, coming into this thing with J.J., you get to a point where his skill set is very similar to Jaxson," Nagy said. "So, it's like, OK, it brings back -- we talked about percentages the first time we were here, right? You talked about whether it's 30 percent of the offense is gone. Well, maybe now 20 percent of that 30 that was gone is back." The Giants (3-2-1) benched Winston in favor of McCarthy on Sunday after falling behind 34-10 against the New Orleans Saints. McCarthy led three scoring drives in the fourth quarter against New Orleans' prevent defense before driving New York to the Saints' 14-yard line in the final seconds. The Giants turned the ball over on downs to end the rally. The third-year pro completed 11 of 21 passes for 234 yards, with one touchdown and one interception. He also rushed for 26 yards on two carries. "When you're down 24 points, they're going to naturally, most defenses, play a little bit more prevent/soft defense. We understand that, but there's still a lot of throws within that game in the fourth quarter where he made some really impressive throws," Nagy said. McCarthy's ability to throw and run gives Nagy more options. Previously, when McCarthy entered as Winston's backup, defenses could anticipate a quarterback run. "Now that he's the quarterback and the starter, it probably benefits us some that he's just not always coming in to do predictable QB-driven runs," Nagy said. McCarthy is still learning the offense after the Giants acquired him from the Minnesota Vikings for a 2027 fifth-round draft pick on Sept. 28. New York brought in the 2024 first-round pick (10th overall) after Dart's injury. McCarthy will face his first true test Sunday when the Giants travel to Houston to take on the Texans (2-4), who are coming off a 34-31 win over the Jacksonville Jaguars in London. --Field Level Media

item.title: Utilidad neta mexicana Grupo Bimbo sube un 22.1% en tercer trimestre
item.description: El productor de pan mexicano Grupo Bimbo informó el jueves que sus ganancias netas se incrementaron un 22.1% interanual en el tercer trimestre, a 4,109 millones de pesos (227.2 millones de dólares).
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El productor de pan mexicano Grupo Bimbo informó el jueves que sus ganancias netas se incrementaron un 22.1% interanual en el tercer trimestre, a 4,109 millones de pesos (227.2 millones de dólares). Los ingresos totales de Grupo Bimbo (BIMBOA.MX) , con presencia en 99 países, sumaron 106,061 millones de pesos en el periodo, un 1.3% menos que los reportados entre julio y septiembre de 2025. (1 dólar = 18.0808 pesos mexicanos al cierre de septiembre)

item.title: Kevin Kisner sees Tiger Woods targeting Masters with TGL slate, Hero
item.description: NBC Sports lead golf analyst Kevin Kisner said he foresees Tiger Woods using his play in TGL as a springboard to more competitive golf in 2027.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: NBC Sports lead golf analyst Kevin Kisner said he foresees Tiger Woods using his play in TGL as a springboard to more competitive golf in 2027. It was announced earlier this week that Woods will compete for the Jupiter Links GC entry in TGL, the winter golf simulator league, with Woods taking Kisner's spot. Kisner, who is also a part-time player on the PGA Tour, said on a recent podcast that he was told Woods wanted to play a full schedule. "Rob (McNamara), Tiger's guy, he texted me a long text last week, I think, just telling me what they did on their decisions, how they were moving around and what players are going to do," Kisner said on the Barstool "Fore Play" episode posted Wednesday. Injuries, legal issues and time in a Swiss rehabilitation center earlier this year have kept Woods, 50, from playing in a pro tournament since The Open Championship in 2024. Kisner said he anticipates Woods will play in the Hero World Challenge (Dec. 3-6), which he hosts in the Bahamas, and the PNC Championship (Dec. 19-20). If that goes well, he could target the Masters (April 8-11). He missed the PNC last year because of back surgery, but he typically plays in that family event with his son, Charlie. "He can't have any more setbacks injury-wise, but the way he was swinging and moving on the range, the guy loves to compete," Kisner said. "Come back, get your feet wet at the Hero, play with Charlie at the father-son, play some TGL, get ready for Augusta." --Field Level Media

item.title: Week 7 TNF: Patriots-Bears Preview, Prop Picks, Prediction
item.description: The New England Patriots will have a makeshift offensive line when they visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday night to kick off Week 7 of the NFL season.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The New England Patriots will have a makeshift offensive line when they visit the Chicago Bears on Thursday night to kick off Week 7 of the NFL season. Patriots head coach Mike Vrabel confirmed that starting guards Ben Brown and Alijah Vera-Tucker have been ruled out against Chicago (4-2) after being injured during last Sunday's 26-19 victory over the New York Jets. Brown left the game with a knee injury, while Vera-Tucker exited the contest with a hamstring injury. The Patriots (4-2) have won their past three games but will be facing a Bears defense that has recorded 17 sacks, including a season-high five in the team's 31-23 win at Atlanta last week. ODDS AND TRENDS The Bears are consensus 3-point favorites. That includes at BetMGM, where they have attracted 61% of the total bets and 70% of the spread-line money wagered since opening as 2.5-point favorites. The moneyline action has been more evenly split, with the Patriots backed by 56% of the bets and 53% of the money while shifting from +110 underdogs to +125. The total points line opened at 50. It has since edged up to 50.5 with the Over supported by 60% of the total bets and 67% of the money. PROP PICKS --Patriots WR DeMario Douglas Over 37.5 Receiving Yards (-110 at BetMGM): This has been the most popular player prop at the sportsbook, with Douglas entering the game with a team-high 20 receptions on 30 targets. He becomes an even bigger focal point of the offense with fellow wide receiver Romeo Doubs on injured reserve. --Bears RB D'Andre Swift Anytime TD Scorer (-160 at DraftKings): With backfield mate Kyle Monangai out again, the brunt of the workload falls on Swift, who has six rushing touchdowns on the season. Three of those have come with Monangai sidelined the past two weeks. This has been the most popular player prop at DraftKings. KEY STAT The Patriots rank sixth in total defense, allowing an average of 300.8 yards per game. That is just ahead of the Bears at 302.3. THE NEWS It's been a Jekyll-and-Hyde season for Maye, who had one touchdown pass and was intercepted six times in his first three games. He has 10 touchdown passes and one interception in the three games since. "Drake Maye is one of those guys who does an outstanding job with his feet," Bears defensive coordinator Dennis Allen said. "There's been times when you watch it, there's been pressure on the quarterback and he makes people miss and he creates run plays down the field, so I see him doing a lot of good things. I see especially his athleticism showing up. His ability to throw the ball down the field has been exceptional." One of Chicago's two losses came when the Bears were without starting quarterback Caleb Williams because of a hamstring injury. Williams returned against Atlanta and completed 30 of 36 passes for 305 yards and a touchdown in a 31-23 victory. It was the first time Williams played since he left the fourth quarter of a 9-3 loss to Minnesota on Sept. 20. The Bears enter this game averaging an NFL-best 160.7 rushing yards per game. Only Buffalo (14) has more rushing scores than Chicago's 13. Swift has run for a team-high 398 yards and six touchdowns on 94 carries. "They have really good talent," Vrabel said. "The O-line is excellent. They're well-coached. It's a good scheme. I think that the backs run hard and the receivers ... when you can run the football, the receivers have to be a big factor in that, and they are. "(Stopping the run) will be our emphasis, but obviously there's a lot more that they do than run the football." INJURY REPORT PATRIOTS: Vera-Tucker and Brown will be replaced by Matt Pryor and Walter Rouse. Pryor, 31, has started 40 of the 111 games he has played in during his NFL career, including 15 of 17 games with the Bears in 2024. Rouse, 25, will make his first career NFL start Thursday. Doubs was placed on injured reserve Monday after he sustained a shoulder injury while catching a 42-yard touchdown pass against the Jets. He has 14 receptions for 261 yards and three scores this season. Backup cornerbacks Karon Prunty (hamstring) and Channing Canada (hamstring) also were ruled out. Right tackle Morgan Moses (foot), linebacker Christian Elliss (chest) and safeties Kevin Byard III (chest) and Craig Woodson (shoulder) were listed as questionable. BEARS: Running back Monangai (thumb, toe) has been ruled out for a third straight game. Linebacker Jack Sanborn (concussion) also was ruled out, fellow linebacker T.J. Edwards (hamstring) is doubtful and defensive back Tyrique Stevenson (hip) is questionable after participating fully in practice Wednesday. THEY SAID IT "It's been a next-man-up mentality," Maye said. "That's a Coach Vrabel-coached team. He always says it and we believe it. We gotta have identity throughout. It's not just the top guys. It's the guys in practice in the huddle." --Maye, on the Patriots' injury situation PREDICTION The Patriots will be hard-pressed to continue their recent surge while traveling on a short week to face a Bears defense that has already racked up 17 sacks. --Bears 31, Patriots 23 --Field Level Media

item.title: S&P 500 e Nasdaq fecham com forte queda, conforme novas dúvidas sobre IA levam a vendas no setor de tecnologia
item.description: As ações nos EUA fecharam em forte baixa nesta quinta-feira, e o Nasdaq registrou sua maior queda diária desde junho, à medida que uma série de relatórios de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão reacendeu novos temores sobre a corrida por gastos com IA.
item.dc:creator: Stephen Culp, Tharuniyaa Lakshmi
item.content:encoded: As ações nos EUA fecharam em forte baixa nesta quinta-feira, e o Nasdaq registrou sua maior queda diária desde junho, à medida que uma série de relatórios de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão reacendeu novos temores sobre a corrida por gastos com IA. O S&P 500 encerrou o dia em território profundamente negativo. O Nasdaq, com forte presença de empresas de tecnologia, foi puxado para baixo pelo setor de microchips e registrou a maior queda, caindo 2,6% na esteira de uma enxurrada de resultados financeiros de grande repercussão relacionados à IA. O Dow Jones, índice de blue chips, conseguiu um ganho nominal minutos antes do fechamento do mercado. Os resultados da Meta (META.O) superaram as expectativas dos analistas, mas suas ações tombaram 7,0%, já que a controladora do Facebook registrou seu primeiro fluxo de caixa negativo em mais de uma década devido aos gastos com IA e anunciou planos de emitir ações sem direito a voto em uma divisão de duas por uma para levantar capital a ser investido nessa tecnologia emergente. As ações da Tesla (TSLA.O) caíram 3,1%, embora a fabricante de carros elétricos tenha, inesperadamente, registrado fluxo de caixa livre positivo no trimestre e reduzido seus planos de gastos de capital para 2026. O índice Philadelphia SE Semiconductor (.SOX) , que impulsionou grande parte dos ganhos do atual mercado em alta, despencou 6,7%, sua maior queda percentual diária desde 23 de junho. Com a queda desta quinta-feira, o SOX está mais de 26% abaixo de sua máxima histórica de fechamento, alcançada em 22 de junho, mas ainda apresenta alta de 51,5% no acumulado do ano. O S&P 500 subiu 11,9% no mesmo período. “É um dia maravilhoso em Wall Street”, disse Paul Nolte, consultor sênior de patrimônio e estrategista de mercado da Murphy & Sylvest, em Elmhurst, Illinois. “A única parte do mercado que está realmente sofrendo aqui é a de tecnologia, que tem sido a queridinha dos mercados até mais ou menos junho.” “Os investidores estão começando a perceber que há algumas lacunas na narrativa da IA”, acrescentou Nolte. “E isso está causando impacto nos índices, pois eles têm uma ponderação muito grande no setor de tecnologia.” No cenário geopolítico, os houthis, apoiados pelo Irã, lançaram novos ataques contra alvos sauditas, levando os preços do petróleo bruto à maior alta em cinco meses. Os investidores temem que os conflitos em curso no Oriente Médio possam manter a inflação elevada e forçar o Federal Reserve a continuar aumentando as taxas de juros. Dados do Departamento do Trabalho mostraram que os pedidos iniciais de auxílio-desemprego continuaram oscilando perto dos níveis mais baixos em várias décadas. Sinais de estabilidade no mercado de trabalho permitirão que o Fed se concentre no combate à inflação. Atualmente, os mercados financeiros estão precificando a probabilidade de que o banco central aumente sua taxa básica de juros em mais 25 pontos-base antes do final do ano. O Dow Jones Industrial Average (.DJI) teve variação positiva de 0,02%, para 52.867,98 pontos, o S&P 500 (.SPX) caiu 1,21%, para 7.663,43 pontos, e o Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) registrou queda de 2,60%, para 26.008,86 pontos. A temporada de resultados do terceiro trimestre está em pleno andamento, com 111 das empresas do S&P 500 já tendo divulgado seus resultados. Dessas, 83% superaram as expectativas dos analistas, de acordo com os dados mais recentes da LSEG. A Procter & Gamble (PG.N) alertou que as crescentes pressões de custo teriam um impacto cada vez maior sobre o lucro, mas superou as estimativas dos analistas, levando as ações a uma alta de 5,6% e impulsionando o setor de bens de consumo básico (.SPLRCS) . A Blackstone (BX.N) saltou 8,4%, depois que a empresa afirmou que a ampliação dos spreads de crédito sobre dívidas relacionadas à IA poderia representar uma oportunidade para garantir retornos mais elevados. A Lockheed Martin (LMT.N) subiu 7,0% depois que a empresa aeroespacial e de defesa elevou suas previsões anuais de vendas e lucro. A Spotify (SPOT.N) saltou 11,1% depois que a empresa sueca de streaming de música previu lucro no quarto trimestre acima das estimativas de Wall Street, apostando em seus recursos baseados em IA para impulsionar o crescimento do número de usuários. A Union Pacific (UNP.N) registrou alta de 3,6% após a empresa superar as expectativas nos resultados trimestrais, impulsionados por aumentos nos preços de seus principais produtos, embora a ferrovia tenha sinalizado um impacto negativo devido ao aumento dos preços dos combustíveis. As fabricantes de chips Intel (INTC.O) , AMD (AMD.O) , Sandisk (SNDK.O) e Marvell (MRVL.O) caíram mais de 8% em meio à onda de vendas generalizada no setor de chips.

item.title: Folha de S.Paulo não publicou capa com "extrato bancário" de R$300 bi de Lula
item.description: É falso que a Folha de S.Paulo tenha publicado uma capa da edição impressa mostrando as supostas "primeiras imagens do extrato bancário" do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, que somariam quase R$300 bilhões em "propinas e desvios identificados".
item.dc:creator: Reuters Fact Check
item.content:encoded: É falso que a Folha de S.Paulo tenha publicado uma capa da edição impressa mostrando as supostas "primeiras imagens do extrato bancário" do presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT), candidato à reeleição, que somariam quase R$300 bilhões em "propinas e desvios identificados". Posts no Facebook espalham a imagem, que simula a identidade visual do jornal, atribuindo as informações à edição de "terça-feira, 14 de outubro de 2026". No entanto, a capa da Folha de S.Paulo do último dia 14 trouxe a manchete "Flávio acena a assalariados, e Lula, a MEIs a 12 dias do segundo turno", e não mencionou supostas acusações de propina contra o presidente. Além disso, neste ano a data caiu em uma quarta-feira. Uma análise da ferramenta SynthID Detector, que identifica a presença de marcas d'água ocultas em materiais criados com IA, detectou que a imagem foi feita ou editada com ferramentas de IA da OpenAI. A Folha de S.Paulo não respondeu a um pedido de comentário. O conteúdo circula nas redes sociais após Lula propor a Flávio Bolsonaro (PL), seu adversário no segundo turno, que ambos abram ao público suas contas bancárias e registros telefônicos. INCONSISTÊNCIAS A falsa capa com o suposto extrato mostra uma lista com nomes de escândalos de corrupção e valores que seriam oriundos dos esquemas, totalizando R$299,4 bilhões. A Folha de S.Paulo noticiou denúncias de supostos pagamentos indevidos ao presidente na época da operação Lava Jato, mas a Reuters não encontrou registros de que o jornal tenha publicado que o petista recebeu R$300 bilhões, como dizem os posts. As postagens também exageram cifras e omitem o desfecho de parte dos casos mencionados. A imagem atribui a Lula, por exemplo, uma propina de R$1,2 bilhão em um processo relacionado à operação Zelotes, no qual o presidente era acusado de ter favorecido montadoras, mas a Justiça absolveu o petista. O presidente foi condenado em um processo da Lava Jato por supostamente ter recebido R$2,2 milhões em propina por meio de um triplex no Guarujá (SP). A montagem atribui um valor de R$3,6 bilhões ao caso. Em 2021, o Supremo Tribunal Federal (STF) anulou todas as sentenças de Lula relacionadas à Lava Jato ao declarar a incompetência da Justiça Federal do Paraná e a suspeição do ex-juiz Sergio Moro, hoje governador eleito do Paraná pelo PL. VEREDICTO Falso. A Folha de S.Paulo não publicou uma capa ou uma notícia mostrando um "extrato bancário" de propinas atribuído a Lula. Este artigo foi produzido pela equipe da Reuters Fact Check. Envie sugestões de checagem via WhatsApp pelo número (11) 91599-9278. . Leia mais sobre nosso trabalho de checagens de afirmações nas redes sociais aqui .

item.title: EEUU impone restricciones de visa a 21 colombianos por presunta corrupción y narcotráfico
item.description: El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos anunció el jueves restricciones de visa a 21 personas en Colombia, incluidos el expresidente de la petrolera estatal Ecopetrol Ricardo Roa, dos congresistas y un alcalde de una ciudad capital, a quienes acusa de socavar a gobiernos elegidos democráticamente mediante la corrupción o el narcotráfico.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El Departamento de Estado de Estados Unidos anunció el jueves restricciones de visa a 21 personas en Colombia, incluidos el expresidente de la petrolera estatal Ecopetrol Ricardo Roa, dos congresistas y un alcalde de una ciudad capital, a quienes acusa de socavar a gobiernos elegidos democráticamente mediante la corrupción o el narcotráfico. La medida amplía la campaña de Estados Unidos contra ambos delitos en la región. Según el Departamento, la decisión impulsa los compromisos asumidos por los socios en la Cumbre de Doral, en marzo, y en la declaración de líderes del Escudo de las Américas del 22 de septiembre. "La Administración Trump respalda al Gobierno de Colombia en sus esfuerzos por eliminar la influencia criminal, incluso en sus tribunales, fuerzas policiales y legislatura", dijo el Departamento de Estado en un comunicado. Roa enfrenta investigaciones criminales por su gestión al frente del grupo energético Ecopetrol y por su desempeño como gerente de la campaña que llevó al poder al expresidente Gustavo Petro en 2022. En la lista del Departamento de Estado también figuran Yahir Fernando Acuña, alcalde de Sincelejo, capital del departamento de Sucre; el senador Wadith Alberto Manzur; y la representante de la Cámara Karen Astrith Manrique. El Gobierno del presidente de derecha Abelardo De La Espriella mejoró las relaciones de Colombia con Estados Unidos, y Washington se comprometió a colaborar con su administración en la lucha contra el narcotráfico y los grupos armados ilegales. Washington es el principal socio de Colombia en su lucha contra la producción y el tráfico de cocaína, así como contra las guerrillas izquierdistas y las bandas criminales que se financian con esa actividad ilegal e intervienen en un conflicto armado interno de más de seis décadas que ha dejado 450.000 muertos. Estados Unidos también es el principal destino de las exportaciones colombianas. No hubo reacciones inmediatas de las personas sancionadas por el Departamento de Estado ni del Gobierno de Colombia.

item.title: US to tighten Ebola screening with new air passenger declarations
item.description: The US government will increase measures aimed at preventing entry by people exposed to Ebola with a new requirement for US-bound air travelers to attest they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days, according to a memo on Thursday seen by Reuters.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: The US government will increase measures aimed at preventing entry by people exposed to Ebola with a new requirement for US-bound air travelers to attest they have not been in the Democratic Republic of Congo in the prior 21 days, according to a memo on Thursday seen by Reuters. The US Centers for Disease Control and Prevention in May adopted rules barring airline passengers who have been in the DRC, the center of the 2026 outbreak, in the prior three weeks. The restrictions were extended to US citizens in July. The new CDC order takes effect November 3 and requires all US-bound airline passengers to file digital or paper attestations. Airlines for America, which represents United Airlines (UAL.O) , American Airlines (AAL.O) , Southwest Airlines (LUV.N) and Delta Air Lines (DAL.N) , did not immediately comment. The CDC is holding briefing calls with major US and foreign airlines on Friday to detail how carriers should comply with the new requirements. As part of the Ebola measures, the CDC since earlier this year has also barred foreign nationals from the US if they have been in Uganda or South Sudan in the prior three weeks. The Bundibugyo strain of the virus spread undetected for months before the outbreak was declared in May. It kills about half of those infected and has no approved treatment or vaccine. So far the outbreak is confirmed to have killed about 4,700 people in Africa, according to the Africa CDC. To date, no Ebola cases associated with this outbreak have been reported in the United States, the CDC said.

item.title: El alto costo de la IA pasa la cuenta a Meta y a otras acciones tecnológicas
item.description: Los inversionistas vendieron el jueves acciones de Meta Platforms y de una gran cantidad de empresas tecnológicas, un día después de que la compañía, uno de los proveedores de servicios en la nube a gran escala que está gastando miles de millones para construir centros de datos y otra infraestructura de IA, anunció que emitirá una nueva clase de acciones para conseguir fondos.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
item.content:encoded: Los inversionistas vendieron el jueves acciones de Meta Platforms (META.O) y de una gran cantidad de empresas tecnológicas, un día después de que la compañía, uno de los proveedores de servicios en la nube a gran escala que está gastando miles de millones para construir centros de datos y otra infraestructura de IA, anunció que emitirá una nueva clase de acciones para conseguir fondos. La acción de Meta cayó un 7%, su mayor descenso desde julio, la de SpaceX (SPCX.O) perdió un 9% y la de la empresa de semiconductores Nvidia (NVDA.O) , un barómetro del sector de la IA, retrocedió un 4%,5. El índice compuesto Nasdaq (.IXIC) cerró con su mayor caída en cuatro meses. Una caída del 12% de las acciones de la empresa de semiconductores Lam Research (LRCX.O) tras sus resultados, también influyó negativamente en el ánimo del mercado y provocó una caída del índice de semiconductores (.SOX) del 6,6%. El retroceso es una prueba para los inversores en el sector de la IA, que asiste a un aumento de los costos de un proyecto a largo plazo cuyas ganancias siguen siendo inciertas y probablemente se distribuirán de forma desigual. Las empresas tecnológicas han contraído enormes deudas durante el último año para financiar proyectos de IA, pero Wall Street ahora prevé que las tasas de interés más altas obligarán a compañías como Meta a vender miles de millones de dólares en acciones para financiar la siguiente fase de desarrollo, lo que ejercerá presión sobre el precio al incrementar el número de títulos. Se trata de un revés para un mercado donde los principales índices bursátiles estadounidenses se mantienen cerca de máximos históricos a pesar de un mes de gran volatilidad en las operaciones. PREOCUPA EL RETORNO DE LA INVERSIÓN La caída comenzó con "la gran pregunta sobre el retorno de la inversión de todo el gasto", dijo Matthew Maley, estratega jefe de mercado de Miller Tabak. "Cada vez es más evidente para la gente que esto va a llevar mucho más tiempo". Thomas Hayes, presidente de Great Hill Capital LLC en Nueva York, coincidió en que las preocupaciones sobre el retorno de la inversión son fundamentales, y mencionó comentarios del CEO de Nvidia, Jensen Huang, sobre el cuello de botella en el financiamiento para las empresas de IA más pequeñas como un factor que contribuye a la venta de acciones. Meta anunció el miércoles que usará nuevas acciones de Clase C, sin derecho a voto, para financiar gastos en inteligencia artificial y otras prioridades. Meta también elevó el límite inferior de su previsión de gasto anual de 130.000 millones de dólares a 135.000 millones, manteniendo el límite superior sin cambios en 145.000 millones. El nivel de gasto requerirá una gran participación de los inversionistas en las próximas ventas de acciones. Meta registró un flujo de caja libre negativo de 2.120 millones de dólares en el tercer trimestre, en comparación con un flujo de caja libre positivo de 10.630 millones de dólares un año antes. Es el primer déficit de efectivo de Meta en más de una década. “Un mayor gasto, un flujo de caja libre negativo y la falta de ingresos generados por el gasto preocupan a los inversionistas, que consideran que esto se está convirtiendo en una especie de pozo sin fondo”, dijo Robert Pavlik, gestor sénior de cartera de Dakota Wealth en Fairfield, Connecticut. Esta medida pone de relieve la preocupación sobre cómo se financiará la inversión en IA. Los swaps de incumplimiento crediticio, que miden el riesgo percibido de impago de muchos de los principales actores del sector de la IA, han aumentado durante el último año, y el de Meta alcanzó un récord el jueves, lo que refleja la incertidumbre sobre quién se beneficiará más de las sumas que se están invirtiendo actualmente. Las nuevas señales de presión del mercado para frenar el gasto en IA se tradujeron rápidamente el jueves en una caída generalizada del mercado, lo que refleja las expectativas de que cualquier retroceso en la IA afectará al crecimiento estadounidense, lo que repercute en un fuerte repunte de los precios de los bonos del Tesoro. "Este es un día típico de rotación", dijo Joe Saluzzi, socio, cofundador y codirector de operaciones de renta variable en Themis Trading. "Se puede ver cómo el dinero se dirige a los bonos del Tesoro, por lo que es una estrategia clásica de seguridad (...) Están rotando sus inversiones, saliendo de las empresas tecnológicas y de las empresas de inteligencia artificial, hacia inversiones más seguras, ya sean bonos o algunas de las grandes acciones del Dow Jones".

item.title: Elevada umidade retarda plantio de soja no RS; Emater eleva previsão de produtividade para o trigo
item.description: O plantio de soja do Rio Grande do Sul na safra 2026/27 avançou lentamente nesta semana devido a chuvas, com o importante Estado produtor realizando a semeadura em 3% da área total projetada, abaixo da média histórica para a época, informou a Emater em boletim nesta quinta-feira.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: O plantio de soja do Rio Grande do Sul na safra 2026/27 avançou lentamente nesta semana devido a chuvas, com o importante Estado produtor realizando a semeadura em 3% da área total projetada, abaixo da média histórica para a época, informou a Emater em boletim nesta quinta-feira. "A elevada umidade do solo e a ocorrência de chuvas frequentes restringiram as janelas de plantabilidade, e as baixas temperaturas e a limitada radiação solar retardaram o desenvolvimento das primeiras lavouras implantadas", afirmou o órgão de assistência técnica vinculado ao governo gaúcho. A média histórica indica plantio em 5% das áreas nesta época. Mas o ritmo está igual ao mesmo período do ano passado. O Rio Grande do Sul tem potencial de ser o quarto maior Estado produtor de soja do Brasil na temporada 2026/27, segundo a primeira estimativa da estatal Conab, divulgada na semana passada. O Estado ficaria atrás de Mato Grosso, Paraná e Goiás. No Paraná, chuvas excessivas associadas ao El Niño também [USN:L1N4660QU TEXT:"reduziram"] os ritmo dos trabalhos de plantio. "Em áreas semeadas antecipadamente, houve prejuízo à emergência após as chuvas volumosas, embora os estandes ainda estejam, em geral, satisfatórios", acrescentou a Emater, que chamou também a atenção para o aparecimento do fungo da ferrugem asiática. A safra gaúcha está estimada pela Conab em 20,2 milhões de toneladas, avanço anual de 8,3%. Com relação ao milho, a Emater afirmou que o plantio avançou em ritmo desigual, atingindo 78% da área do Estado, e que as temperaturas amenas também retardaram o crescimento em algumas regiões. O Rio Grande do Sul é normalmente o principal Estado produtor do cereal na primeira safra e deve colher 6,6 milhões de toneladas, alta de 10,2% ante o ciclo passado, segundo a Conab. TRIGO Embora tenha citado perdas para a safra de trigo em decorrência de chuvas excessivas, a Emater elevou nesta quinta-feira sua projeção de produtividade para a safra do cereal do Estado, afirmando que a projeção inicial considerou resultados de mais perdas em anos de El Niño. A produtividade projetada no início do plantio era de 2.701 kg/hectare, e o cenário atual aponta 2.833 kg/ha, segundo a Emater. Ainda assim, o desempenho indica uma retração de 5,55% em relação ao ano anterior. A safra de trigo, com colheita em andamento, está estimada agora pela Emater em 2,16 milhões de toneladas, o que representa queda de 37,48% no comparativo com o ciclo passado, quando a área plantada foi maior, superando 1 milhão de hectares. O Rio Grande do Sul é um dos principais produtores do Brasil, ao lado do Paraná. Ademais, Neimar Peroni, um dos organizadores do Informativo Conjuntural da Emater, alertou que a empresa poderá revisar para baixo a projeção, caso os resultados esperados no campo não sejam confirmados.

item.title: EEUU bloquea dos dispositivos con chips de vigilancia fabricados en China
item.description: La Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones (FCC) anunció el jueves que prohibió la comercialización en el mercado estadounidense de dos dispositivos que contienen chips de vigilancia extranjeros fabricados por una filial de la empresa china Huawei, la primera vez que ejerce su autoridad en virtud de una nueva normativa.
item.dc:creator: David Shepardson
item.content:encoded: La Comisión Federal de Comunicaciones (FCC) anunció el jueves que prohibió la comercialización en el mercado estadounidense de dos dispositivos que contienen chips de vigilancia extranjeros fabricados por una filial de la empresa china Huawei, la primera vez que ejerce su autoridad en virtud de una nueva normativa. La agencia señaló que había prohibido una cámara para salpicadero y un transmisor de video inalámbrico que contenían chips fabricados por HiSilicon, filial de Huawei, y que, según la agencia, anuncia su chip como "diseñado para el mercado de la vigilancia" e incluye "algoritmos de detección de rostros humanos". El presidente de la FCC, Brendan Carr, afirmó que los dispositivos de video que contienen chips de vigilancia fabricados por empresas incluidas en su lista de seguridad nacional "suponen un riesgo evidente e inaceptable para la nación y nuestra población". Huawei no respondió de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios y no fue posible contactar con HiSilicon. La FCC votó en julio a favor de prohibir en EEUU la venta de dispositivos que contengan componentes de hardware clave de empresas chinas consideradas un riesgo para la seguridad nacional

item.title: Exempleado de Eminem se declara culpable de un delito de infracción de derechos autor
item.description: Un antiguo empleado de Eminem se declaró culpable el jueves de un delito de infracción de los derechos de autor por vender sin permiso música inédita del rapero, según un escrito presentado ante un tribunal federal de Míchigan.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: Un antiguo empleado de Eminem se declaró culpable el jueves de un delito de infracción de los derechos de autor por vender sin permiso música inédita del rapero, según un escrito presentado ante un tribunal federal de Míchigan. Joseph Strange, de 48 años, se enfrenta a una pena de hasta cinco años de prisión por vender varias canciones inéditas de Eminem en 2024 por unos 50.000 dólares, según el acuerdo de declaración de culpabilidad El acuerdo señala que las canciones se filtraron posteriormente en Internet y se reprodujeron entre ocho y nueve millones de veces Strange trabajó para Eminem, cuyo nombre real es Marshall Mathers, en un estudio de música de Ferndale, Míchigan, aproximadamente entre 2007 y 2021 La conducta de Strange "socavó tanto los derechos legales como los artísticos", afirmó el fiscal general adjunto A. Tysen Duva en un comunicado. "Joe Strange es un buen hombre cuyos hijos han sufrido mucho con todo esto", declaró el abogado de Strange, Wade Fink, en un comunicado. "Se trata de un asunto mucho más complicado y matizado que el simple hecho de que un hombre haya robado descaradamente". Los portavoces del sello discográfico de Eminem, Universal Music Group, no respondieron de inmediato a una solicitud de comentarios

item.title: Gilead to buy PepStar's inflammation drug program in $1.28 billion deal
item.description: Gilead Sciences said on Thursday it will acquire PepStar Therapeutics' oral inflammation drug program, including an experimental bowel disease treatment, for $1.275 billion in cash upfront.
item.dc:creator: Sahil Pandey
item.content:encoded: Gilead Sciences (GILD.O) said on Thursday it will acquire PepStar Therapeutics' oral inflammation drug program, including an experimental bowel disease treatment, for $1.275 billion in cash upfront. The deal follows positive mid-stage [USN:L4N4650Q7 TEXT:"results"] for Gilead's experimental pill for chronic bowel disease, emvistegrast, on Monday and adds the new inflammatory bowel disease candidate to its portfolio. Gilead said it sees potential for HCXT-2001 to be developed on its own or in combination with other programs in its pipeline. Inflammatory bowel disease, or IBD, is a group of long-term conditions in which the immune system causes inflammation in the digestive tract. Gilead said HCXT-2001 is designed to block the IL-23 receptor, part of an immune pathway involved in inflammatory diseases. Citi analyst Geoffrey Meacham said the $1.275 billion upfront payment was notable given that HCXT-2001 remains in early-stage testing and has no published clinical data. Meacham said the acquisition reinforces Gilead's inflammation and immunology strategy while offering an opportunity to diversify its longer-term growth beyond its core HIV business. Gilead said the deal, expected to close in the final quarter of this year, gives it worldwide rights to the program.

item.title: 米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落、ＡＩ投資巡る懸念再燃
item.description:
Stephen Culp
［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が反...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米国株式市場＝Ｓ＆Ｐ・ナスダック急落、ＡＩ投資巡る懸念再燃 5:11 配信

2024年9月18日、米国ニューヨーク市。REUTERS/Andrew Kelly

Stephen Culp

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国株式市場はＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種とナスダック総合が反落。ナスダックは１日の下落率として６月５日以来の大きさを記録した。注目企業の決算発表が相次ぐ中、人工知能（ＡＩ）への投資競争を巡る懸念が再燃した。

一方、優良株で構成するダウ工業株３０種は取引終了の数分前に小幅高に転じた。

フェイスブックの親会社メタ・プラットフォームズは、決算がアナリスト予想を上回ったものの、株価は７．０％下落した。ＡＩ関連支出により１０年以上ぶりにキャッシュフローがマイナスとなったほか、ＡＩ技術への投資資金を調達するため、１対２の株式分割で議決権のない株式を発行する計画を発表した。

電気自動車（ＥＶ）メーカーのテスラは３．１％安。四半期のフリーキャッシュフローが予想外のプラスとなり、２０２６年の設備投資計画を引き下げたものの、売られた。

現在の強気相場を大きくけん引してきたフィラデルフィア半導体指数は６．７％急落し、１日の下落率として６月２３日以来の大きさとなった。

同指数はこの日の下落で、６月２２日に付けた終値ベースの最高値を２６％超下回った。ただ、年初来ではなお５１．５％上昇している。同期間のＳ＆Ｐ総合５００種の上昇率は１１．９％。

マーフィー・アンド・シルベストのシニアウェルスアドバイザー兼市場ストラテジスト、ポール・ノルテ氏は「ウォール街にとっては素晴らしい一日だ。市場で本当に苦戦しているのは、６月ごろまで市場の寵児だったハイテク株だけだ」と指摘。「投資家はＡＩの成長シナリオにいくつかの穴があると気付き始めている。株価指数はハイテク株の比重が非常に大きいため、その影響を受けている」と述べた。

地政学面では、イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派がサウジアラビアの標的に新たな攻撃を仕掛け、原油価格が５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。投資家は、中東情勢の混乱が続けばインフレが高止まりし、米連邦準備理事会（ＦＲＢ）が利上げ継続を迫られる可能性を懸念した。

米労働省が発表した新規失業保険申請件数は、数十年ぶりの低水準付近での推移が続いた。労働市場の安定を示す兆候は、ＦＲＢがインフレ抑制に注力する余地を与える。金融市場は現在、ＦＲＢが年末までに政策金利をさらに２５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き上げる可能性を織り込んでいる。

プロクター・アンド・ギャンブル（Ｐ＆Ｇ）は、コスト上昇圧力が利益を一段と圧迫すると警告したものの、決算がアナリスト予想を上回り、５．６％上昇。主要消費財指数を支えた。

ブラックストーンは８．４％高。ＡＩ関連債務の信用スプレッド拡大が、より高いリターンを確保する機会になり得るとの見方を示した。

航空宇宙・防衛大手ロッキード・マーチンは通期の売上高と利益の見通しを引き上げ、７．０％上昇した。

スウェーデンの音楽配信大手スポティファイは１１．１％上昇。第４・四半期の利益見通しが市場予想を上回った。ＡＩを活用した機能が利用者数の拡大を促すと見込んでいる。

半導体株が幅広く売られる中、インテル、アドバンスト・マイクロ・デバイセズ（ＡＭＤ）、サンディスク、マーベル・テクノロジーはいずれも８％超下落した。

ニューヨーク証券取引所では、値上がり銘柄数が値下がり銘柄数を１．０１対１の比率で上回った。ナスダックでは値下がり銘柄数が値上がり銘柄数を１．３７対１の比率で上回った。

米取引所の合算出来高は１８７億９０００万株。直近２０営業日の平均は１７１億９０００万株。
