item.title: US nuclear power regulator allows applicants to include data from agency projects
item.description: The US nuclear power regulator finalized a rule on Thursday allowing companies to use data from demonstration projects at US agencies, calling it the first major change to reactor regulations since President Donald Trump ordered faster agency reviews.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US nuclear power regulator finalized a rule on Thursday allowing companies to use data from demonstration projects at US agencies, calling it the first major change to reactor regulations since President Donald Trump [USN:L1N3RV0O8 TEXT:"ordered"] faster agency reviews. The Nuclear Regulatory Commission rule will now allow companies to use analyses, data and information from reactor demonstration projects at the US energy and defense departments to support an expected wave of applications to the NRC of high-tech reactor projects, including small modular reactors. Trump's orders in May 2025 directed the NRC to finish approvals for new reactor designs within 18 months, igniting criticism that his administration was reducing the NRC's independence. Nuclear plants are powered by radioactive fuels the NRC monitors at all stages. The agency also monitors the safety of nuclear reactors. NRC Chairman Ho Nieh said the rule will not allow projects to get around his agency's strict standards. "This is not a shortcut, this is not a compromise," Nieh told reporters. Nieh said NRC reviews could be more stringent on "consequence analysis," or estimations of potential offsite radiological, health or economic impacts of severe reactor accidents, or hazards from natural events like earthquakes or tornadoes. Nuclear safety activist and physicist Edwin Lyman of the Union of Concerned Scientists said it is critical that the NRC maintain its authority to make independent safety and security determinations and not simply ape the decisions of other agencies. "For all their flaws, the NRC's licensing procedures are far more rigorous and transparent" than the energy and defense department procedures, Lyman said.

item.title: Sainz says talk of F1 racing in Middle East is 'premature'
item.description: Williams driver Carlos Sainz said talk of Formula One seeing out the season with races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi was "premature" in the current circumstances.
item.dc:creator: Alan Baldwin
item.content:encoded: Williams driver Carlos Sainz said talk of Formula One seeing out the season with races in Qatar and Abu Dhabi was "premature" in the current circumstances. Formula One and the sport's governing body, the International Automobile Federation (FIA), have both said the calendar [USN:L6N466191 TEXT:"remains as scheduled"] despite conflict in the Gulf region and the Iran war. FIA president Mohammed Ben Sulayem told reporters this week that the situation was currently "fine", the races were going to happen and he would be happy for his staff and teams to go. Qatar is scheduled for November 29 and Abu Dhabi for December 6. Sainz, a director of the Grand Prix Drivers Association (GPDA), sounded less sure. "I think they seem very convinced that it's going to go ahead. On my personal side, I'm not speaking as the GPDA, it's very difficult to be convinced right now," the Spaniard told reporters on Thursday ahead of the US Grand Prix in Austin. "There's still plenty of things happening in the Middle East and also there is obviously an election that is going to happen in the US and things that are going to happen in the political side of the world that could affect the next month, month and a half. "So I think it's relatively premature to be so convinced. But as it stands, we would go to Qatar and Abu Dhabi and if the FIA and Formula One decide that's still safe and a good scenario I think we as drivers have to go with whatever they say." The US midterm elections are on November 3. President Donald Trump [USN:L1N45U0PH TEXT:"said on October 8"] that the US will not launch an attack on Iran before those elections. The US and Israel launched strikes on Iran in February, with Tehran firing missiles and drones at Gulf neighbours that host American forces. Sainz said the drivers lacked inside information and needed to trust in the decision-making of those running the show. "The world can change a lot in the next month and we need to stay diligent and reactive to whatever happens and not just go because we want to go right now," added the Spaniard. [USN:L6N43R03E TEXT:"Italy's Imola circuit"] has been lined up as a possible Plan B, although winter cold in early December could also make that challenging. McLaren's Oscar Piastri said he would be happier going to Australia at that time of year. "We might have to get some snowploughs out if we race in Imola," he added. "I think Imola is being kind of touted as the replacement. Hopefully it's above zero."

item.title: Australian agency mulled firing KPMG over data-handling rule breach, documents show
item.description: KPMG Australia breached a contract with the country's biggest federal agency by transferring sensitive government material outside its secure environment, prompting officials to consider firing the firm, documents reviewed by Reuters show.
item.dc:creator: Byron Kaye, Christine Chen
item.content:encoded: KPMG Australia breached a contract with the country's biggest federal agency by transferring sensitive government material outside its secure environment, prompting officials to consider firing the firm, documents reviewed by Reuters show. The incident is the global accounting firm's first apparent violation of client information-handling protocols regarding its vast portfolio of Australian government work — A$650 million ($456 million) in active [USN:L1N42K03U TEXT:"federal contracts"] as of 2026. KPMG's Australian unit has been at the centre of a [USN:L1N42R05P TEXT:"scandal"] over accusations it shared confidential private-sector client information to pitch for work, which it has admitted, but has maintained the conduct did not extend to government contracts. The government incident in late 2025 involved Services Australia, which operates the country's public health and welfare systems and handles data of most of the country's population of 27 million. Both KPMG and Services Australia said in comments to Reuters the matter did not involve any data breach, however the government agency has not awarded any new audit work to the firm since. The incident came to light when a KPMG employee sent a draft audit report marked "OFFICIAL: Sensitive" from a KPMG email account rather than from a specifically-assigned account for Services Australia. "It appears KPMG has taken agency materials outside of the network which is in breach of their obligations under the contract," a director of the Services Australia audit branch wrote to the agency's national audit manager, Sally Bond, in a December 17 email obtained under Freedom of Information law. The director, whose name was redacted, recommended the agency demand an explanation from KPMG then "assess whether any further action is required ... including termination of contracts, noting there is no remedy available for a breach of this nature". Bond wrote to KPMG a week later saying "information was transferred outside of the Services Australia environment by KPMG during our engagement", adding the transferral was "explicitly prohibited under the contract". "Services Australia takes a breach of this nature extremely seriously," Bond wrote in the email dated December 23. "We will be in parallel engaging with our relevant agency teams to undertake a review of the situation." In an email the same day to another Services Australia general manager, Bond wrote that the information taken outside the government system was not of "particular concern", but said: "I am more concerned that KPMG has acted outside the contract and has not taken any proactive steps to assure us of this fact". In a response to Bond on December 23, KPMG said the only document transferred outside the agency was an internal audit report template which had been deleted, and the KPMG employee involved would face follow-up action, including additional training. The documents didn't show whether Services Australia took additional measures, but an internal cybersecurity review into the incident concluded in January that the risk of data breach was low and closed it off. NO NEW AUDIT WORK FOR KPMG FROM SERVICES AUSTRALIA KPMG said in a statement to Reuters it "confirmed with Services Australia that no confidential information was exchanged and reminded our people of their obligations in relation to data protocols". A Services Australia spokesperson told Reuters KPMG had "used its own network and email system, rather than the agency's, to develop and distribute a draft internal audit report", but the incident did not amount to a data breach. The agency "considered the available contractual options", the spokesperson added. Since "the work was substantially complete and remedial action had been taken, the agency finalised the engagement rather than terminate the contract". "This was the only instance of this type occurring and Services Australia has not awarded KPMG additional internal audit work since the incident," they said. The agency gave KPMG an A$12 million multi-year contract in 2024 for "program assurance services", and in April awarded the firm an A$69,850 contract to provide actuarial services, according to published government tender data. Gary Monroe, a University of New South Wales professor who specialises in audit, said regardless of what material was taken outside the government system, "it's a breach of trust with the client". On Thursday, the government said it had [USN:L1N468031 TEXT:"extended"] a ban on KPMG bidding for new federal work until February 28, while the firm fixes cultural and governance weaknesses. ($1 = 1.4247 Australian dollars)

item.title: Grupo México prevé invertir hasta 6,000 mln dlr en Asarco en próximos tres años
item.description: El gigante minero Grupo México prevé destinar entre 4,000 y 6,000 millones de dólares en los próximos tres años a los principales proyectos de su filial estadounidense Asarco, dijo el jueves un ejecutivo, después de que reportó esta semana un declive en la producción del tercer trimestre.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: El gigante minero Grupo México prevé destinar entre 4,000 y 6,000 millones de dólares en los próximos tres años a los principales proyectos de su filial estadounidense Asarco, dijo el jueves un ejecutivo, después de que reportó esta semana un declive en la producción del tercer trimestre. La producción de cobre de Grupo México (GMEXICOB.MX) , con negocios también en los sectores transporte e infraestructura, alcanzó en el tercer trimestre las 260,322 toneladas, un 1.9% por debajo del mismo periodo del año anterior, afectada por menores volúmenes en Perú y Asarco, en Estados Unidos. La disminución fue parcialmente compensada por una mayor actividad en México, según su [USN:L6N4661HF TEXT:"informe trimestral"] divulgado el martes. El director de la división minera, Leonardo Contreras, dijo a analistas durante una conferencia telefónica que la empresa mantiene la expansión de su mina Ray, en Arizona, al tiempo que lleva a cabo estudios de viabilidad. Contreras añadió que la compañía es "cada vez más optimista" sobre la puesta en marcha de la fundición y refinería de Hayden, en Arizona, con capacidad para procesar 1.4 millones de toneladas anuales de concentrado de cobre. El proyecto buscaría recuperar capacidad de procesamiento de cobre en Estados Unidos. "Esto supondría casi 350,000 toneladas métricas de cobre contenido y, si se incorporara a nuestra refinería, podríamos alcanzar las 500,000 toneladas métricas de cobre", añadió Contreras. El ejecutivo dijo además que Silver Bell, también en Arizona, permanece en fase de estudios de viabilidad. La empresa espera tener mayor claridad sobre el proyecto en los próximos trimestres.

item.title: 米ロッキード、国防総省にＦ３５を850機供給で合意 通期業績見通し引き上げ
item.description:
Mike Stone Aatreyee Dasgupta
[２２日 ロイター] - 米防衛機器大手ロッキード・マーチン...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ロッキード、国防総省にＦ３５を850機供給で合意　通期業績見通し引き上げ 5:08 配信

米防衛機器大手ロッキード・マーチンのロゴ。2025年7月撮影。REUTERS/Dado Ruvic

Mike Stone　Aatreyee Dasgupta

[２２日 ロイター] - 米防衛機器大手ロッキード・マーチンは２２日、通期の売上高と利益の見通しを上方修正した。米国防総省に「Ｆ３５ライトニングⅡ」戦闘機を今後１０年間に少なくとも８５０機供給する枠組み合意も発表した。

同戦闘機は最も低価格な機種で１機当たり９２００万ドルであるため、１０年間の枠組み合意では少なくとも７８２億ドル相当に達する見込みだ。海兵隊向けの短距離離陸・垂直着陸が可能な「Ｆ３５Ｂ」は１億２１００万ドル、海軍向け「Ｆ３５Ｃ」は１億１０００万ドル。契約における機種構成は不明で、価格はインフレや人件費の上昇に伴って上がると予想される。

また同社は、２０２６年通期の売上高は約８００億─８２０億ドルになるとの見通しを示し、従来の７９７億５０００万─８１７億５０００万ドルから引き上げた。通期の１株当たり利益見通しも、従来の２９．９５─３０．６５ドルから３０．３５─３０．７５ドルに引き上げた。

２６年のフリーキャッシュフロー見通しも、従来の７０億─７２億ドルから約７８億─８０億ドルに引き上げた。

併せて発表した第３・四半期（９月２７日終了）の売上高は１１％増の２０７億１０００万ドル。ミサイル部門の売上高がＰＡＣ３とＴＨＡＡＤの増産で２４％伸びたほか、Ｆ３５とＣ１３０プログラムで航空部門も１３％増加したのが寄与した。ＬＳＥＧがまとめたアナリスト予想は２０５億１０００万ドルだった。

同四半期の１株当たり利益は７．９７ドルで、アナリスト予想の７．４３ドルを上回った。

エバン・スコット最高財務責任者（ＣＦＯ）はロイターに対し、第４・四半期の設備投資増加は、弾薬生産能力の拡大に向けた投資が主因になるとの見方を示した。

ロイター 関連ニュース アングル：米移民摘発、過去最高の逮捕件数も送還難航　法的手続きや移送能力に壁 コラム：米財務省の借入拡大、債務問題の大きさに比べれば単なるノイズ 焦点：テスラ、ロボタクシー「サイバーキャブ」で試す規制の限界 コラム：日銀利上げの「美しいシナリオ」に弱点はないか＝上野泰也氏 アングル：米国防総省のアンソロピック追放、小規模ＡＩライバルに想定外の商機 最終更新: 10/23(金) 5:08 ロイター

item.title: トランプ氏、住宅保有コスト引き下げに大統領令署名 ローン負担軽減など
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日 ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、一戸建て住宅の保有や住宅ローンに伴うコストの軽減を目指す大統領令に署名した。ホワイトハウスが発表した。

大統領令は、借り手が現在の市場価値に基づく自己資本比率の要件を満たした場合、住宅ローン保険料を自動的に打ち切る試験プログラムの開始を連邦住宅金融庁（ＦＨＦＡ）に指示するもの。また、借り換え時の権原保険を免除するＦＨＦＡの試験制度も恒久化する。

このほか、連邦政府の支援対象となる工場生産型住宅の普及拡大に向け、「住宅イノベーション・タスクフォース」を設置。農務長官と退役軍人省長官に対し、それぞれの省が提供する一戸建て住宅向け融資の金利引き下げに取り組むことも指示した。

item.title: New UK banking watchdog to review impact of rules on competitiveness
item.description: Britain's banking watchdog will review how financial regulation affects investment, capital and economic growth, signalling a sharper focus on transparency and an objective to promote competition.
item.dc:creator: Kirstin Ridley, Phoebe Seers
item.content:encoded: Britain's banking watchdog will review how financial regulation affects investment, capital and economic growth, signalling a sharper focus on transparency and an objective to promote competition. Around four months after becoming CEO of the Prudential Regulation Authority, Katharine Braddick said the PRA would publish its first five-year strategy next year, focusing in part on ensuring its regime remained relevant, effective and proportionate. "We will set out how that (competitiveness and growth) framework is embedded in our day-to-day decision-making and how we will track the effect our work is having on the growth and international competitiveness of the UK," she told a dinner at London's Mansion House on Thursday, in her first major speech in the role. Braddick said the PRA, part of the Bank of England, would work with industry to develop its competitiveness and growth agenda, including examining how regulation influences investment, the availability of capital and the pricing of financial services. RESILIENCE IS THE FIRST PRIORITY But ensuring the resilience of the UK's banking and insurance sectors remains the PRA's first priority, Braddick said, particularly given the threat of cyberattacks. She laid out a dedicated supervisory division to act as a "centre of excellence" for operational and cyber resilience, reporting directly to her. "We will significantly increase our focus on firms' operational and cyber resilience," she said. Reuters reported this month that [USN:L6N45Z0FI TEXT:"banking regulators"] including the Bank of England were intensifying efforts to contain AI cyber risks. The PRA and the Financial Conduct Authority on Thursday also laid out plans to further streamline a regime introduced after the 2007-09 financial crisis, in part by speeding up some senior bank job approvals. In the second phase of a consultation on the Senior Managers & Certification Regime, or SMCR, regulators said lightening the regulatory load on the industry would cut annual compliance costs by 53% to about £229.9 million ($307.91 million). SMCR rules include how firms should deal with senior manager roles, identify and assess people's fitness for office and report conduct breaches. The regulators have said the final rules should be published in the first half of next year, with implementation in the second half of 2027. ($1 = 0.7467 pounds)

item.title: Apple bets iPhone Duo can remake foldable market as sales begin
item.description: For nearly two decades Apple has made only small changes to the iPhone, its money machine. That changes on Friday when Apple starts selling its first folding phone, iPhone Duo, betting that the device can do for the small foldables market what the iPhone did for smartphones.
item.dc:creator: Aditya Soni
item.content:encoded: For nearly two decades Apple (AAPL.O) has made only small changes to the iPhone, its money machine. That changes on Friday when Apple starts selling its first folding phone, iPhone Duo, betting that the device can do for the small foldables market what the iPhone did for smartphones. Its reception could prove an early test for new Apple CEO John Ternus, the former hardware chief who unveiled iPhone Duo barely a week after taking charge in September. It could also have large implications for a niche category in which rivals such as Samsung Electronics (005930.KS) and Huawei Technologies have sold premium offerings for years. Within minutes of pre-orders opening last Friday, Apple's estimated delivery dates for the Duo had slipped to late January as demand outpaced supply. The company called the response from customers "nothing short of extraordinary." MIXED REVIEWS Early reviews have praised the $1,999 Duo's premium design as well as its sturdy and barely visible hinge, a major feat for the phones whose prominent creased screen has long been a major drawback and potential deterrent to buyers. But reviewers have also said that camera compromises including the absence of a telephoto lens and third-party apps that still need to be reworked for the new display size could disappoint some buyers. They have noted that iPhone Duo in its smaller, folded state is less handy for the litany of quick tasks that most users carry out each day on standard iPhones, leading several prominent reviewers to recommend against the Duo for many Apple customers. "It's been a lot of fun trying the Duo out for a week, but it feels like I've gotten to use an extraordinarily polished prototype  —  not a finished product that I'd want to buy and carry," longtime Apple commentator John Gruber, the author of the blog Daring Fireball, wrote in a review. Tech commentator Marques Brownlee, popularly known as MKBHD, said in a YouTube review that "if you're just a regular person who doesn't do much more than texting, social media and browsing here and there, then it is probably a no. But if the $2,000 doesn't mean much to you, and you like the idea, after the learning curve and getting used to not having facial identification, it is a really fun phone." TOUGH TO FIND The limited supplies could disappoint Apple fans lining up in front of stores to buy the Duo. Apple told Reuters that walk-in availability would vary by country, with limited stocks in the US, Australia, Canada, Mexico and much of Britain and Europe. In China, France, Hong Kong, India and Japan, units would be available only for customers who had ordered online. In the China-governed territory of Macau, where the iPhone Duo will be available for walk-in customers only, fans already started lining up hours in advance, social media posts and media reports showed. "Foldables have been an established category for years, but adoption has remained relatively limited compared with conventional smartphones. Apple's entry could bring the format to a much broader audience," said Francisco Jeronimo, vice president at market research firm IDC. IDC expects Apple will take 44% of the foldable value in 2026 on 31% of foldable units. By 2027, it will become the market leader in the category both in value and units shipped, according to the firm. "Apple has made a convincing case for this form factor," Jeronimo said after spending a week with the Duo. "Now comes the next test: turning excitement into availability, adoption and a lasting new chapter for the smartphone market," Jeronimo added.

item.title: Ibovespa fecha em queda com tombo de 4% da Vale e ajuste antes de eleição
item.description: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quinta-feira, quase perdendo o patamar dos 203 mil pontos no pior momento, contaminado pelo viés negativo em praças acionárias no exterior e ajustes antes do desfecho da disputa presidencial no Brasil no domingo.
item.dc:creator: Paula Arend Laier
item.content:encoded: O Ibovespa fechou em queda nesta quinta-feira, quase perdendo o patamar dos 203 mil pontos no pior momento, contaminado pelo viés negativo em praças acionárias no exterior e ajustes antes do desfecho da disputa presidencial no Brasil no domingo. Índice de referência do mercado acionário brasileiro, o Ibovespa (.BVSP) recuou 1,15%, a 204.120,21 pontos, mas chegou a 203.051,87 na mínima do dia. No melhor momento, marcou 206.493,11 pontos. O volume financeiro no pregão somou R$39,45 bilhões. A bolsa paulista encerrou os negócios com agentes financeiros na expectativa de nova pesquisa Datafolha, prevista para as 19h, em meio a um cenário ainda acirrado para o segundo turno da eleição para o Palácio do Planalto. Na véspera, [USN:L6N4670YJ TEXT:"pesquisa Quaest"] divulgada pelo jornal O Globo mostrou o senador Flávio Bolsonaro (PL) com 45% das intenções de votos, enquanto o presidente Luiz Inácio Lula da Silva (PT) somou 44%. Desde o recorde intradia registrado no último dia 9 (209.713,45 pontos), ainda sob efeito do entusiasmo com o resultado do primeiro turno no dia 4, com Flávio à frente de Lula, o Ibovespa acumula um declínio de 2,67%. Em outubro, ainda sobe 9,54%. "A impressão é que, no geral, o mercado está indo 'mais leve' para o segundo turno do que foi no primeiro", afirmou um gestor. "As pesquisas que o mercado mais olha estão mostrando um cenário bem apertado." Estrangeiros têm sido um relevante suporte para as ações brasileiras no mês, com entrada líquida de R$20 bilhões até o dia 20. No cenário externo, o índice acionário norte-americano S&P 500 (.SPX) terminou com declínio de 1,21%, com apreensões envolvendo inteligência artificial e o avanço do petróleo. O europeu STOXX 600 (.STOXX) fechou em [USN:L6N46819T TEXT:"queda"] de 1,01%. Na visão do especialista de investimentos Josias Bento, sócio da GT Capital, a bolsa paulista refletiu uma combinação de tensão eleitoral pré-segundo turno, com os candidatos muito próximos nas pesquisas, e uma aversão ao risco no mercado internacional. Em relação ao cenário doméstico, ele chamou atenção especial ao fato de que "os candidatos até agora não mostraram ou falaram de um plano de contingência para controlar as contas públicas, que é uma das principais agendas para 2027". DESTAQUES VALE ON (VALE3.SA) recuou 3,97%, acompanhando o viés negativo de mineradoras no exterior (.SXPP) . Na China, o contrato futuro de [USN:L6N4680V1 TEXT:"minério de ferro"] mais negociado na Bolsa de Mercadorias de Dalian (DCE) caiu 1,62%, para 669 iuanes (US$100,23) por tonelada. No setor de mineração e siderurgia no Brasil, CSN ON (CSNA3.SA) perdeu 5,43%, USIMINAS PNA fechou em queda de 4,81% e GERDAU PN (GGBR4.SA) cedeu 3,92%. Números divulgados pela Inda também mostraram que, em setembro, os distribuidores de [USN:L1N4680WC TEXT:"aços planos"], que costumam ser responsáveis por cerca de um terço das vendas das usinas siderúrgicas nacionais, tiveram queda de 7,2% na comercialização sobre um ano antes. PETROBRAS PN (PETR3.SA) fechou com acréscimo de 0,14%, apesar da forte alta dos preços do petróleo no exterior, onde o barril do Brent terminou com elevação de 4%, a US$113,17, em meio a uma nova [USN:L1N46801N TEXT:"escalada"] das tensões no Oriente Médio. No setor, PRIO ON (PRIO3.SA) avançou 1,85% e BRAVA ON (BRAV3.SA) subiu 0,24%, enquanto PETRORECONCAVO ON (RECV3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, recuou 1,29%. BRADESCO PN cedeu 2,08%, tendo no radar a divulgação do balanço do terceiro trimestre após o fechamento do mercado. Estimativas compiladas pela LSEG apontam lucro líquido de R$7,1 bilhões. No setor, BTG PACTUAL UNIT recuou 1,37%, SANTANDER BRASIL UNIT perdeu 1,35%, ITAÚ UNIBANCO PN caiu 1,84% e BANCO DO BRASIL ON (BBAS3.SA) fechou em baixa de 0,75%. MBRF ON (MBRF3.SA) caiu 2,71%, com investidores ainda especulando potenciais reflexos da ocorrência de [USN:L1N4650PD TEXT:"foco da doença"] de Newcastle em estabelecimento de criação comercial de perus da empresa em Nova Itaberaba, Santa Catarina. Na véspera, a companhia disse que "entende que eventuais impactos decorrentes da ocorrência sobre suas operações, situação econômico-financeira ou resultados, se houver, não serão materiais". No setor, JBS , que é listada nos Estados Unidos, encerrou com declínio de 0,80%. BRADSAÚDE ON (SAUD3.SA) , que não faz parte do Ibovespa, avançou 4,22%, após reportar [USN:L1N467172 TEXT:"lucro líquido"] de R$1,1 bilhão no terceiro trimestre, avanço de 14,4% em relação ao mesmo período do ano anterior. A companhia vinculada ao grupo Bradesco também anunciou que vai distribuir dividendos intercalares de R$1 bilhão, equivalente a R$0,34 por ação em circulação.

item.title: Trump says wind turbine imports threaten national security
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Thursday declared imports of wind turbines and their components a threat to national security, but stopped short of imposing new tariffs on the sector.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Thursday declared imports of wind turbines and their components a threat to national security, but stopped short of imposing new tariffs on the sector. In a White House proclamation, Trump said a Commerce Department investigation found that imported wind turbines threatened national security due to cybersecurity concerns tied to foreign-made equipment, interference with radar systems and air traffic operations, and an increased US reliance on goods made overseas. The move responds to a probe [USN:L1N3UD0KZ TEXT:"launched"] in August 2025 under Section 232 of the Trade Expansion Act. It is one of numerous trade investigations the administration has conducted into the national security ramifications of imports across an array of sectors. Instead of ordering immediate trade restrictions, Trump directed trade officials to pursue negotiations with trading partners and report back within 180 days. Additional trade measures, including tariffs, could be considered later, the order said. The order repeats Trump's longstanding criticism of wind energy as being unreliable because it is intermittent. "Given wind energy’s intermittent reliability, use of wind energy diverts the United States electrical grid from more reliable energy sources," the order said. Major suppliers of wind turbines and components to the United States include Mexico, France, India, Denmark and Germany, according to trade data cited by the center-right think tank American Action Forum. A spokesperson for the American Clean Power Association, a trade group representing clean energy companies, was not immediately available for comment.

item.title: Former Eminem employee pleads guilty to criminal copyright infringement
item.description: A former employee of rapper Eminem pleaded guilty on Thursday to a criminal copyright infringement charge for selling unreleased music from the rapper without permission, according to a filing in Michigan federal court.
item.dc:creator: Blake Brittain
item.content:encoded: A former employee of rapper Eminem pleaded guilty on Thursday to a criminal copyright infringement charge for selling unreleased music from the rapper without permission, according to a filing in Michigan federal court. Joseph Strange, 48, faces up to five years in prison for selling several unreleased Eminem songs in 2024 for around $50,000, the plea agreement said The agreement said that the tracks were later leaked to the internet and streamed between eight and nine million times Strange worked for Eminem, whose given name is Marshall Mathers, at a Ferndale, Michigan, music studio from approximately 2007 to 2021 Strange's conduct "undermined both legal and artistic rights," Assistant Attorney General A. Tysen Duva said in a statement "Joe Strange is a good man whose children have suffered greatly in all of this," Strange's attorney Wade Fink said in a statement. "It is a far more complicated and nuanced matter than a man just unabashedly stealing." Spokespeople for Eminem's label Universal Music Group did not immediately respond to a request for comment

item.title: Moderna sheds about $24 billion as cancer vaccine data triggers 'sell-the-news' retreat
item.description: Moderna's shares sank over 25% on Thursday as late-stage trial data for its personalized melanoma vaccine, developed with Merck , triggered what analysts called a "sell-the-news" reaction after a months-long stock surge.
item.dc:creator: Kamal Choudhury
item.content:encoded: Moderna's (MRNA.O) shares sank over 25% on Thursday as late-stage trial data for its personalized melanoma vaccine, developed with Merck (MRK.N) , triggered what analysts called a "sell-the-news" reaction after a months-long stock surge. The selloff wiped out about $24 billion from the drugmaker's market value, halting a massive rally that has lifted the stock over 500% this year. Moderna was last down 25.2% at $183.88, set for its steepest one-day percentage fall on record, while Merck shares fell nearly 1%. The companies, in August, reported [USN:L1N44G0D3 TEXT:"interim data"] that showed the experimental vaccine, intismeran, cut the risk of recurrence and cancer spread in high-risk melanoma patients in a late-stage trial with over 1,100 patients. [USN:L1N46814F TEXT:"Detailed results"] from the trial on Thursday showed that intismeran combined with Merck's immunotherapy Keytruda [USN:L1N468128 TEXT:"reduced the risk"] of cancer recurrence or death by 42%, while cutting the risk of distant metastasis or death by 38% compared to Keytruda alone. Moderna and Merck released the data after the results leaked on an oncology website earlier in the day, sparking the stock fall. 'SOLID DATA' UBS analyst Michael Yee said the recurrence-free survival results are "solid data," and that the pullback was an expected "'sell the news' event," referring to the trading strategy of buying shares when a rumor appears and selling them when it becomes a reality. Expectations were high given the rally driven by "bullish commentary from the companies," he said. William Blair analyst Myles Minter described the trial data as "great" and concurred that the reversal appears to be a "sell-the-news" reaction. But investors may now be questioning whether the treatment will prove as effective in other cancer types to justify the high valuation, Minter said. TD Cowen analysts also said the 42% recurrence reduction was "compelling" and squarely in the "exceptional range" defined by medical experts. Merck and Moderna said overall survival data are not yet mature but show a "favorable trend," and said they are engaging with regulatory authorities. The results, based on patient data for the first two years after treatment, are scheduled to be presented on Saturday at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid.

item.title: 米ＦＣＣ、中国ファーウェイ子会社製半導体搭載2製品販売禁止 新規則初適用
item.description:
David Shepardson
[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）は２２日、中国の通...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米ＦＣＣ、中国ファーウェイ子会社製半導体搭載2製品販売禁止　新規則初適用 4:53 配信

７月２２日撮影　REUTERS/Kylie Cooper

David Shepardson

[ワシントン ２２日 ロイター] - 米連邦通信委員会（ＦＣＣ）は２２日、中国の通信機器大手、華為技術（ファーウェイ）の子会社が製造した監視向け半導体が搭載された２製品について、米国内での販売を禁止したと発表した。ＦＣＣが新たな規則に基づく権限を行使したのは今回が初めて。

ＦＣＣが販売を禁止したのは、ダッシュボードカメラと無線映像送信機。いずれもファーウェイ子会社のハイシリコンが製造した半導体が搭載されている。ハイシリコンはこの半導体を「監視市場向けに設計されている」と宣伝しているほか、「人の顔を検知するアルゴリズム」を備えていると説明しているという。

この件について、ファーウェイとハイシリコンからコメントは得られていない。

item.title: 原油先物4％高、5カ月ぶり高値 サウジ攻撃で供給懸念
item.description:
Scott DiSavino
［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は、北海ブレント先物が約４％...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
原油先物4％高、5カ月ぶり高値　サウジ攻撃で供給懸念 4:47 配信

2020年4月21日、米国オクラホマ州で撮影。REUTERS/Drone Base/File Photo

Scott DiSavino

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 米国時間の原油先物は、北海ブレント先物が約４％上昇し、５カ月ぶりの高値を付けた。イエメンの親イラン武装組織フーシ派によるサウジアラビアでの攻撃を受け、主要なエネルギー輸出地域からの供給に一段の混乱が生じるとの懸念が強まった。

清算値は、北海ブレント先物が４．３５ドル（４．０％）高の１バレル＝１１３．１７ドル。米ＷＴＩ先物は２．３２ドル（２．４％）高の９９．４７ドルだった。

ブレントは５月４日以来の高値で取引を終えた。テクニカル指標では、この１週間で３度目の買われ過ぎの状態となった。

エネルギー助言会社リターブッシュ・アンド・アソシエーツのアナリストはリポートで「米中間選挙後に米国とイスラエルがイランを共同攻撃するとの観測が浮上する中、フーシ派によるサウジのインフラへの追加攻撃でリスクプレミアムが再び大きく上乗せされ、原油相場は反発している」と指摘した。

item.title: 仏大統領、「正当性ない」抗議活動禁止へ 暴動は「極左に責任」
item.description:
Michel Rose
[パリ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Michel Rose

[パリ　２２日　 ロイター] - フランスのマクロン大統領は２２日、教育環境の改善などを求める大規模な抗議デモが各地で続く中、「正当性のない」抗議活動を向こう数日以内に禁止すると表明した。また、先週末に発生した暴動や略奪は極左の「扇動的な」団体や破壊行為者に責任があるとの認識を示した。

マクロン氏はこの日、情報機関トップや主要閣僚との会合を実施。会合後に記者団に対し「１７日に国家の転覆を目的とする極左団体による政治的かつ扇動的な行為があった」と述べ、労働組合などが主催するデモについては実施を認めるものの、商店などを保護するためデモ隊のルート変更を求める可能性があると語った。

ダルマナン法相は、デモ参加禁止命令に違反した人の選挙権停止のほか、暴力行為や略奪、警察への攻撃に関与した人に対するソーシャルメディアの利用制限を導入したい考えを示した。

地元当局によると、フランス第２、第３の都市であるマルセイユとリヨンで２４日に予定されていた全ての抗議活動は禁止されている。ただ、フランス最大の学生組合ＵＮＥＦは２４日に集会を呼びかけているほか、２０１８年に発足した反体制運動「黄色いベスト運動」もパリ中心部を行進する計画を届け出るなど、新たな抗議活動の動きは広がりつつある。

２２日はパリで予定されていた学生による抗議集会が当初は禁止されたが、その後実施が認められた。ただ、無許可の集会が開かれる可能性が警戒される中、公共交通当局はパリ中心部の複数の地下鉄駅を閉鎖している。

item.title: Actor Tom Skerritt, star of 'Alien' and 'Top Gun,' dies at 93
item.description: Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93.
item.dc:creator: Will Dunham
item.content:encoded: Versatile actor Tom Skerritt, who starred in Hollywood megahits including the sci-fi classic "Alien," the war comedy "M*A*S*H," and the action drama "Top Gun," has died at the age of 93. Skerritt, a Detroit native whose Hollywood career spanned from the 1960s to the 2020s, died on Wednesday of natural causes, his family said in a statement. "While the world knew Tom through his remarkable acting career, we knew him for his humor, curiosity, wisdom, generosity, and the love he brought into our lives," they said. "He cared deeply about imagination, creativity, storytelling, service, veterans, the natural world, and helping others find and share their own voices." Known for his rugged good looks and ability to shine in a variety of genres, Skerritt delivered memorable performances in leading and supporting roles in film and television. Skerritt's breakthrough role was a roguish US Army surgeon in director Robert Altman's 1970 Korean War black comedy "M*A*S*H," a film whose ensemble cast also included Donald Sutherland, Elliott Gould and Sally Kellerman. Skerritt played Southerner Duke Forrest as the doctors at the Mobile Army Surgical Hospital stitched up wounded troops. The film, whose popularity coincided with American unease over the Vietnam War, was nominated for five Academy Awards. In director Ridley Scott's claustrophobic 1979 sci-fi horror "Alien," Skerritt played Dallas, the captain of an ill-fated spacecraft whose crew encounters a deadly parasitic extraterrestrial creature with a surrealist look and a bad attitude. In the film's famous and bloody "chestburster" scene, Skerritt's character is seated next to cast mate John Hurt when a baby alien violently exits the torso of Hurt's character. "Alien," an influential masterpiece whose ensemble cast also included Sigourney Weaver and Ian Holm, earned two Oscar nominations. "It is spontaneity and impulse that make the difference, and that is what I felt we had with 'Alien.' Every one of us had that immediate rapport with each other — the respect that I had for the other actors and the respect that they had for me," Skerritt told interviewer Peter Sobczynski in 2019, while also lauding Scott's directorial brilliance. "Alien" was one of several films in which Skerritt appeared that featured strong female characters, in this case Weaver's courageous character Ripley. That was considered pioneering at the time. "When I read the script, one of the things that I liked most about it was that the woman becomes the hero. I loved that," Skerritt said. "The sight of women being in positions of strength and fortitude to make the right connections and decisions was what appealed to me. I experienced that as well in 'Steel Magnolias,' with the women in that. I liked the idea of women being tough and strong and influential." In "Steel Magnolias" (1989), Skerritt played Drum Eatenton, husband of Sally Field's M'Lynn Eatenton. Tony Scott, the brother of the "Alien" director, cast Skerritt in the key supporting role of naval aviation instructor Viper Metcalf in the 1986 blockbuster "Top Gun" that helped star Tom Cruise soar into Hollywood's stratosphere. Skerritt also played Shirley MacLaine's husband in director Herbert Ross's 1977 ballet drama "The Turning Point," and starred alongside another emerging star in Brad Pitt in Robert Redford's beautifully shot 1992 period drama "A River Runs Through It." Among other films in which he appeared were: "Harold and Maude" (1971), "Ice Castles" (1978), "The Dead Zone" (1983), "Poltergeist III" (1988), "Contact" (1997), "Tears of the Sun" (2003) and "Ted" (2012). On the small screen, Skerritt starred in the offbeat CBS series "Picket Fences" from 1992 to 1996, playing a Wisconsin town sheriff and claiming an Emmy as outstanding lead actor in a drama series in 1993. Born on August 25, 1933, in Detroit, Skerritt served in the US Air Force before becoming an actor, making his film debut in 1962 alongside a young Redford in "War Hunt." He was a father of five children and was married three times.

item.title: Trump signs order aimed at reducing single-family housing costs
item.description: US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing expenses for homeowners by lowering insurance premiums, refinancing costs and interest rates on certain government-backed home loans, the White House said.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: US President Donald Trump on Thursday signed an executive order aimed at reducing expenses for homeowners by lowering insurance premiums, refinancing costs and interest rates on certain government-backed home loans, the White House said. High home prices and elevated mortgage rates have put pressure on the Trump administration to deliver meaningful relief as affordability has emerged as a political vulnerability for Republicans ahead of the November midterm elections. Trump's order directs the Federal Housing Finance Agency to launch a pilot program to cancel borrowers' mortgage insurance premiums once they meet equity requirements based on current market values. It also makes permanent an FHFA pilot program waiving title insurance requirements for mortgage refinancings. In addition, the order establishes a task force on manufactured housing innovation to expand factory-built homes eligible for federal housing programs, and directs the agriculture and veterans affairs secretaries to reduce interest rates on single-family home loans issued by their departments. Contracts to buy previously owned US homes plunged to a [USN:L1N4650NQ TEXT:"record low"] in September as rising mortgage rates depressed demand for housing, according to the National Association of Realtors. US single-family housing starts [USN:L1N4650SY TEXT:"fell 4.6%"] in September, while permits for future construction dropped 4% to their lowest level in 3-1/2 years, underscoring the challenges facing the housing market as borrowing costs rise. The average 30-year fixed mortgage rate last week reached 7.40%, the highest in about three years, before falling to 7.32% this week, according to Freddie Mac. The yield on the 10-year Treasury note, which acts as a pricing benchmark for mortgages, has fallen by more than a quarter percentage point in the last two weeks.

By Jack Queen Oct 22 (Reuters) – A federal judge on Thursday ordered Donald Trump to sit for a deposition by December 11 in his $10 billion defamation lawsuit against the BBC, which has accused the US president of stalling to avoid answering questions under oath.

Trump is suing Britain’s publicly funded broadcaster for at least $10 billion over a misleadingly edited clip of a speech. The case is one of several Trump has privately filed against the news media as part of a wider pressure campaign against coverage he dislikes.

US Magistrate Judge Enjolique Lett ordered Trump to take questions from the BBC’s lawyers under oath in a ruling from the bench at a court hearing on Thursday, according to a spokesman for Trump’s personal legal team. Trump canceled a deposition in October, citing conflicts with his presidential duties.

Show Full Article

The Trump spokesman said the lawsuit is aimed at holding the BBC accountable for defamation and “reckless election interference.”

The BBC declined to comment. It previously admitted the edits were misleading and apologized to Trump, though it denies being liable for defamation.

Trump’s lawsuit filed in December in Florida federal court accuses the BBC of intentionally misleading viewers into thinking he directed supporters to storm the US Capitol by splicing together different parts of a January 6, 2021, speech.

In court filings, the broadcaster has accused Trump and his lawyers of dragging their feet in response to their requests for records and other information that is exchanged between parties in a process known as discovery.

The BBC is seeking financial records from Trump’s Mar-a-Lago club and the web of business entities associated with him, saying the information is necessary to defend against Trump’s damages claims.

Trump’s lawyers say the requests are too broad and irrelevant to the case. They have also denied in court filings that Trump is avoiding a deposition, saying Trump’s duties and security needs must take precedence.

The edited speech appeared in a BBC “Panorama” documentary show shortly before the 2024 presidential election, which Trump won. A leaked internal BBC memo cited the edits as evidence of potential political bias, sparking a public relations crisis for the broadcaster and leading to high-level resignations.

(Reporting by Ryan Patrick Jones in Toronto and Jack Queen in New York; Editing by Michelle Nichols, Bill Berkrot and Daniel Wallis)

item.title: Juventus salvage Rennes draw as Benfica, Leverkusen stay perfect
item.description: Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: Juventus dropped their first points of the Europa League campaign after coming from behind to draw 2-2 with visitors Rennes on Thursday. Benfica went top of the standings with a 4-1 demolition of Omonia in Cyprus, after Bayer Leverkusen had also moved onto nine points with a 2-0 win at OFI in Crete. Bournemouth also maintained their perfect start with a 3-0 victory over 10-man AC Milan. Olympiacos and Ferencvaros made it three wins from three as well, beating Sparta Prague 1-0 and Torreense 4-1 respectively. Zeki Celik gave Juventus a fifth-minute lead, but the French side kept their composure and were level 10 minutes later when Jordan international Musa Al-Taamari finished from close range for his first goal in the competition. Rennes then stunned the hosts with a Boulaye Dia penalty two minutes before the break as the Italians struggled to create chances until Nick Woltemade equalised from the spot in the 67th minute. The German forward twice went close to scoring again as Luciano Spalletti's team upped the pressure, and Juve thought they had won it in the 88th minute when Jhon Lucumi found the net from close range, but his effort was ruled out for offside. The draw at least spared Juventus a second successive defeat following Sunday's 3-0 home [USN:L6N46407C TEXT:"loss"] to Lazio in Serie A. Jonas Hofmann made the most of his surprise start for Bayer Leverkusen, scoring twice in three minutes to give the Bundesliga side a 2-0 victory at OFI. OFI, who stunned Hoffenheim 2-0 in their opening league-phase match, were twice caught napping by Hofmann, who was added to the side following an injury to Martin Terrier. Bournemouth took control against Milan through first-half penalties from Justin Kluivert and Marcus Tavernier before Amine Adli added a third in the 84th minute. Milan goalkeeper Mike Maignan was sent off in the 28th minute. Hoffenheim beat Olympique Lyonnais 3-0 to claim their first win of the competition, but the victory was overshadowed by an injury to Lyon defender Steeve Kango. Kango fell awkwardly after an aerial challenge and was carried off on a stretcher wearing a neck brace before being taken to hospital for checks.

item.title: 欧州市場サマリー（22日）
item.description:
＜ロンドン株式市場＞
反落して取引を終えた。原油高やそれに伴うインフレへの懸念が強まる中、銀行や鉱業株の売り注文が優...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
欧州市場サマリー（22日） 4:14 配信

＜ロンドン株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。原油高やそれに伴うインフレへの懸念が強まる中、銀行や鉱業株の売り注文が優勢だった。中型株で構成するＦＴＳＥ２５０種指数は０．９３％下落した。

ＦＴＳＥ３５０種銀行株指数は２．５４％安。四半期決算の利益が市場予想を下回った銀行大手バークレイズは２．３％安。約５０００人の人員削減計画を発表した。

金や銅の値下がりを受けて、ＦＴＳＥ３５０種貴金属株指数は５．２１％、鉱業株指数は３．９７％それぞれ下落。銅大手アントファガスタは６．２％、資源大手アングロ・アメリカンは５．６％、リオ・ティントは３．４％いずれも値を下げた。

一方、製薬大手アストラゼネカは２．９％、ＧＳＫは２．５％それぞれ上昇。英日用品のユニリーバは３．２％高。

直近四半期の売上高の伸びが鈍化したスーパーマーケット大手セインズベリーは２．２％安。ホテル経営大手のインターコンチネンタル・ホテルズ・グループ（ＩＨＧ）は２．７％安。

ロンドン証券取引所グループ（ＬＳＥＧ）は７．７％高。金融データ企業の買収で合意したことが好材料視された。

ロンドン株式市場：[.LJP]

＜欧州株式市場＞

反落して取引を終えた。銀行株の売り注文が目立った。原油高やフランス国債利回りの上昇も相場の重荷となった。

ＳＴＯＸＸユーロ圏銀行株指数は４．１７％安。四半期決算を発表したスペインの銀行バンキンターは７．６％下落。英銀大手バークレイズは２．３％安。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州高級品株１０種指数は０．９１％安。足元の売上高が市場予想に届かずフランスの高級ブランド大手エルメスは４．９％下落した。

ＳＴＯＸＸ欧州６００種テクノロジー株指数は２．０４％安。人工知能（ＡＩ）関連投資への懸念が再燃し、欧州の半導体大手ＳＴマイクロエレクトロニクスは４．９％、オランダの半導体製造装置メーカーＡＳＭＬホールディングは５．０％、ドイツの半導体大手インフィニオン・テクノロジーズは６．０％いずれも下落した。

一方、食品・飲料株指数は１．９２％高。売上高の伸び率が市場予想を上回ったスイスの食品大手ネスレは１．１％上昇した。ヘルスケア株指数は２．０７％上昇。堅調な業績予想を示したベルギーのバイオ医薬品グループ、ユーシービーは２１．６％高だった。

欧州株式市場：[.FJ]

＜ユーロ圏債券＞

独仏１０年債利回り格差が１５年ぶりの高水準に拡大した。フランスの厳しい財政状況と抗議デモ継続への懸念が投資家心理を圧迫した。

フランスの指標１０年債利回りは終盤、６．５ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）上昇の５．０６％。一時は５．１４１５％と、２００２年７月以来の高水準を付けた。

安全資産とされるドイツ国債との利回り格差は１７７．７ｂｐと、ユーロ圏債務危機下の２０１１年１１月以来の水準に拡大。フランスの財政見通しに対する投資家の不安を浮き彫りにした。

ユーロ圏の指標となる独１０年債利回りは７ｂｐ低下の３．３４％。原油価格が上昇する中でも、安全資産需要が独国債を支えた。

独国債に対する利回り格差はユーロ圏全体で拡大した。ベルギーは１０ｂｐ拡大の１１０ｂｐと、２０１２年以来の高水準となった。イタリアは１０．５ｂｐ拡大の１２３ｂｐ、スペインは６ｂｐ拡大の７０ｂｐ、ギリシャは８．５ｂｐ拡大の１０６ｂｐだった。

金利見通しに敏感な独２年債利回りは６ｂｐ低下し、３．０２％となった。

短期金融市場が終盤に織り込む２７年末のＥＣＢ中銀預金金利は３．１５％。０．２５％ポイントの利上げを２回実施し、３回目を実施する確率が８０％であることを示している。

item.title: トランプ氏、マスク氏がウクライナ向けスターリンクを回復と表明
item.description:
Jacob Bogage
[ワシントン／キーウ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Jacob Bogage

[ワシントン／キーウ　２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、米宇宙開発企業スペースＸを率いるイーロン・マスク氏が、ウクライナ向け衛星通信サービス「スターリンク」へのアクセスを回復させたと述べた。この問題でマスク氏と協議したかについては言及を避けた。

これに先立ち、米紙ウォール・ストリート・ジャーナル（ＷＳＪ）は、トランプ氏がマスク氏に電話し、ウクライナに対するスターリンクの利用制限を解除するよう求めたと報道。トランプ氏はマスク氏に対し、ウクライナ向けのスターリンクの通信速度が制限された状態が続いていることに不満を示したとしていた。

トランプ氏はマスク氏と話したかと記者団に問われ、「それについてはコメントしたくない。私が電話したのか、他の誰かが電話したのかは、どちらでも変わらないと思う。要するに、彼が元に戻したということだ」と述べた。それ以上の説明はしなかった。

ウクライナは戦場での通信やドローン（無人機）の運用にスターリンクを利用している。サービスの制限は、ロシアに対する攻撃や防空のためのドローン運用を妨げていた。

ＷＳＪは、米国とウクライナの当局者の話として、トランプ氏とマスク氏の協議後まもなくスターリンクは通常に近い状態で利用できるようになったと伝えた。

一部のウクライナ当局者は同紙に対し、完全には機能が回復していないものの、システムは制限下よりも高速で稼働していると述べた。

ウクライナのゼレンスキー大統領はＷＳＪの報道に先立ち、スターリンクの通信速度は回復していないと述べ、この問題について向こう数日以内にルビオ米国務長官と協議できることを期待していると語っていた。

トランプ氏はスターリンクの速度制限に関する決定への関与を否定している。ルビオ氏は２１日、ウクライナによるスターリンクへのアクセスに関する決定はホワイトハウスではなく、運営会社のスペースＸとマスク氏次第だと記者団に述べた。

item.title: ＮＹ外為市場＝円が大幅高、原油高やＡＩ収益懸念で安全資産買い
item.description: ［ニューヨーク ２２日 ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
ＮＹ外為市場＝円が大幅高、原油高やＡＩ収益懸念で安全資産買い 4:03 配信

2026年10月20日撮影 REUTERS/Kim Kyung-Hoon/Illustration

［ニューヨーク　２２日　ロイター］ - 終盤のニューヨーク外為市場では、円が１日としては約１カ月ぶりの大幅上昇となる見通し。株式市場の不安定な動きや中東での戦争長期化に伴う原油高、人工知能（ＡＩ）投資の将来の収益性に対する疑念を背景に、投資家が安全資産を求めた。

円は対ドルで０．７５％上昇し、１ドル＝１５６．９６円となった。

円相場の動きの一部は、重要な節目である１ドル＝１６０円に近づいていたことも背景にある可能性がある。この水準に近づくほど、日本当局が円を下支えするため再び介入する可能性が高まると見られている。

ドルは、円と同様に伝統的な安全資産とされるスイスフランに対して０．４２％下落し、１ドル＝０．８２１フランとなった。

円やユーロなど主要通貨に対するドルの値動きを示すドル指数は０．０８％低下し、１０１．６０。

ユーロは０．０９％下落し、１ユーロ＝１．１２２２ドルとなった。

ウェルズ・ファーゴのグローバル為替戦略責任者、エリック・ネルソン氏は「米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力とフランスの国家としての信用力という、それぞれの弱点を巡る材料がせめぎ合っている。ここ数日は、どちらへの懸念が強いかによって相場が左右されている。フランスへの懸念が米国のＡＩ関連企業の信用力への懸念を上回る限り、ユーロは相対的に軟調に推移するだろう」と語った。

フランスが巨額の債務負担に対処できるかどうかへの懸念が同国の国債を圧迫し、債務水準が高い他のユーロ圏諸国への不安も高めている。

英ポンドは０．０５％上昇し、１ポンド＝１．３４０１ドル。豪ドルは０．１１％下落し、１豪ドル＝０．７０１９米ドルとなった。

暗号資産（仮想通貨）のビットコインは４．２７％下落し、８万１０２３ドルとなった。

item.title: Rooney labels Man United players 'selfish' after Fernandes criticism
item.description: Oct 22 : Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain Bruno Fernandes questioned the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como.Fernandes said United failed to apply enough
item.dc:creator: CNA
item.content:encoded:

Rooney labels Man United players 'selfish' after Fernandes criticism

FAST

Oct 22 : Manchester United's all-time leading scorer Wayne Rooney called the club's players "selfish" and said they were "like babies" after captain Bruno Fernandes questioned the coaching staff's tactics following Wednesday's 4-1 Champions League thrashing by Como. Fernandes said United failed to apply enough pressure and adopted a "mood of defeat" after conceding in the second minute, as the heavy loss intensified scrutiny of manager Michael Carrick. United's collapse at Como left them staring at another damaging defeat, with only a stoppage-time goal from Joshua Zirkzee reducing the margin of loss. The criticism follows signs of growing frustration within the squad. Earlier this month, defender Lisandro Martinez criticised the club's hierarchy after a 2-0 Champions League defeat by Atletico Madrid, saying he expected greater investment to help the team compete at the highest level.

"When Martinez came out, I said this is an absolute nightmare because it will rip the dressing room apart," Rooney told the United Stand podcast on Thursday. "That was the start. We've seen it now with Bruno and you're going to see it with more players because they don't want to take responsibility. "You can say whether Bruno was right or wrong in what he said but you have to take responsibility on the pitch. You have to take responsibility as a group of players. "These players, they're selfish. They don't care about their teammates, don't care about the manager, the staff or the fans, they care about themselves. "If they're not getting what's right for them, they're like babies and just throw. their toys out of the pram and go and deflect the blame on to anyone else but themselves." Carrick, a former United midfielder who played alongside Rooney at Old Trafford, was appointed on an interim basis following Ruben Amorim's dismissal in January before earning a contract through 2028 after overseeing a dramatic improvement in results. Carrick is under growing pressure with United winless in seven matches across all competitions. They are 20th in the Champions League standings and 13th in the Premier League.

item.title: Trump says Musk restored Ukraine's Starlink access, declines to say if they spoke
item.description: Donald Trump said on Thursday that SpaceX CEO Elon Musk had restored Ukraine's Starlink access but the US president declined to comment when asked whether he had spoken to the billionaire about the matter.
item.dc:creator: Jacob Bogage , Kanishka Singh
item.content:encoded: Donald Trump said on Thursday that SpaceX (SPCX.O) CEO Elon Musk had restored Ukraine's Starlink access but the US president declined to comment when asked whether he had spoken to the billionaire about the matter. The Wall Street Journal reported earlier on Thursday that Trump had called Musk and asked him to lift restrictions on Ukraine's use of Starlink. "I don't want to comment on it, whether I called or whether somebody else called, doesn't make any difference, I guess. The bottom line - he put it back," Trump told reporters when asked if he spoke to Musk. Trump did not elaborate further. Ukraine uses Starlink for battlefield communications and drone operations. Restricting the satellite service [USN:L8N4600M6 TEXT:"hampered"] the country's attack and air defense drone missions against Russia. The Starlink system was working more normally on Thursday, shortly after the Trump-Musk conversation, the WSJ reported earlier, citing US and Ukrainian officials. Some Ukrainian officials told the newspaper the system had not been restored to full functionality but was working at higher speeds than under the cap. Ukrainian President Volodymyr Zelenskiy said earlier on Thursday that speed on Starlink systems had not been restored for Ukraine, adding that he hoped for talks with US Secretary of State Marco Rubio in the coming days. Trump told Musk he was frustrated the system's speeds remained capped, according to the newspaper. Trump has denied being involved in the decision concerning the slowdown. Rubio told reporters on Wednesday that decisions regarding Ukraine's [USN:L6N467096 TEXT:"access to Starlink"] were up to its parent company SpaceX and Musk, not the White House. Zelenskiy's relations with Washington have sunk to new lows after Trump announced a deal to buy Russian diesel and waived new sanctions on Moscow. Trump has also told Kyiv to stop attacking Russian refineries and urged Ukrainians to replace Zelenskiy. Russia [USN:L1N4671BN TEXT:"pounded Kyiv"] with ballistic missiles and Ukraine sent hundreds of drones towards Moscow on Thursday, as the warring sides kept up a barrage of attacks despite the latest US push to end the conflict. Russia launched a full-scale invasion of Ukraine in early 2022. Trump had promised to end the war when he took office but the goal has remained elusive.

item.title: 銀行の自国国債保有制限案「時期尚早」、長期金利上昇が目下の問題＝伊中銀総裁
item.description: [ローマ ２２日 ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ ）理事会メンバーのパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁は２２日、銀行に...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
銀行の自国国債保有制限案「時期尚早」、長期金利上昇が目下の問題＝伊中銀総裁 3:33 配信

写真はパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁。フランス・パリで５月撮影。REUTERS/Tom Nicholson

[ローマ　２２日　ロイター] - 欧州中央銀行 （ＥＣＢ ）理事会メンバーのパネッタ・イタリア中銀総裁は２２日、銀行による自国国債の保有を制限するという案は時期尚早であり、有益でないとの考えを示した。

銀行が多額の国債を保有すると金利上昇に対して脆弱になり、銀行と国家財政の「負の連鎖」を招く危険性は広く議論されており、一部のエコノミストは、銀行が自国の国債に対するエクスポージャーを制限することを提案している。

パネッタ氏はトリノで開催された経済フォーラムで、こうした提案は「やや時期尚早である」と指摘。２０１１─１２年のユーロ圏債務危機当時よりも銀行の財務体質は強化されており、資本準備金に対する国債保有比率もはるかに低いと述べた。

現在の問題は長期金利の上昇にあり、こうした状況下で長期国債の購入余地を制限することは賢明でないと述べた。さらに、監督当局は銀行が国債や金利リスクに過度にさらされていないかを既に監視していると説明。その上で「現時点でこの議論を行うことはあまり有意義ではないと思う」と述べた。

item.title: Steep bill for AI buildout punishes Meta, other tech favorites
item.description: The tab for the next round of the AI buildout came due on Thursday.
item.dc:creator: Lewis Krauskopf, Sudeshna Ghoshal
item.content:encoded: The tab for the next round of the AI buildout came due on Thursday. Investors sold shares of Meta Platforms (META.O) and a wealth of companies central to the AI trade, a day after Meta — one of the hyperscalers spending billions to build data centers and other infrastructure supporting the AI boom — said it would issue a new class of shares that will help it raise funds. Meta fell 7%, its largest drop since July. SpaceX (SPCX.O) declined 9% and semiconductor company Nvidia (NVDA.O) — a bellwether of the AI trade — dropped 4%. The Nasdaq Composite (.IXIC) lost 2.6%, its largest decline since June 5. Sentiment was also hurt by a 12% plunge in shares of semiconductor company Lam Research (LRCX.O) following its results. The Philadelphia Semiconductor index (.SOX) lost 6.7%. The pullback is the latest test for the AI trade as investors focus on the rising costs of long-term projects where the payoff remains uncertain. Tech firms have borrowed huge sums over the past year for AI spending, but Wall Street now expects that the rise in borrowing costs will motivate tech companies like Meta to sell billions of dollars in stock to fund the next round of building. That dilution could put pressure on share prices, and is a potentially unwelcome development when major US stock indexes remain near all-time highs despite a punishing month of volatile trading. RETURN ON INVESTMENT CONCERNS Selling started with "the big question about the (return on investment) on all the spending," said Matthew Maley, chief market strategist at Miller Tabak. "It's just becoming more and more evident to people that it's going to take a lot longer." Thomas Hayes, chairman at Great Hill Capital LLC in New York, agreed that ROI concerns are central while also citing remarks by Nvidia CEO Jensen Huang about a financing bottleneck for smaller AI companies as contributing to the selling. Meta said on Wednesday it would use new Class C shares, which hold no voting power, to [USN:l4n4671s3 TEXT:"fund AI spending and other priorities"]. Meta also raised the low end of its annual spending forecast to $135 billion from $130 billion, with the high end unchanged at $145 billion. That level of spending will require lots of investor participation in coming stock sales. Meta reported negative free cash flow of $2.12 billion in the third quarter, compared with positive free cash flow of $10.63 billion a year earlier. It was the first cash burn at Meta in more than a decade. “More spending, negative free cash flow, not enough revenue being generated from the spend (is) concerning investors that this is just sort of a bit of a money pit,” said Robert Pavlik, senior portfolio manager at Dakota Wealth in Fairfield, Connecticut. The action highlights concern over how AI investment will be paid for. Credit default swaps, which track perceived default risk for the debt of the biggest AI players, have largely risen over the past year, with Meta’s hitting a record on Thursday . INVESTOR ANXIETY SHOWS Fresh signs of market anxiety over AI spending snowballed into a broad market selloff Thursday, with some saying an AI pullback could hit US growth. Investors sought the safety of Treasury bonds, sending those prices higher . "This is your classic rotation day,” said Joe Saluzzi, partner, co-founder and co-head of equity trading at Themis Trading in Chatham, New Jersey. “You can see the money going into Treasuries, so it's a classic safety move ... They are rotating out of techs, out of the AIs, and into the more safety trades, whether it's bonds or some of those big Dow Jones stocks.” Thursday’s selloff added to the pressure on the neocloud companies at the heart of the AI buildout, with Nebius (NBIS.O) off 7% after announcing a new $3.5 billion credit line from Citigroup and CoreWeave (CRWV.O) , whose unsecured bond yields soared to 15% in last week’s AI selloff, down 10%. Bank of America analyst Tal Liani said in a report on Thursday he is maintaining a buy rating and a price target of $140 on CoreWeave stock heading into next month’s earnings report, though he said he believes the firm will need to raise $20 billion to fund commitments to customers — the sort of prospect that is generating anxiety among tech investors. "Nobody is worried about Meta or Amazon or Google getting the financing they need," Maley said. "But if it gets prohibitive for smaller companies, then you don't have to have an implosion of things to make people nervous."

item.title: Merck/Moderna cancer vaccine cuts melanoma death or recurrence risk by 42%, shares fall
item.description: Moderna and Merck said on Thursday that their mRNA cancer vaccine when combined with Merck's widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of melanoma death or recurrence by 42% in a large trial, potentially paving the way for a new era of personalized treatment.
item.dc:creator: Michael Erman, Julie Steenhuysen
item.content:encoded: Moderna (MRNA.O) and Merck (MRK.N) said on Thursday that their mRNA cancer vaccine when combined with Merck's widely used immunotherapy cut the risk of melanoma death or recurrence by 42% in a large trial, potentially paving the way for a new era of personalized treatment. Moderna shares have soared since the companies in August announced the trial's success without the actual data, nearly quadrupling through Wednesday's close. They closed more than 17% lower after the results leaked on an oncology website earlier on Thursday. Merck shares closed down about 1.8%. The data from the Phase 3 trial of more than 1,100 patients also showed that the combination cut the risk of the cancer's spread by 38%. It is the first data to show that the combination of a vaccine based on mutations unique to each patient's tumor plus a drug that helps the immune system fight cancer can keep the disease at bay. The vaccine, known as intismeran autogene, was tested along with Merck's blockbuster immunotherapy Keytruda, among the world's biggest-selling medicines. Some analysts said the data may raise concerns among investors about how broadly the technology may extend to other cancers. Keytruda works by removing a natural brake cancer cells use to hide from immune system attack, while the vaccine instructs the patient's cells to produce copies of specific mutations for the immune system to seek and destroy. Moderna CEO Stephane Bancel said the data signaled a new chapter in cancer treatment. "With this ability to create new T cells that are specific to your tumor... the clinical impact is very profound, and as we saw in the Phase 2 (trial), very lasting," Bancel said in an interview. The companies are preparing to file for US approval and expect the cancer vaccine to launch in 2027, Bancel said. The intismeran/Keytruda combination is already being tested in multiple other cancers, including kidney, bladder and lung cancer. Bancel said he believes the vaccine should add to efficacy "everywhere that Keytruda works," but it remains to be seen how much it will improve results. Keytruda is approved for 19 types of cancer. The CEO also said intismeran could work on its own as a treatment in early-stage cancers. The Phase 3 melanoma results, based on patient data for the first two years after treatment, are scheduled to be presented on Saturday at the European Society for Medical Oncology meeting in Madrid. Among those who received the vaccine in addition to Keytruda, 82.2% were still cancer-free after two years, compared with 70% of patients who received Keytruda alone. "This is highly statistically significant. It is not by chance," Dr. Hussein Tawbi, a melanoma expert and trial investigator at the University of Texas MD Anderson Cancer Center, said of the results. Several Wall Street analysts said before the meeting that investors were looking for the combination to cut the risk of recurrence by 40% or more. "We see optimism waning on pricing in multibillion-dollar (intismeran) franchises across oncology," wrote RBC analyst Trung Huynh. "This data makes us less optimistic as melanoma was supposed to be the best case." The trial tested nine doses of the vaccine along with Keytruda, beginning 13 weeks after surgery to remove melanoma lesions. The response to the combination treatment was compared with that of the patients treated with just Keytruda, a standard therapy for melanoma.

item.title: トランプ氏、レブロン・ジェームズ選手を批判 国歌斉唱中に「無礼な振る舞い」
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、米プロバスケットボール協会（ＮＢＡ）のスーパースター、レブロン・ジェームズ選手が試合前の国歌斉唱中に「無礼な振る舞い」をしたとして批判した。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」への投稿で「国歌を聴いている間、レブロン・ジェームズはわが国を侮辱する態度を取った」と述べ、ジェームズさんが国歌斉唱中に体を動かしている様子を映した動画を添付した。

さらに「レブロン・ジェームズは、米国国旗とわが国が象徴する全てのために命を捧げた偉大な米国の戦士や英雄たち全員に謝罪すべきだ！」と非難した。

トランプ氏が共有した動画には、ジェームズさんが所属するセブンティシクサーズの選手たちと一列に並び、ウオームアップとして腕を振ったり、シュートの動作をする様子が映っていた。

item.title: 仏でシャモンダウイルスのヒト感染確認、世界初 患者は死亡
item.description:
Sybille de La Hamaide
[パリ ２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
Sybille de La Hamaide

[パリ ２２日 ロイター] - フランス政府は２２日、主に牛などの家畜が感染するシャモンダウイルスについて、ヒトへの感染を世界で初めて確認したと発表した。患者はその後、死亡した。ただ、現段階で一般市民へのリスクはないとしている。

国際獣疫事務局（ＷＯＡＨ）によると、シャモンダウイルスは吸血性昆虫のヌカカが媒介する。牛のほか、馬やアルパカ、羊、ヤギでも確認されている。

政府の声明によると、患者はフランス東部でウイルスを保有するヌカカに刺された疑いがある。同地域では今春から夏にかけて動物の間でウイルスが広がっていた。

国連の世界保健機関（ＷＨＯ）は、今回の感染について仏当局と連絡を取っていると明らかにしたうえで、「現時点で得られている情報と近縁のウイルスの感染経路に関する知見に基づけば、これはヒトへの単発の感染例であり、現段階で感染拡大につながる可能性は低い」と説明した。

仏政府も、一般市民への健康リスクは確認されていないとした。

地元紙ル・プログレによると、患者はリヨン地域に住む６０代の男性。ストックホルムに本部を置く欧州疾病予防管理センター（ＥＣＤＣ）によると、患者は１０月上旬に死亡した。重い病気の治療を受けており、一般の人より感染しやすい状態だった。

item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日　ロイター] - トランプ米大統領は２２日、イランが米国の中間選挙を前に原油価格を押し上げようとしているとの認識を示した。

トランプ氏は自身の交流サイト（ＳＮＳ）「トゥルース・ソーシャル」に「イランは中間選挙を前に原油価格をつり上げるため、できる限りのことをしている」と投稿。「現在は戦闘開始前より多くの原油がホルムズ海峡を通過しているため、イランは偽の攻撃や機雷など、あらゆるものをでっち上げている」と主張した。

item.title: US regulator is probing suspicious Iran oil trading, official says
item.description: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing suspicious oil trading activity around the US war in Iran and scrutinizing prediction market trading around elections, the agency's enforcement director said on Thursday at a conference in New York.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: The US Commodity Futures Trading Commission is probing suspicious oil trading activity around the US war in Iran and scrutinizing prediction market trading around elections, the agency's enforcement director said on Thursday at a conference in New York. CFTC Enforcement Director David Miller made the remarks in response to a Bloomberg News story last week that said a CFTC political appointee had told market surveillance staff to retract a referral to the agency's enforcement team identifying suspicious trading around President Donald Trump's March decision to back away from strikes on Iran's power plants. When asked about the story during a panel at the conference, Miller said the agency had "from the beginning" been probing the trading and that the investigation remained open. The report fueled concerns raised by investor advocates and lawmakers over a decline in enforcement activity at the agency, which is dealing with an [USN:L6N43N0Y2 TEXT:"exodus of staff"] as it tries to oversee the growing prediction markets industry. Prediction markets allow people to bet on the outcome of various events, from US elections to sports games. Federal lawmakers are starting to scrutinize the industry, and most Americans oppose the idea of betting on government actions or elections, according to a mid-October [USN:L1N45S0TL TEXT:"Reuters/Ipsos opinion poll"]. Miller also said the CFTC is watching for problematic trading in prediction markets, including on election outcomes. He declined to comment specifically on the November US midterm elections. CFTC staff "have investigated, and may have open investigations about some candidates who have placed trades on contracts that are based on their own elections," Miller said.

item.title: 米マイクロン、27年から全世界で業績連動報酬導入へ 台湾労組の圧力受け
item.description:
Wen-Yee Lee
[台北 ２２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは２２日、２０２７会計年度...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
米マイクロン、27年から全世界で業績連動報酬導入へ　台湾労組の圧力受け 1:14 配信

米マイクロンの施設。台湾・台中市で１５日撮影。REUTERS/Ann Wang

Wen-Yee Lee

[台北 ２２日 ロイター] - 米半導体大手マイクロン・テクノロジーは２２日、２０２７会計年度から全世界の従業員を対象に、四半期ごとの業績連動型報酬制度を導入すると発表した。人工知能（ＡＩ）ブームで得られた利益のうち、従業員への分配をより多くするよう求める台湾の労働組合の圧力を受けた措置となる。

マイクロンは、新たな制度は既存の年次インセンティブ制度を補完するものだと説明。韓国の競合サムスン電子やＳＫハイニックスの制度と異なり、マイクロンは利益の配分比率や従業員向けに確保された総額については開示していない。

マイクロンによると、四半期ごとの賞与原資は、２６会計年度を基準年として、税引き後利益から次四半期の予想設備投資額を差し引いた額を基に算出する。賞与の半分は決算発表後に現金で支給され、残りは１年後に権利が確定する株式で支払われる。

ただ、新しい生産能力が収益を生み出し始める前に工場や設備に多額の投資を行うため、この方式では基礎的な業績が改善しても、生産能力拡大の局面では支給額が制限される可能性がある。

今回の発表は、２１日にマイクロンの大規模な台中事業所の労組との間で成立した合意を受けたものとなる。桃園の別の労組との協議は、２２日時点で合意に至っていない。

item.title: FIFA opens bidding for 2030 and 2034 World Cup media rights covering US and Puerto Rico
item.description: FIFA opened the bidding process for US media rights to the 2030 World Cup on Thursday along with an option to secure the 2034 edition, adding that it has yet to decide whether to keep the controversial hydration breaks introduced this year that opened up additional advertising windows for broadcasters.
item.dc:creator: Frank Pingue
item.content:encoded: FIFA opened the bidding process for US media rights to the 2030 World Cup on Thursday along with an option to secure the 2034 edition, adding that it has yet to decide whether to keep the controversial hydration breaks introduced this year that opened up additional advertising windows for broadcasters. FIFA said in a press release that it was open to "innovative approaches" to reach large audiences and that the bid submission deadline is November 19. Fox held the exclusive English-language FIFA broadcast rights in the United States for the last three World Cups, including the 2026 edition that was co-hosted by the US, Canada and Mexico, while Telemundo held the Spanish language rights during that same time. Spain, which won the 2026 World Cup, will co-host the 2030 edition with Portugal and Morocco, although Argentina, Paraguay and Uruguay will also stage matches to mark the tournament's 100th anniversary. Saudi Arabia will host the 2034 World Cup. FIFA Chief Business Officer Romy Gai, speaking to reporters after the announcement, said world soccer's governing body is still evaluating whether to keep the hydration breaks that were put in place for the 2026 World Cup to help players cope with high temperatures but also proved lucrative for broadcasters. The hydration breaks fuelled debate over their impact on the game, with some viewers complaining about being exposed to commercials during the three-minute stoppages in each half. "If the average temperature will be higher than the normal average is in these countries we expect to confirm having the hydration break, but not automatically," said Gai. "It's not the final decision because this is something that we need to further engage with all the stakeholders." According to FIFA, the 2026 World Cup averaged 13.5 million viewers per match on linear and streaming platforms in the United States, up 166% on the 2022 World Cup in Qatar. Earlier this week, [USN:L6N45Z0QE TEXT:"Netflix"] announced that it secured the rights to broadcast the 2030 World Cup in Spain and Andorra. The Saudi climate will likely force FIFA to hold the 2034 tournament in the Northern Hemisphere winter, just like it did for the 2022 World Cup in Qatar, but Gai said that while it is a possibility the matter has not yet been discussed officially. "It's too early for that. But this is something that we are concretely considering," Gai said when asked about staging the 2034 World Cup in November-December of that year instead of the tournament's traditional June-July slot. "It will be further assessed and we will share the same comments with any bidders when it will be the time to sit down and analyze how it can be to play the World Cup in 2034. It is a clear possibility ... but it's not yet confirmed. So we need to understand more."

item.title: トルコ中銀、利下げ再開 政策金利36％
item.description: ［イスタンブール ２２日 ロイター］ - トルコ中央銀行は２２日の金融政策決定会合で、主要政策金利を１００ベーシスポイ...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
トルコ中銀、利下げ再開　政策金利36％ 1:05 配信

２０２４年２月撮影　REUTERS/Cagla Gurdogan

［イスタンブール　２２日　ロイター］ - トルコ中央銀行は２２日の金融政策決定会合で、主要政策金利を１００ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）引き下げ、３６．０％にすると決定した。市場予想とほぼ一致した。２月末に始まった米イラン交戦がインフレに与える影響を見極めるため５会合連続で金利を据え置いていた。エネルギー価格は大幅に上昇しているものの、輸入依存型のトルコ経済への影響が懸念されたほどではないとの見方から利下げに踏み切ったもようだ。

ロイターがまとめた調査で、２２人のエコノミストが利下げを予想。据え置き予想は２人だった。今年１２月の会合でさらに１００ｂｐの利下げが見込まれている。金融緩和局面は２０２７年に入っても続き、政策金利は２７年３月末に３３％、６月末に３１％、９月末に３０％、１２月末には２８％まで低下していくと見られている。

トルコの２６年９月の消費者物価指数（ＣＰＩ）は前月比１．８４％上昇と市場予想を下回った。前年同月比では２９．７３％上昇した。ロイター調査で、２６年末時点のインフレ率予想は２９．５％。２７年末には２３．７％まで鈍化すると見込まれている。２６年の経済成長率は２．７％、２７年は３．７％に加速すると予想されている。政府は２６年の成長率見通しを３．３％、２７年は４．２％としている。

item.description: Oct 22 : AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year.The exercise, conducted from July 21 to August 11, gave

External evaluators find flaws in OpenAI's AI monitoring system in pilot review

FAST

Oct 22 : AI safety evaluators METR and Redwood Research found several new vulnerabilities in OpenAI's internal system, including an exploit agents could have used to keep hundreds of their actions from being monitored, in a pilot review earlier this year. The exercise, conducted from July 21 to August 11, gave outside researchers "a deep level of access" to OpenAI's internal infrastructure for so-called embedded evaluations, the safety nonprofits said on Thursday. METR and Redwood said they each sent one researcher, tested an arrangement giving access to OpenAI's internal code, documentation and some technical staff. Both were accompanied on site and used OpenAI-issued devices that "never left the premises". OpenAI told the safety organizations it has since patched all vulnerabilities affecting its production safeguards, although METR and Redwood said they had not verified the fixes.

AI labs, experts and the Trump administration have touted independent evaluation by outside reviewers as a way to safely advance the technology without slowing its development. However, AI companies are worried that evaluator staff working inside the companies' walls could take proprietary information to rivals, Reuters reported earlier this month. While OpenAI received a full 61-page internal report, METR and Redwood said they agreed to publish only a broad summary publicly, and gave OpenAI the right to redact sensitive information. Unlike in some previous evaluations, they could not independently disclose those redactions, but said they expected greater transparency in future evaluations. The researchers also identified a potential way for OpenAI's Codex agents to bypass security restrictions and act with their users' full permissions. The evaluators assessed the monitoring system as it existed on and before July 21, and noted that OpenAI was expanding the system during the exercise. OpenAI said the "findings helped strengthen safeguards as we expanded the system and will help shape future research collaborations with METR and other third-party evaluators."

Source: Reuters

item.title: Yes Bank unlikely to pay AT1 bond coupons despite bond holders demand, sources say
item.description: Yes Bank has announced potential non-payment of coupons on additional tier-1 bonds this fiscal year following a Supreme Court decision that annulled the previous write-off of these bonds. Bondholders are advocating for repayment based on the court's ruling, which emphasizes unsettled dues. Nonetheless, Yes Bank maintains it has ultimate authority over coupon payments, raising concerns about its financial losses impacting these obligations.
item.dc:creator: Reuters
item.content:encoded: India's Yes Bank is unlikely to pay coupons due this year on its additional tier-1 (AT1) bonds despite a Supreme Court ruling overturning their write-off during the lender's 2020 rescue, two persons familiar with the matter said.The bank is preparing to seek a review of the ruling, one of the sources told Reuters, while bondholders press for payment of coupons that have remained unpaid since Yes Bank wrote the bonds off six years ago.Last week, India's Supreme Court upheld a 2023 Bombay High Court ruling that set aside Yes Bank's write-off of 84 billion rupees ($886 million) worth of AT1 bonds, in a setback to the lender and regulators that had defended the move.Yes Bank did not respond to an email seeking comment.The sources declined to be named as they were not authorised to speak on the matter.Retail investors holding the bonds said on Thursday they had not received coupon payments due on October 18, three days after the SC ruling.In a letter to Axis Trustee Services Ltd, reviewed by Reuters, investors sought clarity on the status of coupon payments and urged the debenture trustee to intervene. We call upon the Trustee to obtain immediate written confirmation from Yes Bank as to whether this coupon has been paid, cancelled or remains outstanding, bondholders said.They cited the Supreme Court order that payment of annual coupons shall remain unaffected by the outcome of these appeals and must be made in terms of the Information Memoranda. The sources, however, said the bond documentation gives the bank discretion over coupon payments and that the issue can only be considered once the AT1 bonds are reinstated on the bank's balance sheet.The losses the bank accumulated during fiscal years 2020 and 2021 are expected to be fully offset only by fiscal 2028, a third source familiar with the matter told Reuters. This could weigh on the bank's decision to pay coupons on its AT1 bonds, the source added.Yes Bank carries a debit balance of 52.79 billion rupees ($557 million) in its profit and loss account, according to the lender's latest annual report.

item.title: 中国チベットでＭ7の地震、16人死亡・32人負傷
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] -
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
[２２日 ロイター] - 中国地震ネットワークセンター（ＣＥＮＣ）によると、中国南西部のチベット自治区で２２日午後１０時３３分（１４３３ＧＭＴ、日本時間午後１１時３３分）ごろ、マグニチュード（Ｍ）７の地震が発生した。国営新華社通信は現地応急管理局の情報として、１６人が死亡、３２人が負傷したと報じた。

ＣＥＮＣのデータによると、震央はチベット北部ナクチュの標高の高い地域に位置し、震源の深さは１０キロ。震央から半径５キロ以内の平均標高は約４８６４メートル。

ＣＥＮＣによると、中国で発生した地震としては２０２４年１月以来の規模。震央は自治区の中心都市ラサから約４００キロ離れている。

地元の公営メディアが公開した映像には、住民が自宅を出て屋外や路上に駐車した車内に避難する様子が映っていた。ある住民は、強い揺れで目が覚め、家がきしむ音が聞こえたと話した。

今回の震央から約２８０キロ離れた隣接する青海省玉樹では、２０１０年にＭ７．１の地震が発生し、少なくとも２６９８人が死亡、約３００人が行方不明となった。

item.title: メタ株6.5％安、ＡＩ投資負担を懸念 ＣＤＳも過去最高水準
item.description: [２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶり...
item.dc:creator: ロイター
item.content:encoded:
メタ株6.5％安、ＡＩ投資負担を懸念　ＣＤＳも過去最高水準 0:36 配信

2025年6月12日、フランス・パリで撮影。 REUTERS/Benoit Tessier/File Photo

[２２日 ロイター] - ２２日午前の米株式市場で、メタ・プラットフォームズの株価が６．５％下落し、一時約６週間ぶりの安値を付けた。同社のクレジット・デフォルト・スワップ（ＣＤＳ） も過去最高水準に上昇している。投資家は、急成長する人工知能（ＡＩ）エージェント事業の恩恵と、野心的なＡＩ事業拡大に伴う資金負担の増大を見極めている。

マークイットのデータによると、同社の債務不履行に備える保証コストであるＣＤＳは、５年物スプレッドが７．６ベーシスポイント（ｂｐ）拡大し、過去最高の１１４．７９ｂｐとなった。１日の拡大幅としては少なくとも２０２５年以降で最大となる見通し。

２１日終値時点では、株価は２６年に入って５％超上昇していた。現在の下落幅が続けば、時価総額は約８５０億ドル減少する見通し。

メタが２１日に発表した第３・四半期決算は、売上高が６４６億ドルと、ＬＳＥＧが集計したアナリスト予想の６３３億７０００万ドルを上回った。第４・四半期の売上高見通しも市場予想を上回った。

また、２６年の設備投資見通しを１３５０億─１４５０億ドルとし、従来の１３００億─１４５０億ドルから下限を引き上げた。
